new_roles.title: Director, New Product Development Engineering
new_roles.description:
Bevi is on a mission to transform how beverages are delivered and consumed. Our connected beverage platform eliminates the need for single-use bottles and cans, making it easy, fun, and sustainable to stay hydrated. As the category leader in IoT-enabled beverage technology, we're building a future where Bevi machines are everywhere people live, work, and connect. We've raised over $160M in venture capital, serve thousands of customers across the US, Canada, UK and Ireland, and we've been rapidly growing year over year, saving over 1 billion bottles from waste. In addition to driving hypergrowth with our current product line, Bevi is heavily investing in new product development.
 
 
Bevi is hiring a Director of New Product Development Engineering to lead the team that designs our next generation of beverage machines and takes them into high-volume production. The work spans new platforms, smaller form-factor machines, hot water, flavor cartridges, and consumables, and brings together hardware, software, and beverage science.
 
 
Your top priority is scaling. You'll take Bevi's hardware into much higher-volume, lower-cost manufacturing, working closely with ODM, JDM, and overseas contract manufacturing partners. You'll lead NPD Engineering, Systems Engineering, and Compliance Engineering, and own new products from concept through certification and production launch.
 
 
This role reports to the VP of Engineering, sits on the engineering leadership team, and works across Product, Software, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and more. Bevi is still growing fast, so you'll have real room to shape how we build hardware and the team that does it. Expect regular travel to manufacturing partners in Asia.
 
 
What You'll Own
 
 
New Product Development
 
 

* Lead new product programs from concept and prototype through EVT, DVT, PVT, and mass production.
* Own product architecture and make the tradeoff calls on cost, reliability, manufacturability, and schedule, while staying hands-on in design reviews and critical build issues.
* Set cost targets (BOM, tooling, landed cost) early and design to them, with DFM, DFA, and design-for-cost built in from the start.

High-Volume Manufacturing & Working with ODMs
 
 

* Lead Bevi's shift to high-volume, lower-cost manufacturing with ODM, JDM, and overseas contract manufacturing partners.
* Work with partner engineering teams as true collaborators: align on specs, work through design feedback together, and decide where their expertise can speed up our programs.
* Drive NPI and transfer to production, including pilot builds, line validation, and yield ramp, with time on-site during critical builds.

Systems Engineering & Compliance
 
 

* Guide Systems Engineering on requirements, architecture, DFMEA, and design verification across mechanical, electrical, firmware, software, and beverage subsystems.
* Oversee product safety and regulatory certification (UL, NSF, FCC, CE/UKCA, and food-contact requirements) so it supports international growth and stays off the critical path.

Team Leadership & Process
 
 

* Lead and grow a team of NPD, Systems, and Compliance engineers, including managers, aligned to one product roadmap.
* Recruit and develop engineering talent to build an organization that scales with Bevi's product strategy.
* Run a clear product development process, with phase gates and design reviews, that works for both in-house and partner-led programs.
* Champion the use of AI across the team to speed up design, analysis, testing, and documentation.

What We're Looking For
 
 

* 12+ years in hardware product development, including 5+ years leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams that include managers.
* Ability to be in the office 3+ days per week.
* Ability to travel up to 25%, including extended trips to overseas manufacturing partners.
* A track record of scaling electromechanical products into high-volume production (tens of thousands of units or more), ideally in consumer electronics, appliances, or connected devices.
* Hands-on experience partnering with ODMs and overseas contract manufacturers (Asia strongly preferred), from spec through design iterations, NPI, tooling, and yield ramp, including time on the ground with them.
* Strong design-for-cost and DFM/DFA skills, with a record of driving down BOM and landed cost at volume.
* Knowledge of high-volume manufacturing processes such as injection molding, sheet metal, die casting, and automated assembly.
* Experience with systems engineering practices and bringing products through safety and regulatory certification.
* A practical, hands-on approach to using AI tools in engineering work.
* A strong communicator who is credible in a design review, on a factory floor, and in a leadership meeting.
* BS in Mechanical Engineering or a related field. Experience with fluid, thermal, or food and beverage systems is a plus.

At Bevi, We Believe Compensation Is a Powerful Tool To Attract, Retain, And Grow Talent. Our Compensation Philosophy Centers On 5 Principles
 
 

* Market-driven - We anchor pay decisions in real-time market data
* Performance-based - We reward individual impact, not just tenure
* Equitable - We ensure fairness across teams, roles, and demographics
* Growth-focused - We invest in talent that scales with Bevi
* Total Rewards approach - We strategically balance base pay, bonuses, benefits, and equity

The posted compensation range reflects the salary\* for this position. Some roles may be eligible for a commission plan or a bonus incentive. All Bevi employees receive equity in the form of stock options. All full-time employees are invited to participate in our Total Rewards plan, which includes health & medical benefits, flexible spending accounts, flexible PTO, and more. Offers to join Bevi are based on a few criteria, including the scope of the role, the candidate's work experience, targeted skills, internal equity of the team, and external market data.
 
 

* For Sales roles: The posted range reflects base salary plus commission which is the total potential on target earnings (OTE) for the position.

Pay Range
 
 
$195,840—$230,400 USD
 
 
**Benefits**

* Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance plans with BlueCross BlueShield, 95% paid by employer
* 401(k) with company match
* Flexible PTO plus 12 company holidays, and additional paid days for sick leave, etc
* Generous fully paid parental leave for both birth parents and non-birth parents
* Fully employer paid disability and life insurances
* Wellness and fitness reimbursements
* Monthly stipends for cell phone use and commuting costs
* Onsite snacks, weekly catered lunch, and (of course) unlimited Bevi ... plus composting and terra-cycling, too
* Happy hours, team-building events, bagel breakfasts, Values awards - and more.

**A note on AI in our hiring process**
: We use AI to help synthesize interview notes and surface themes from feedback, keeping our process consistent as we grow. Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and interviews may be recorded to support note-taking, just let us know if you'd prefer we don't. We'll also ask how you're learning and experimenting with AI in your work. Growing our AI fluency is something every Bevi team member is committed to and invested in.
 
 
Our commitment to responsible innovation is reflected in our partnership with the Mass AI Coalition, a collaboration that aligns with our dedication to community-driven progress and the future of technology.
 
 
*We're passionate about supporting career growth and would love to be part of your professional journey. We also know that talent comes in many forms. We value individual accomplishments, specialized knowledge, and genuine passion over simply checking boxes on a requirements list. Whether you're a seasoned expert or an emerging talent, we're looking for people who are ready to build what's next. If any of our open positions interest you, we'd encourage you to apply!*
*A member of the Bevi Talent team 'recruiting@bevi.co' will be reaching out about next steps if we would like to move forward.*
**Accommodations**
Bevi is committed to an inclusive hiring process and we aim to provide accommodations for persons with disabilities. If you need any accommodations for the application or throughout the interview process please contact recruiting@bevi.co.

new_roles.description:
**Job Description**
Be part of the global Integrated Supply Chain (ISC) Engineering leadership team driving factory improvements, product improvements for producibility and cost savings, manufacturing technology implementation, and new product development for Honeywell Aerospace.
 
 
We are hiring a Sr Director to lead the global ISC Advanced Manufacturing Engineering (AME) team for New Product Introduction (NPI) supporting programs across the Aerospace portfolio.
 
 
In this role, you will leverage your extensive product development experience and leadership skills. You will drive continuous improvement to develop new products, processes, and standards in support of the organization's business strategies with a direct impact on development program success. You will develop strategy, hold teams accountable and deliver high impact business results.
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Deliver NPI program objectives including product producibility, design-to-cost (DTC) targets, production readiness, and customer quality.
* Operate as a change agent to embed producibility into our core design processes.
* Build Employee Engagement and Skills through the development of standard work, clear roles and responsibilities, and effective training programs.
* Design and develop Management Operating Systems to ensure effective team operations, driving results to program and department objectives.
* Work closely with the SBU engineering team, Program Management, and ISC leaders to build cross-organizational alignment

**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as the sciences, technology, engineering or mathematics
* 8 years of experience in New Product Development
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes
* Experience working with suppliers on technical issues
* Track record of managing multiple projects with demonstrated results on a macro scale
* Experience leading a team with direct line reporting responsibility
* Abitlity to travel 30%

**Us Person Requirements**
Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. Person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status or have the ability to obtain an export authorization.
 
 
**WE VALUE**

* Advanced degree in engineering or business
* Exceptional data analysis and communication skills
* Willingness to raise standards each year to drive organizational excellence
* Ability to make sound and timely judgments in ambiguous environment
* Ability to convey subtle or complex messages clearly, as appropriate for the topic and audience.
* Diverse and global teaming and collaboration
* Balance between demand and capacity when establishing priorities for the organization.

**For Mn Candidates**
The annual base salary range for this position is $238,000-$297,000. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations.
 
 
This position is incentive eligible.
 
 
**Benefits**
Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:
 
 

* Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability coverage
* 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
* Employee assistance program and educational assistance
* Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
* Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time

Explore your benefits: https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/
 
 
**POSTING TIMELINE**
The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.
 
 
Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At
**Honeywell Aerospace**
(NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.
 
 
Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.
 
 
Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.
 
 
Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.
 
 
Honeywell Aerospace Products And Services Are Found On Aircraft Across Commercial Aviation, Defense And Space. We Operate Through Three Business Areas
 
 
Electronic Solutions develops the avionics, navigation systems, sensors and electromagnetic defense technology on board 90% of the world's aircraft
 
 
Engines & Power Systems provides the propulsion, auxiliary power and electrical systems that keep those aircraft flying
 
 
Control Systems supplies the thermal and motion control systems that support takeoff, landing and the safety of everyone on board
 
 
With approximately 58,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, we are also advancing systems for autonomous and supersonic platforms — bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com
 
 
Join Honeywell Aerospace! Our aerospace innovations bring people together, make the world safer and more secure, and help humankind reach for the stars. Now we’re shaping aviation’s future with sustainable aviation fuels, smarter cockpits, ultra-efficient engines, smart airports, flying taxis and much more.

new_roles.title: Director of Product Development & Industrialization
new_roles.description:
At Horizon Hobby, we inspire dreams and help build memories! Our company is the leader in the global Radio Control industry, celebrating 40 years in 2025! We offer tremendous opportunities for growth and development and a full array of benefits including discounts on our products! We are currently hiring for a Director of Product Development and Industrialization at our Pro-Line office in Banning CA!
 
 
*This is a full time, on-site position at our Pro-Line facility in Banning California. Workings hours will be Monday-Friday 8am-5pm PST.*
**Typical pay for this position is $105,000-$125,000. The final offer for this position will be based on the unique experience and qualifications of the candidate selected. This position may also be eligible for a bonus not included in the base pay range.**
The Director of Product Development & Industrialization will provide strategic leadership for the development, commercialization, and industrialization of proprietary hobby products from concept through production. This role will be leading our Product Development, Product Engineering, and Industrialization resources while overseeing the systems, processes, tooling, molds, manufacturing equipment, and technical capabilities required to deliver innovative, high-quality products to market.
 
 
This role will partner closely with Brand, Sales, Marketing, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, Tooling, and external partners to identify market opportunities, translate customer needs into successful products, and ensure products are designed, developed, and launched efficiently. The role balances technical excellence with business performance, ensuring product investments align with growth objectives, customer demand, profitability targets, and long-term strategic priorities.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
Product Innovation & Strategy
 
 

* Partner with Brand and cross-functional teams to define product roadmaps, priorities, resources, and timelines.
* Drive innovation and development investments that strengthen market position, customer satisfaction, growth, and return on investment.
* Identify and prioritize new product opportunities using customer insight, competitive analysis, market trends, and commercial potential.

Product Development Leadership
 
 

* Lead and develop Product Development, Product Engineering, and Industrialization teams supporting proprietary products.
* Own product development from concept and engineering through validation, launch, and lifecycle management.
* Strengthen quality, scalability, execution, and organizational capability through standards, coaching, succession planning, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Business & Commercial Leadership
 
 

* Monitor portfolio performance and align cross-functional priorities to achieve revenue, profitability, and strategic objectives.
* Contribute to portfolio planning, market expansion, long-range growth, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
* Provide senior leadership with business reviews, development updates, performance metrics, and recommendations.

Industrialization & Manufacturing Readiness
 
 

* Lead new-product industrialization from concept through launch, applying DFM and DFA to optimize quality, scalability, cost, and manufacturing readiness.
* Partner across Engineering, Manufacturing, Tool Room, suppliers, and development teams to resolve challenges and improve processes, tooling, and capacity.
* Track launch, readiness, quality, and productivity performance to drive continuous improvement.

Tooling, Equipment & Technology
 
 

* Define requirements and roadmaps for molds, tooling, fixtures, machinery, automation, and manufacturing technology.
* Lead capital planning and business cases that improve capability, productivity, quality, cost, and return on investment.
* Manage external tooling and manufacturing partners, strengthen internal capabilities, and maintain effective engineering data and technical documentation processes.

Supplier & Partner Management
 
 

* Build strategic relationships with domestic and international manufacturing, tooling, engineering, and supplier partners.
* Evaluate supplier capabilities and performance to improve quality, speed, cost competitiveness, and alignment with business objectives.

*Success in this role requires strong leadership across innovation, engineering, manufacturing, and business functions to continuously improve speed to market, product quality, operational performance, and return on investment*
**Required**
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Product Development, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in product management, category management, business management, product development, or a related leadership role.
* 5+ years of experience leading and developing teams.
* Demonstrated success growing a product category, business unit, or consumer product portfolio.
* Experience developing and launching successful products from concept through commercialization.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets, forecasting, business cases, and profitability.
* Proven ability to develop business strategies and translate them into measurable results.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
* Ability to travel as required for customer visits, product testing, trade shows, industry events, and supplier meetings.

**Preferred**

* Experience in the RC, hobby products, powersports, automotive aftermarket, consumer products, or related industries.
* Experience working directly with enthusiast communities, racers, influencers, or brand ambassadors.
* Familiarity with manufacturing processes, new product introduction, and global sourcing environments.
* Experience using product lifecycle management (PLM) and project management systems.

**Physical Requirements**

* Occasional lifting of office supplies and materials, up to 20 pounds.
* Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while working on a computer.

*The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.*
**Benefits & Other Perks**

* Medical, Dental, Vision
* HSA and FSA options
* Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Life Insurance and Supplemental Life Insurance
* 401(k) with a company match
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays
* Internal Rewards
* Discounts on Products
* Additional Coverage such as accident, critical, hospital and pet insurance

*Horizon Hobby is a progressive, innovative company and, as such, is constantly reevaluating and reinventing the processes and procedures associated with each job. The essential duties and responsibilities of this position may change at any time. In addition, employees may be asked to work on special projects or to assist with other work necessary or important to the operation of Horizon. Your cooperation and assistance in performing such additional work is expected and appreciated.*
**Horizon Hobby, LLC is an equal opportunity and E-Verify employer**

*As Lubrizol approaches its centennial in 2028, our Wickliffe campus will become the unified home of Lubrizol’s*
*global headquarters, integrating Lubrizol’s Brecksville site capabilities and employees to the Wickliffe campus.*
**Job Type:**
Hybrid. 4 days on-site
 
 
**Travel Expectancy:**
20 - 40%
 
 
**Salary Range:**
$160,000.00 - $220,000.00 + Bonus
 
 
**Shape the Future with Us.**
At Lubrizol, we’re bringing to life the chemistry behind clean water, efficient transportation, reliable infrastructure, critical medicines, and the products people rely on every day through science, sustainability, and a culture of inclusion.
 
 
As part of our global team, you’ll be empowered to make a real impact - on your career, your community, and the world around you.
 
 
****How You’ll Make An Impact****
The Global Leader, New Product Development – Medical Devices is a senior technical and people leader responsible for medical device new product development, from concept through commercialization. This role owns NPD strategy, talent development, governance, and execution across multiple geographies and development centers, ensuring strong alignment with customer needs, regulatory requirements, and business strategy.
 
 
The role leads a global, multidisciplinary NPD organization, partners closely with Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Commercial, and Executive Leadership, and acts as a senior technical representative to key medical device OEM customers.
 
 
****Required Qualifications That Enable Your Success****

* Define and execute the global medical device NPD strategy aligned with business growth priorities, customer roadmaps, and portfolio strategy.
* Identify and pursue adjacent medical device applications where our technologies and platforms can create differentiated value and drive organic growth.
* Lead capability road mapping to define and build the new technical, testing, and development capabilities the group must invest in to sustain growth and capture high value programs.
* Establish scalable development governance, stage-gate rigor, and portfolio prioritization to ensure consistent execution excellence.
* Oversee complex, multi-site development programs from concept through commercialization, ensuring delivery to cost, schedule, performance, and quality expectations.
* Partner with Quality and Regulatory to ensure compliance with FDA, CE/MDR, ISO 13485, and applicable global regulatory requirements.
* Serve as senior technical interface with strategic OEM customers, supporting complex development engagements and long-term partnerships.
* Collaborate with Commercial, Marketing, and Business Development to shape development proposals, technology roadmaps, and differentiated customer solutions.
* Champion design-for-manufacturability, design-for-quality, and design-for-cost principles across global manufacturing platforms.
* Ensure effective transfer of products from NPD to Manufacturing, preserving design intent, robustness, and scalability during launch and ramp-up.
* Lead and develop a global organization of NPD engineers, scientists, and program leaders across multiple regions and sites.
* Build technical bench strength through hiring, development, coaching, and succession planning.

****Required Qualifications That Enable Your Success****

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Biomedical, Chemical Engineering, or related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* 10 or more years of progressive experience in medical device product development in a regulated environment., including experience in thermoplastic precision extrusion and silicone processing.
* Demonstrated experience leading global or multi-site technical teams.
* Strong working knowledge of FDA design controls, ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 820, and CE/MDR requirements.
* Proven track record delivering complex development programs from concept through commercialization and manufacturing transfer.

****Preferred Qualifications That Drive You Forward****

* Advanced technical degree (MS or PhD).
* Experience with catheter-based or minimally invasive medical device technologies.
* Strong understanding of polymer-based medical devices and associated manufacturing processes.
* Formal training or certification in program or portfolio management.
* Experience operating effectively within matrixed global organizations.

****Benefits That Empower You****

* Competitive salary with performance-based bonus plans
* 401(k) match + Age-Weighted Defined Contribution
* Comprehensive medical, dental & vision coverage
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Paid holidays, vacation, and parental leave
* Flexible work environment
* Learning and development opportunities
* Career and professional growth
* Inclusive culture and vibrant community engagement Learn more at benefits.lubrizol.com!

**Lubrizol: Imagined for Life. Enabled by Science. ™ Delivered by You.**
For nearly 100 years, The Lubrizol Corporation, a Berkshire Hathaway company, has been at the forefront of innovation to enhance everyday life, advance mobility, and make the modern world work better. Our specialty chemistry solutions—from engine oils, performance coatings, and skincare to medical devices and plumbing systems —are powered by the expertise, passion, and commitment of people like you. We tackle the world’s toughest challenges with science-based solutions, deeply understanding our customers to deliver innovative chemistry and differentiated value.
 
 
Our inclusive culture, dedication to safety, and incredible global talent drive our success. Our solutions meet the evolving needs of the modern world—brought to life by science and, most importantly, delivered by you. Whether you're in the lab, on the production floor, or in the office, you'll be part of a team around the world that empowers you to think boldly, drive results, and contribute to solutions that shape a better, more sustainable future.
 
 
**We win because of you. Let’s build the future together.**

new_roles.description:
**Application Close Date**
Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.
 
 
At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!
 
 
This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.
 
 
We are a team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly committed to a culture of safety. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and require your commitment and detailed attention toward safe and repeatable space flight. Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin's vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth.
 
 
We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!
 
 
Blue Origin is scaling production of its electric propulsion systems. We are hiring a Director to own the manufacturing outcome for that product line and to carry it from development hardware into rate production.
 
 
You will be the single-threaded leader for Operations of this program: one person accountable for rate, quality, cost, and people, with full authority over the entire in-program production flow.
 
 
This is a build-it role, not a run-it role. You will define the value streams, stand up integration with support organizations, and build the team that runs the line — working concurrently with an active design program rather than behind a frozen one.
 
 
**Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To**

* Own the strategy, roadmap, and priorities for successful manufacturing outcomes of the electric propulsion thruster line — delivery rate, quality, cost, and the people who produce it.
* Build the production organization. Define the value streams, stand up production control and manufacturing engineering, and hire and develop the leadership beneath you as the program scales.
* Own the get-to-rate plan. Define the path from development build to sustained rate production, and demonstrate cycle time at the rate-readiness gate as a committed acceptance number rather than a projection.
* Lead the transition from development build into rate production, including the qualification of tooling, processes, and work instructions required to produce repeatably at rate.
* Drive producibility into the product during design, rather than absorbing it on the floor later. Own the manufacturing view of the bill of materials as the product configuration evolves.
* Establish and own the program's working interfaces with quality, supply chain, material planning, and test operations.
* Build and manage the program's manufacturing operating budget and capital plan, owning responsibility for product delivery at cost and rate.
* Set the safety and quality culture for a new production team, and hold it as the organization grows.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in an engineering or technical discipline.
* 12+ years of experience in manufacturing, production, supply chain, or operations, including 5+ years leading manufacturing organizations.
* Direct, hands-on experience taking a new product or production line from development into rate production.
* Experience carrying a product through a production-readiness or rate-readiness gate, and owning the cycle-time and capability evidence presented at it.
* Experience building an organization — defining structure, hiring leaders, and developing a team through significant growth.
* Line management of both salaried professionals and craft or technician populations.
* Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguity: making defensible assumptions and moving forward on an incomplete definition, then correcting as information arrives.
* Ability to travel frequently, up to approximately 35%, to other Blue Origin sites.
* Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 15+ years of manufacturing and operations experience.
* Propulsion, spacecraft, satellite, or other high-reliability low-volume hardware experience.
* Experience transitioning a product from low-volume, high-mix build into repeatable rate production.
* Demonstrated cycle-time or throughput improvement with measured results.
* Experience standing up production at a new or greenfield manufacturing site.
* Experience managing a build against a bill of materials that changed materially during production ramp.
* Formal lean or continuous-improvement training, with applied results on a production line.
* Master’s degree in engineering or technical field, or MBA.

**Base Pay Range For**
WA applicants is $203,165.00 - $284,430.30
 
 
**Other Site Ranges May Differ**
**Culture Statement**
Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
 
 
**Export Control Regulations**
Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.
 
 
**Background Check**

* Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
* Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

**Benefits**

* Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
* Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
* Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
* Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws. For more information on “Know Your Rights,” please see here.
 
 
**Affirmative Action and Disability Accommodation**
Applicants wishing to receive information on Blue Origin’s Affirmative Action Plans, or applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation in order to participate in the application and/or interview process, please contact us at EEOCompliance@blueorigin.com. Please note this is a publicly managed inbox. Please do not include any personal medical information in your request.

new_roles.title: Director, Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
**Job Description**
The Director, Continuous Improvement leads the Supply Chain-wide capability for identifying, prioritizing, enabling, and sustaining improvements that increase business performance and organizational effectiveness across functions and end-to-end processes. This role establishes a culture of continuous improvement, advances operational and business process excellence, and enables measurable improvements in productivity, cost, quality, service, and capacity.
 
 
Working closely with cross-functional Supply Chain leaders, this position standardizes processes, uses data and insights to prioritize opportunities, and implements sustainable solutions aligned with strategic objectives. The Director maintains a strong connection to frontline operations by working directly in Supply Chain Centers and other functional environments to understand processes firsthand and translate observations into meaningful improvements.
 
 
**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive Continuous Improvement strategy and multi-year roadmap aligned with Supply Chain priorities, and advise Supply Chain leadership on opportunities that improve productivity, efficiency, cost, service, quality, capacity, and organizational effectiveness.
* Lead the deployment of consistent Continuous Improvement methodologies, tools, governance, performance expectations, and resource prioritization across Supply Chain functions.
* Work directly with Supply Chain Centers and functional teams to observe work at the point of execution, identify process variation and non-value-added activities, and implement standardized processes, operating practices, management systems, standard work, and process controls.
* Lead cross-functional transformation and productivity initiatives, including process redesign, technology-enabled improvement, automation, and new ways of working, in partnership with functional leaders, the PMO, Finance, and other stakeholders.
* Establish measurable outcomes, baselines, KPI definitions, reporting standards, dashboards, and processes for tracking, validating, and sustaining financial benefits, productivity improvements, and business value.
* Build organizational Continuous Improvement capability through training, coaching, structured problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and the development of CI team members and functional leaders.
* Lead change management and cross-functional alignment, manage risks and barriers, strengthen process integration, and communicate priorities, progress, results, and recommendations to Supply Chain leadership and key stakeholders.

**What You’ll Bring**
In addition to the technical and functional requirements of this role, successful candidates demonstrate Domino's Hungry for MORE Ways of Working:
 
 
Be Curious
 
 

* Seeks clarity, asks thoughtful questions, and uncovers root causes to solve problems effectively.
* Actively pursues learning opportunities, applies feedback, and continuously develops new skills.

Connect the Dots
 
 

* Uses information and insights to identify opportunities and drive informed decisions.
* Builds strong partnerships across teams and considers the broader organizational impact of decisions.

Aim High
 
 

* Sets ambitious goals, challenges the status quo, and focuses on work that drives meaningful business results.
* Uses feedback and data to continuously improve performance and outcomes.

Shift Fast
 
 

* Adapts quickly to changing priorities and business needs while maintaining focus on results.
* Demonstrates resilience, sound judgment, and the ability to learn from setbacks.

Deliver More
 
 

* Takes ownership, executes with discipline, and consistently produces measurable results.
* Identifies opportunities to create additional value for customers, team members, and the business.

Leadership Expectations
 
 

* Builds and develops high-performing teams aligned to Domino’s Ways of Working.
* Creates accountability, fosters collaboration, and delivers results through others.
* Leads confidently through change while maintaining team engagement and performance.
* Demonstrates enterprise thinking and drives cross-functional alignment to achieve business goals.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing, or a related discipline; an advanced degree or MBA is preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Continuous Improvement, Supply Chain, business transformation, operational excellence, or related disciplines, including demonstrated leadership experience in complex, cross-functional organizations.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing Continuous Improvement strategies and delivering measurable business results across multiple functions or complex organizations.
* Strong knowledge and practical application of Lean Six Sigma, structured problem-solving, process optimization, standardization, and change management methodologies.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional improvement initiatives, influence stakeholders, and drive organizational change without direct authority.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience leading Continuous Improvement initiatives in manufacturing, distribution, logistics, or other complex operational environments, including the ability to engage frontline employees, site leaders, and senior executives to diagnose issues, implement solutions, and deliver measurable results.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including experience identifying, quantifying, and validating productivity improvements, cost savings, and business value.
* Well-developed team building and influencing skills, unquestioned integrity, and the experience and confidence to work effectively across multiple functions and levels of the organization.
* Experience developing performance management frameworks, leveraging data analytics, and translating insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to build organizational capability through coaching, talent development, and deployment of Continuous Improvement methodologies.
* Strong strategic thinking, communication, collaboration, and executive presentation skills.
* Experience managing complex improvement portfolios, prioritizing competing business needs, and delivering sustainable outcomes.
* Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent demonstrated Continuous Improvement expertise is preferred.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally, including Canada, as business needs require. Expected travel is up to 50%

Additional Information
 
 
Benefits:
 
 

* Paid Holidays and Vacation
* Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment
* No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents
* Childcare tuition discounts
* No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs
* Fertility benefits
* Adoption assistance
* 401k matching contributions
* 15% off the purchase price of stock
* Company bonus

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

new_roles.title: Supply Chain Director of Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
1.0 FTE Full time Day - 08 Hour R2655441 Hybrid 108400006 SC Administration Business & Administration PALO ALTO, 1840 Embarcadero, California
 
 
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.
 
 
Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)
 
 
**This is a Stanford Health Care job.**
**A Brief Overview**
The Director of Supply Chain Operational Excellence is a senior leadership role driving enterprise‑wide efficiency, innovation, and transformation across a Gartner top‑2 ranked healthcare supply chain. With system‑wide influence and a seat at the leadership table, this role partners closely with the Chief Supply Chain Officer and Vice President of Strategic Initiatives to turn strategy into measurable results. The ideal candidate combines healthcare supply chain expertise with strong program management skills and a passion for developing people, leading change, and delivering measurable, enterprise‑wide impact.
 
 
**Locations**
Stanford Health Care
 
 
**What You Will Do**

* Maintain continuous alignment with defined organizational and departmental strategic business objectives in conjunction with leadership.
* Direct and ensure the efficient operation of day-to-day activities of the team and ensure competency of all staff.
* Supports and partners on Change Management, Training and Communications activities as needed for effective performance improvement and project management.
* Act in an advisory capacity to all Supply Chain divisions, programs, staff and leaders.
* Provide expertise, guidance and training on Performance Improvement and Project Management best practices.
* Apply LEAN/Six Sigma principles and methods to identify waste reduction and performance optimization opportunities across Supply Chain operations.
* Implement, oversee and continuously improve Supply Chain systems, processes and standard work to drive the efficient management of operations across Logistics, Sourcing, Procurement, Business Office, Resiliency, Sustainability, Data Management and other functions.
* Build, develop and grow business relationships with Supply Chain’s key stakeholders and partners including but not limited to the Interventional Platform, A/P, Pharmacy, and IT.
* Lead cross-departmental initiatives, establishing strong governance, communication, and accountability to deliver progress measurable through mutually agreed KPIs.
* Align and collaborate with the enterprise Performance Improvement team and Stanford Operating System (SOS).
* Lead the implementation of programs and/or projects as assigned by the Administrative Director.

**Education Qualifications**

* Requires a Bachelor’s degree in a work-related discipline/field from an accredited college or university.
* Relevant experience in lieu of degree may be considered. Relevant experience in lieu of degree is in addition to the experience requirements for this position.

**Experience Qualifications**

* Seven (7) years of progressively responsible and directly related work experience.

**Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Must have strong leadership and interpersonal skills and be effective at people management including the ability to delegate assignments and share decision-making with team members and direct reports as appropriate.
* Excellent communication skills including the ability to present, and to write in a clear and understandable manner.
* Ability to understand complex verbal or written instructions and translate to action to deliver quantitative and qualitative results.
* Must be well organized and systematic, and able to design, implement and maintain standard work processes.
* Knowledge of project management methodologies to lead complex project teams and large scope projects, including managing resources (people, costs, time).
* Familiar with and able to apply Lean Six Sigma concepts and techniques including value stream mapping, kaizen, Five Whys, VoC, RCA etc. for structured process improvement.
* Demonstrated expertise in leading change management initiatives within Agile delivery environments.
* Ability to multi-task and handle multiple priorities while managing aggressive deadlines. Knowledge of Supply Chain functions, practices, and operational challenges.
* Understanding of healthcare and clinical concepts.

**Licenses and Certifications**

* Lean Six Sigma Certification preferred .
* PMP - Project Mgmt Professional preferred .
* CMRP (Certified Materials & Resource Professionals) preferred.

**Physical Demands and Work Conditions**
**Blood Borne Pathogens**

* Category II - Tasks that involve NO exposure to blood, body fluids or tissues, but employment may require performing unplanned Category I tasks

**These Principles Apply To ALL Employees**
**SHC Commitment to Providing an Exceptional Patient & Family Experience**
*Stanford Health Care sets a high standard for delivering value and an exceptional experience for our patients and families. Candidates for employment and existing employees must adopt and execute C-I-CARE standards for all of patients, families and towards each other. C-I-CARE is the foundation of Stanford’s patient-experience and represents a framework for patient-centered interactions. Simply put, we do what it takes to enable and empower patients and families to focus on health, healing and recovery.
 
 
You will do this by executing against our three experience pillars, from the patient and family’s perspective:*

* Know Me: Anticipate my needs and status to deliver effective care
* Show Me the Way: Guide and prompt my actions to arrive at better outcomes and better health
* Coordinate for Me: Own the complexity of my care through coordination

**Equal Opportunity Employer Stanford Health Care (SHC) strongly values diversity and is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination in**
**all of**
**its policies and practices, including the area of employment. Accordingly, SHC does not discriminate against any person on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation or gender identity and/or expression, religion, age, national or ethnic origin, political beliefs, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, veteran status, or disability, or the perception of any of the above. People of all genders, members of all racial and ethnic groups, people with disabilities, and veterans are encouraged to apply. Qualified applicants with criminal convictions will be considered after an individualized assessment of the conviction and the job requirements.**
Base Pay Scale: Generally starting at $81.59 - $108.12 per hour
 
 
The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, specialty and training. This pay scale is not a promise of a particular wage.

**Job Description**
**About the role**
As the Director of Continuous Improvement, you’ll be the senior strategic leader driving operational excellence, transformation, and sustainable performance improvement across the enterprise. You’ll own the development, deployment, and governance of TERREPOWER’s global continuous improvement (CI) strategy — aligning it with business objectives and building a culture of innovation, accountability, and measurable results. It’s a high-impact role for a visionary change agent with deep Lean and Six Sigma expertise who can influence at every level and deliver real impact across diverse regions and functions.
 
 
**What You’ll Do**

* Strategic leadership — Define and execute a global CI strategy aligned with corporate goals, partner with executive leadership to identify high-value transformation opportunities, and establish enterprise-wide CI governance, frameworks, and performance standards.
* Operational excellence — Lead global CI initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, and other methodologies, standardize processes and best practices across regions, and drive measurable improvements in cost, quality, delivery, safety, and customer satisfaction.
* Change management & culture — Champion a culture of continuous improvement and data-driven decision-making, and build organizational capability through training, coaching, and certification programs.
* Performance management — Develop KPIs, dashboards, and reporting to track CI progress and ROI, run regular reviews with regional and functional leaders, and benchmark best practices to maintain competitive advantage.
* Team leadership — Develop regional CI teams and leaders, foster collaboration across geographies and business units, and drive talent development and succession planning.

**What You’ll Bring**
**Must-haves**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, Operations, or a related field.
* 10+ years in continuous improvement, operational excellence, or transformation leadership, with proven success leading global or multi-site CI programs.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt certification.
* Strong analytical, strategic-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder-influencing abilities across all levels of an organization.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Master’s degree (MBA or related discipline).
* Experience in sustainable manufacturing, supply chain, and/or complex global operations.
* Expertise in digital transformation, automation, or advanced analytics.
* Track record of delivering significant financial and operational impact.

**What We Offer**

* Compensation — Competitive base salary plus annual performance bonus.
* Health & wellness — Medical, dental, and vision coverage.
* Retirement — 401(k) with company match.
* Time off — Paid time off, holidays, and parental leave.

new_roles.title: Director, Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Job Description**
**Company Overview**
Vertex is a global biotechnology company focused on investing in scientific innovation to create transformative medicines for people with serious diseases. Across our organization, we work with urgency, rigor, and collaboration to deliver therapies that improve patient outcomes and create long-term value.
 
 
**General Summary**
The Operational Excellence team serves as the process improvement and performance enablement backbone of CMTO, providing the improvement discipline, management systems, and change capabilities required to run, grow, and optimize Vertex’s commercial manufacturing network.
 
 
The Director, Operational Excellence leads the development and execution of CMTO’s Operational Excellence strategy and improvement portfolio. The role identifies and prioritizes performance improvement opportunities, leads structured problem-solving and transformation initiatives, and ensures improvements are implemented and sustained through effective change management, standard work, performance monitoring, and leadership accountability.
 
 
The Director also leads and develops the Operational Excellence team, building organizational capability, setting priorities, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability. The role partners closely with Business Analytics, Network Performance, Manufacturing Operations, MS&T, Business Operations Leads, Quality, Supply Chain, and Finance to use performance insights to identify improvement priorities and deliver measurable business outcomes.
 
 
**Key Duties And Responsibilities**

* Operational Excellence Strategy & Initiative Execution
* Contribute to setting CMTO's operational excellence strategy, priorities, and success measures, aligned to enterprise and functional priorities
* Identify, prioritize, and drive execution of a portfolio of commercial manufacturing improvement and transformation initiatives — partnering with sites and functions while avoiding ownership of routine operations
* Lead initiatives targeting lead-time reduction, launch optimization, yield, and manufacturing success-rate improvements and COGM reduction through structured problem definition, root-cause analysis, options analysis, and ROI calculation
* Lead Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, and structured problem-solving initiatives across technical and business processes
* Develop clear business cases, recommendations, and implementation plans for Operational Excellence initiatives, including expected benefits, resource requirements, risks, and measures of success.
* Manage and Lead the Operational Excellence Team
* Establish and communicate a clear vision, mission, and strategic direction for the Operational Excellence team, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and stakeholder expectations
* Partner with senior leadership to define team priorities, continuously reassessing and adjusting focus based on evolving business needs, operational risks, and strategic objectives
* Set clear performance expectations, goals, and development plans for team members; monitor progress, provide timely feedback, and hold the team accountable for results
* Remove organizational barriers and resolve escalated issues that impede team performance or delivery of key initiatives
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, innovation, and accountability by coaching and mentoring team members in problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills
* Build organizational capability by identifying skill gaps, developing talent, and implementing training and succession plans that strengthen Operational Excellence competencies
* Communicate team objectives, progress, achievements, risks, and resource needs to senior leadership and key stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment across organization
* Promote cross-functional collaboration and strong stakeholder relationships to enable successful execution of Operational Excellence initiatives and sustainable business improvements
* Continuous Improvement & Change Execution
* Embed structured problem-solving, continuous improvement, and change execution into CMTO governance and operating rhythms, using performance insights provided by Business Analytics, Network Performance, and functional teams.
* Ensure improvements are implemented and sustained through effective change management, standard work, control plans, performance monitoring, and clear process ownership.
* Identify and deploy digital tools, automation, and process solutions that improve operational performance and the scalability of Operational Excellence practices.
* Community of Practice & Capability Building
* Operate as a community-of-practice leader for manufacturing operational excellence across internal manufacturing and supply chain, driving common standards, methods, and ways of working
* Mentor teams on Lean methods, structured problem-solving, and continuous improvement practices, and benchmark industry best practices to inform innovative approaches

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Strong leadership, communication, collaboration, and team building
* Proven ability to motivate teams and build team unity
* Demonstrated success implementing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, FMEA, Hoshin Kanri, and Change Management methodologies in GMP environments
* Proven experience leading improvement initiatives targeting lead-time reduction, launch optimization, yield improvement and COGM/COGs reduction
* Experience using operational data and performance insights to identify, prioritize, and measure improvement opportunities.
* Hands-on proficiency in data analysis, root-cause analysis, process analysis, and structured problem-solving
* Ability to quantify the operational and financial benefits of improvement initiatives and communicate clear recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Experience implementing and sustaining performance management systems, visual management, Standard Work, and Leader Standard Work.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; experience with process mapping, statistical analysis, and Lean Six Sigma tools preferred.
* Ability to translate complex operational problems into clear improvement priorities, recommendations, and implementation plans.
* Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed environment with strong role clarity, partnering across Network Performance, Business Operations, Manufacturing Operations, MS&T, Finance, and Strategic Sourcing

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Life Sciences, Business, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
* Typically requires 8–12 years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, regulated manufacturing, supply chain, MS&T, Operational Excellence, or business transformation environments.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading Operational Excellence, transformation, continuous improvement, or complex process-improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt required

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.
 
 
**Pay Range**
$181,900 - $272,900
 
 
**Disclosure Statement**
The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.
 
 
At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.
 
 
**Flex Designation**
Hybrid-Eligible Or On-Site Eligible
 
 
**Flex Eligibility Status**
In this Hybrid-Eligible role, you can choose to be designated as:
 
 

* Hybrid: work remotely up to two days per week; or select
* On-Site: work five days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility.

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.
 
 
**Company Information**
Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation.
 
 
Vertex is committed to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Vertex is an E-Verify Employer in the United States. Vertex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.
 
 
Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should make a request to the recruiter or hiring manager, or contact Talent Acquisition at ApplicationAssistance@vrtx.com

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**Director of Operations – Beauty & Cosmetics Manufacturing**

**Lead. Innovate. Transform.**

**Location:**
Azusa, CA | On-Site

**Salary Range:**
$130,000 – $160,000 annually, depending on experience (DOE)

**Reports Directly to the CEO**

**Ready to Lead the Next Chapter of Manufacturing Excellence?**

At Westwood Laboratories, we're building the future of our operations, and we're looking for a
**driven, hands-on Director of Operations**
to help lead the transformation.

As an established FDA-registered contract manufacturer specializing in beauty, cosmetics, personal care, and OTC products, we're focused on strengthening operational excellence, embracing technology, and building scalable processes for continued growth.

**We're not looking for someone to simply manage operations. We want someone who can elevate them.**

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment, takes ownership, and knows how to turn challenges into results.

**What You'll Lead**

* **Operational Excellence:**
 Oversee Production, Compounding, Warehouse, and Facilities, driving efficiency, quality, productivity, and cost improvements.
* **Quality & Compliance:**
 Champion a quality-first culture, ensuring manufacturing operations consistently meet cGMP, FDA, safety, and customer requirements. Partner closely with Quality and Regulatory teams to strengthen compliance, process controls, and right-first-time execution.
* **KPIs & Accountability:**
 Establish meaningful performance metrics, dashboards, and systems that drive measurable results.
* **Digital Transformation:**
 Lead the transition from paper-based processes toward automation, improved ERP utilization, and data-driven operations.
* **People Leadership:**
 Develop high-performing teams, strengthen accountability, and create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
* **Strategic Execution:**
 Partner directly with the CEO to translate business priorities into action, lead cross-functional projects, and deliver results.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
 Implement Lean manufacturing practices, reduce downtime and waste, and optimize production performance.

**What You Bring**

* **Direct manufacturing experience in beauty, cosmetics, or personal care is essential.**
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing experience with strong operations leadership.
* Proven success implementing KPIs, improving processes, and driving measurable operational improvements.
* Experience with ERP systems, manufacturing automation, and organizational transformation.
* **Strong experience operating in FDA-regulated, cGMP manufacturing environments**
 , with a demonstrated understanding of quality systems, compliance, documentation, deviation management, CAPA, and process controls.
* Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing, cGMP, and FDA-regulated operations.
* A self-motivated, solutions-oriented leadership style with strong project management and execution skills.
* A hands-on, solutions-oriented leadership style with the confidence to make decisions, drive accountability, and collaborate directly with executive leadership

**Why Westwood?**

Because you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact.

We're a company with a strong foundation and an exciting opportunity ahead. You'll work directly with the CEO, influence operational strategy, develop teams, and help shape the next phase of our growth.

**If you're a builder, a problem-solver, and a leader who gets things done, we want to hear from you.**

**Apply today and help us take Westwood Laboratories to the next level.**

*Westwood Laboratories is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

new_roles.title: Director, Quality
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Director, Quality is responsible for leading multiple manufacturing/service sites and/or corporate quality resources in the execution of the overall STERIS Quality System. This position is principally responsible for manufacturing/service site or functional quality system execution to drive product/service quality improvement and ensure compliance with, as appropriate, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, MDSAP, FDA QMSR CFR Part 820/211, EU MDR, and other applicable standards. Supporting the GI Reprocessing business, this role provides quality leadership for products, processes, and services that help healthcare providers safely clean, disinfect, and reprocess gastrointestinal endoscopes and related equipment. The Director will champion a culture of quality, compliance, and continuous improvement, helping ensure the delivery of safe, effective, and reliable solutions that support infection prevention, patient safety, and customer confidence. The Quality Director will lead teams of quality managers and engineers responsible for product and service quality, supplier quality, new product/service support, continuous improvement initiatives, and quality system execution. This leader will partner closely with Operations, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, and Commercial teams to drive operational excellence, mitigate risk, support innovation, and enhance quality performance across the GI Reprocessing portfolio.

Preferred onsite location: Mentor, OH, with consideration for candidates based in Plymouth, MN or Conroe, TX.

**What You’ll do as a Director Quality**
----------------------------------------

* The Director, Quality will have responsibility for the following: Leads manufacturing/service sites and/or corporate quality staff in the execution and continuous improvement of the STERIS Quality System. Operates with a focus on the following objectives:
 + Ensures site level compliance to appropriate ISO, FDA, and other applicable regulatory standards.
 + Drives strategies and methods to continuously improve capital, consumable and service product quality performance.
 + Establishes clear and consistent quality measurement systems in order to monitor and drive results.
 + Leads quality planning and the execution of assigned New Product/Service Development (NPD) projects to achieve targeted quality deliverable adherence.
 + Drives targeted supplier quality improvement efforts and oversees supplier evaluation, approval, and control for assigned manufacturing sites.
 + Assists in the continuous improvement and standardization of quality system procedures and monitor effectiveness.
 + Supports the reliability function by integrating design for reliability tools and techniques within the local projects.
 + Leads quality planning efforts through cross-functional teaming at a site level.
* Supports the New Product/Service Development process and projects to ensure projects attain cost, quality, and delivery objectives.
* Directs local staff on planning sequential and concurrent quality activities. Establish planning and monitoring tools and techniques.
* Provides Quality viewpoints and opinions in planning and specifying existing and future products.
* Assists in the development of the Quality budget. Helps to ensures resources are adequate to fully support the Quality System.
* Takes ownership of all local quality issues, projects, and development activities. Works closely with the site’s Senior Management Teams to provide strategic direction and development of the manufacturing sites product quality strategies and tactics.
* Manages and provide direction to a teams of quality professionals both at corporate and manufacturing sites, with responsibility for hiring, performance management, appropriate staffing, and deployment of resources.
* Assures that local sites maintain and improve operational and quality systems to remain in a state of compliance to appropriate ISO, FDA, and other applicable regulatory standards.
* Works closely with the regulatory function to ensure compliance to appropriate ISO and FDA standards; plans for and assists in the management of external audits.
* Leads manufacturing and service site quality teams to ensure alignment to operations, support of Lean efforts and drive quality improvement performance for products, services, and processes across the sites.
* This individual has autonomy to perform the duties of Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) on behalf of STERIS legal manufacturing entities under the EU MDR. This individual shall suffer no disadvantage within the organization in relation to proper fulfilment of his or her duties in lieu of article 15 of the EU MDR.

**The Experience, Skills, and Abilities Needed**
------------------------------------------------

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s Degree (Engineering or related technical field)
* Minimum 10 years of experience with increased responsibility leading quality system and product quality improvement efforts. Exceptional leadership manifested through organizing and motivating teams toward their respective goals by employing hands-on management.
* Must fulfil the experience requirements listed in Article 15 of the EUMDR (PRRC).
* A solid quality foundation indicated by a demonstrated understanding of Lean/Six Sigma, quality system, and product/process improvement methodologies.
* Solid business acumen and proven ability to build and lead process and product improvement strategies and results.
* Strong expertise in analytical methods, quality systems, and continuous improvement methods.
* Excellent interpersonal, as well as verbal and written communication skills in order to develop and maintain rapport and effective internal and external relationships to support business success.
* The ability to work hard and deliver results under pressure, as well as the willingness to address and shift priorities in rapidly changing markets.

**Preferred:**

* Advanced degree.
* Experience with statistical analysis software and Visio.
* Experience in medical device industry.

**Other:**

* Excellent problem-solving skills.
* Focus on identification of potential issues and continuous improvement.
* Experience working on cross-functional teams and on own initiative.
* Demonstrated excellent organizational, oral, and written communications skills.
* Must have PC experience, as well as working familiarity of desktop applications including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

**What STERIS Offers**
----------------------

We value our employees and are committed to providing a comprehensive benefits package that supports your health, well-being, and financial future.

Here is a brief overview of what we offer:

 

* Market competitive pay
* Extensive paid time off and (9) added holidays
* Excellent healthcare, dental, and vision benefits
* Long/short term disability coverage
* 401(K) with company match
* Maternity and parental leave
* Additional add on benefits/discounts for programs such as pet insurance
* Tuition reimbursement and continued educational programs
* Excellent opportunities for advancement in a stable long-term career

#LI-HT

Pay range for this opportunity is $144,500.00 - $187,000.00. This position is eligible for bonus participation.

Minimum pay rates offered will comply with county/city minimums, if higher than range listed. Pay rates are based on a number of factors, including but not limited to local labor market costs, years of relevant experience, education, professional certifications, foreign language fluency, etc.

STERIS offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits portfolio.

Open until position is filled.

STERIS is a leading global provider of products and services that support patient care with an emphasis on infection prevention. WE HELP OUR CUSTOMERS CREATE A HEALTHIER AND SAFER WORLD by providing innovative healthcare and life sciences products and services around the globe. For more information, visit www.steris.com.

If you need assistance completing the application process, please call 1 (440) 392.7047. This contact information is for accommodation inquiries only and cannot be used to check application status.

STERIS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to ensure that persons are recruited, hired, trained, transferred and promoted in all job groups regardless of race, color, religion, age, disability, national origin, citizenship status, military or veteran status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, and any other category protected by federal, state or local law. We are not only committed to this policy by our status as a federal government contractor, but also we are strongly bound by the principle of equal employment opportunity.

The full affirmative action program, absent the data metrics required by § 60-741.44(k), shall be available to all employees and applicants for employment for inspection upon request. The program may be obtained at your location’s HR Office during normal business hours.
