new_roles.description:
***Position Summary***

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall day-to-day leadership and performance of the machine shop operation. This position provides hands-on leadership across machining, production, quality, maintenance, safety, scheduling, and employee development to ensure the facility consistently meets customer requirements for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.

The Plant Manager will drive operational excellence through Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, standardized work, effective production planning, and development of a high-performing manufacturing team. This individual will partner closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and other functional leaders to support business growth and achieve operational objectives.

***Essential Functions / Responsibilities*****:**

**Operations Leadership**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for daily machine shop operations.
* Manage production activities to achieve customer delivery, quality, productivity, and cost objectives.
* Establish and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly production goals.
* Ensure effective production scheduling, machine loading, labor utilization, and workflow.
* Identify and resolve production constraints, bottlenecks, and capacity issues.
* Ensure appropriate staffing and resource allocation to meet production requirements.
* Maintain strong floor presence and lead through visible, hands-on management.

**Machining & Manufacturing**

* Oversee CNC machining, manual machining, secondary operations, assembly, plating, Injection molding, deburring, inspection, and related manufacturing activities.
* Ensure equipment, tooling, fixtures, and processes are capable of meeting production requirements.
* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering to improve machining processes, cycle times, setups, tooling, and machine loading.
* Drive setup reduction, machine utilization, labor efficiency, and throughput improvements.
* Ensure adherence to standardized work and documented manufacturing processes.
* Lead Hazardous Waste Coordinator for facility.

**Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the machine shop.
* Implement and sustain 5S, visual management, standard work, waste reduction, and problem-solving methodologies.
* Identify opportunities to reduce scrap, rework, setup time, downtime, and overall manufacturing costs.
* Utilize data and KPIs to identify root causes and drive corrective actions.
* Establish a culture of continuous improvement and employee involvement.

**Safety & Environmental**

* Maintain a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA and company safety requirements.
* Lead safety initiatives, audits, training, and corrective actions.
* Ensure proper machine guarding, PPE, lockout/tagout, housekeeping, and safe operating practices.
* Investigate incidents and near misses and implement appropriate corrective actions.
* Hold employees and leaders accountable for safe work practices.

**Quality**

* Partner with Quality to ensure products meet customer and internal quality requirements.
* Drive reduction of scrap, rework, defects, and customer complaints.
* Ensure operators follow documented work instructions and quality procedures.
* Participate in root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action activities.
* Promote a culture of first-time quality and process ownership.

**People Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors, leads, machinists, operators, and other production personnel.
* Establish clear performance expectations and accountability.
* Support recruiting, onboarding, training, cross-training, and employee development.
* Develop a flexible, multi-skilled workforce capable of supporting changing production requirements.
* Conduct performance reviews and address performance issues in a timely manner.
* Foster teamwork, communication, accountability, and employee engagement.

**Maintenance & Equipment**

* Partner with Maintenance to maximize equipment availability and reliability.
* Monitor machine downtime and establish corrective action plans.
* Support preventive and predictive maintenance programs.
* Manage capital equipment planning, justification and implementation.
* Ensure new equipment and processes are effectively integrated into production.

**Financial & Business Performance**

* Manage operational performance against established budgets and financial targets.
* Monitor labor efficiency, overtime, scrap, rework, material usage, and machine utilization.
* Identify and execute cost-reduction opportunities.
* Support Supplier Development Activities
* Support Product Transfer activities which may include travel
* Drive capital expenditure planning and return-on-investment analysis.
* Understand the relationship between operational performance, cost, and EBITDA.

**Communication & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Conduct daily/weekly operational meetings and communicate priorities throughout the organization.
* Provide leadership with clear reporting on production performance, capacity, quality, safety, and staffing.
* Work closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Purchasing, and Sales to resolve issues and support customer requirements.
* Escalate operational risks and develop action plans to address them.

***Physical Requirements*****:**

Required to sit, stand, bend, and lift up to 25 lbs.

***Work Environment*****:**

* Combination of Manufacturing and Office environment.
* Regular exposure to noise, dust, heat, cold and odors.

***Knowledge, Skills & Experiences*****:**

* Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, or related field preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive manufacturing experience, preferably in a precision machining environment.
* 3+ years of manufacturing leadership experience with responsibility for people and operational performance.
* Strong knowledge of CNC machining and machine shop operations.
* Experience with high-mix/low- to medium-volume manufacturing preferred.
* Strong understanding of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement principles.
* Demonstrated experience leading production teams and improving operational performance.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing safety practices and OSHA requirements.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems and production scheduling.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent communication and leadership abilities.

***Preferred Experience***

* Precision machining and tight-tolerance manufacturing
* CNC turning and milling
* Multi-axis machining
* High-mix manufacturing
* AS9100, ISO 9001, or other regulated manufacturing environments
* Hazardous Waste Management

* Lean/Six Sigma methodologies
* ERP/MRP systems
* Capital equipment implementation
* Continuous improvement / Kaizen
* P&L or operating-budget responsibility

new_roles.description:
Plant Manager

**Company:** Smitty Bee Honey - Defiance, IA

**Reports to:** President

Job Summary

SBH is seeking an experienced, results-driven Plant Manager to coordinate and direct all major plant functions. You will oversee manufacturing, maintenance, and warehouse operations while fostering positive employee relations and managing operational budgets. The ideal candidate will ensure strict compliance with SBH policies, food safety regulations, and legal requirements, while driving continuous improvement and on-time customer delivery.

Key Responsibilities

* **Operations & Production Management:** Oversee daily manufacturing, maintenance, and warehouse operations, ensuring production schedules and product quality consistently meet specifications.
* **Customer Fulfillment:** Coordinate and communicate scheduled open orders to guarantee on-time delivery to all SBH customers, supporting strategic efforts to retain existing business and generate new sales.
* **Continuous Improvement & Efficiency:** Identify and implement initiatives to reduce labor costs, material waste, and indirect expenses. Develop and manage labor utilization strategies that adapt effectively to shifting production demands and deadlines.
* **Equipment & Facility Optimization:** Partner with Engineering and Maintenance to minimize equipment downtime. Manage process flows, optimize plant layouts, and coordinate shutdowns and startups for new production lines and equipment installations.
* **Food Safety & Quality Culture:** Champion a strong food safety culture by ensuring strict site-wide adherence to Food Safety, Quality, HACCP, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).
* **Workplace Safety:** Actively monitor, support, and enforce all plant safety objectives and regulatory standards.
* **Financial & Budgetary Oversight:** Consult with the SBH President on operational budgetary planning, forecasting, and disciplined spending.
* **Team Leadership & HR Partnership:** Collaborate with Human Resources on policy development, employee relations, talent development, and workforce motivation. Clearly communicate changes in company policies, procedures, and strategies to management and plant personnel.

Qualifications

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Business, Engineering, or Supply Chain Management preferred (equivalent relevant work experience will be considered).
* Experience:
* 5+ years of leadership experience within a manufacturing environment required.
* Prior food processing plant management experience in an HACCP- and GMP-regulated environment.
* Certifications & Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of HACCP, GMPs, and chain-of-custody management; current forklift certification (or willingness to obtain certification upon hire).
* Skills: Proven ability to communicate clearly, lead effectively, and influence team members across all levels of the organization.

Physical Requirements

* Frequently required to stand, walk, sit, talk, hear, bend, stoop, and kneel; occasionally required to climb, balance, crouch, and crawl.
* Frequently required to push, pull, lift, and carry up to 60 pounds with assistance.
* Routinely required to reach with hands and arms, involving repetitive motion of the wrists, hands, and fingers.
* Occasionally required to maintain balance while ascending or descending ladders or open stairs.
* Specific vision abilities required include close, distance, color, and peripheral vision, as well as depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

* Active, fast-paced manufacturing and production floor with heavy forklift traffic and moving machinery; constant situational awareness is essential.
* Exposure to varying climate conditions, including wet surfaces, temperature extremes (hot, unconditioned environments), and high noise levels.
* Strict adherence to food safety and PPE protocols is mandatory, including wearing hairnets/beard nets and following rigorous hand-washing procedures (safety training is provided).

Pay: $90,000.00 - $113,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Relocation assistance

Work Location: In person

new_roles.description:
**About the role:**
-------------------

As Plant Manager for Eaton’s Critical Power Solutions operations in Santa Ana, California, you’ll lead two facilities, 500+ employees, and approximately $280M in annual sales, delivering engineered-to-order critical power solutions for some of the world’s fastest-growing customers.

This is a **high-visibility business and operations leadership role** with the opportunity to make a significant impact. You’ll co-own the P&L, lead the full plant organization, and help scale the operation as demand continues to grow.

**We’re looking for a leader who can:**

* Build and develop high-performing, cross-functional teams.
* Deliver consistently against safety, quality, delivery, inventory, cost, and financial commitments.
* Create a culture of structured problem solving using A3, 8D, PDCA, and root cause analysis.
* Lead through growth, complexity, and change while maintaining strong operational discipline.
* Make sound financial decisions around cost, budgets, capital, capacity, and profitability.
* Move comfortably between the manufacturing floor, customer conversations, and senior leadership discussions.

**What you will do:**
---------------------

**Lead people and culture** 

* Build a safety-first culture where every employee owns EHS, and keep our safety management systems strong through active, visible leadership.
* Be a visible leader on every shift: communicate openly, spend real time on the floor, and build an inclusive team where people want to stay and grow.
* Model Eaton's values and Code of Ethics in how results get delivered, every day.

**Run a high-performing operation** 

* Co-own the site P&L and scorecard (safety, quality, delivery, inventory, cost, productivity and engagement), set stretch goals and close gaps quickly.

new_roles.description:
This position will oversee production to enable plant productivity and maintenance and the delivery of quality products to customers in an efficient manner, performs various manual tasks in the pits as required. Production activities and coordinates projects. Maintains quality control and ensures the project is going smoothly and according to schedule.

**Essentials Functions**

* Full and complete working knowledge and understanding of all equipment.
* Promotes and supports safety culture and ensures compliance with safety rules and regulations.
* Manages the plant’s production function while maintaining working relationships with other departments to ensure smooth operation.
* Reviews sales forecast and schedules production to ascertain and meet production quantity and quality requirements.
* Review production and operating reports, and resolve operational, manufacturing, and maintenance problems to ensure safety, while minimizing costs and preventing operational delays.
* Complies, stores, and retrieves production data. Monitors physical inventory levels.
* Oversee employee training requirements.
* Additional major functions include planning, annual budgeting and monthly forecasting, reporting of department’s effectiveness, safeguarding assets, and environmental compliance.
* This position requires knowledge equivalent to that which normally would be acquired through a bachelor’s degree in mechanical, industrial, or chemical engineering, or related field.
* Ability to analyze, troubleshoot, critically think about, and resolve problems with field equipment.
* Make sure all equipment is mechanically sound, safe, and ready to work daily.
* Oversee the daily construction activities at work site, including scheduling of workers, delivery of equipment and materials and progress of the project.
* Professionally and positively motivate and direct activities of the crew to enable the completion of work in a safe environmentally responsible and timely manner.
* Daily pre-job preparation and organization for self and crew members, including safety meetings.
* Complete and turn in all paperwork and log in a professional, legible, and timely manner.
* Manage aggregate production to ensure goals and objectives are met.
* Responsible for maintenance and repair of all mobile and stationary equipment.
* Ensures that the workforce complies with policies, procedures, and regulations to produce a productive labor climate at plant facilities.
* Assist Plant Managers and Quality Control Departments as necessary to ensure quality products, accounts & service.
* Assist in development of riverbed aggregate sites, pit operations and reclamation.
* Equipment repair and preventative maintenance
* Interact with vendors and employees.
* Maintain a high degree of customers satisfaction and employee morale through problem solving.
* Ensure a safe working environment through daily inspections and monthly safety meetings.
* Supervise 1-2 aggregate plants (both fixed and mobile)

**Qualifications**

* High School diploma or equivalent
* A minimum of 5 years’ experience in the operations of a sand and gravel pit.
* Experience in a supervisory capacity
* Knowledge of MSHA rules and regulations
* Experience in planning, design, and project management
* Minimum of two years of operating experience
* Ability to understand and follow instructions.
* Ability to learn the methods and practices used in our business.
* Ability to perform strenuous work in varying weather conditions.
* Knowledge of heavy equipment including but not limited to loaders, dozers, and hydraulic excavators and off-road haul trucks. Plant processing includes, but is not limited to water pumps, generators, electrical control components, vibratory screens, sand screws, conveyors, radial stackers, material washers, scales, settling basins, vibratory feeders, and log washers.
* Ability to meet deadlines and multi-task.

**Physical Demands & Work Environment**

Must be able to walk on uneven terrain, climb stairs and ladders, occasionally lift up to 50 pounds, wear required PPE, and work extended hours as needed. Valid driver's license and ability to safely conduct site inspections required.

**NOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**

* Ability to understand and follow instructions.
* Ability to learn the methods and practices used in the Pits.
* Ability to perform strenuous work in varying weather conditions.

**What we offer**

Salary: $80,000 - $105,000 DOE

Bonus Potential: 10%

* Medical
* Telemedicine
* Health Advocate Service
* Dental & Orthodontics
* Vision
* 10% profit Sharing
* FSA Medical & Dependent Care
* Paid Parental Leave
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Employee Assistance Program
* Wellness Incentive Bonus Program
* Life and AD&D
* Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
* Paid Vacation
* Paid Holidays
* 401(k)

new_roles.description:
Kingspan Insulated Panels North America, a division of the Kingspan Group plc headquartered in Ireland, is a global and trusted leader in the design, manufacturing, and supply of high-performance sustainable building products and solutions for the construction industry. As the most energy-efficient, cost-effective building envelope solutions, insulated metal panels are at the forefront of sustainability. We serve the architectural, commercial/industrial, cold storage and food processing markets, and are committed to delivering the most advanced building products on the market.

Learn about our Planet Passionate initiatives: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EEeIS55WMOk (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EEeIS55WMOk)

At Kingspan, our future success is based on the quality of our people, who's expertise and motivation have helped ensure that we remain at the forefront of the construction materials manufacturing industry. In joining Kingspan you become an important part of a growing organization with a reputation for innovative design and use of technology, technical expertise, product quality, service excellence, and dedication to sustainability.

***Ready to be part of our team?***

***We are looking for an Experienced Plant Manager for our Columbus, OH plant!***

* **Sponsorship is not available for this position.**

**Summary:** The Plant Manager is the senior site leader with full accountability for overall plant performance, overseeing all operations across the entire site, including continuous panel line manufacturing and ancillary processes. This role is responsible for aligning people, processes, and strategy to ensure the site produces high-quality products at standard manufacturing costs in a safe, efficient, and profitable manner.

Success is achieved through the direct leadership and development of subordinate managers and supervisors, while building a strong, engaged organization capable of delivering reliable operational and business results.

**Essential Duties**

**Operational Performance & KPI Accountability**

* Own and drive plant performance against key metrics, including safety, quality, delivery, cost, inventory, productivity, and employee engagement.
* Translate corporate and regional objectives into clear plant-level goals, priorities, and operating plans.
* Ensure disciplined execution of daily management systems, standard work, and KPI reviews.
* Hold leaders and teams accountable for results while removing barriers and providing necessary resources.
* Ensure customer requirements are met through effective production planning, quality control, and on-time delivery.

**Organizational Leadership & People Development**

* Provide visible, values-based leadership that sets clear expectations for behavior, performance, and accountability across all levels of the plant.
* Lead, coach, and develop managers and supervisors, ensuring they are equipped to lead teams, solve problems, and deliver results through others.
* Build a high performing leadership team through effective hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, and succession planning.
* Foster an inclusive, respectful, and engaged workplace culture where safety, quality, and continuous improvement are shared responsibilities.
* Communicate effectively and consistently with employees, reinforcing vision, priorities, and alignment to company objectives.
* Partner with Human Resources to address employee relations matters, labor strategy (where applicable), and workforce planning.

**Safety, Quality & Compliance Leadership**

* Champion a proactive safety culture by modeling safe behaviors, enforcing standards, leading incident investigations, and driving corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory, environmental, safety, and labor requirements.
* Maintain adherence to quality standards and lead continuous improvement efforts to reduce defects and variability.
* Act as the site authority for audits, inspections, and regulatory interactions.

**Continuous Improvement & Change Leadership**

* Lead lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives that improve performance and build organizational capability.
* Drive root-cause problem solving and data-driven decision making.
* Lead change initiatives effectively by engaging stakeholders, communicating clearly, and sustaining improvements over time.
* Balance short-term operational execution with long-term capability and talent development.

**Financial & Strategic Stewardship**

* Maintain full accountability for plant financial performance, including labor, operating costs, and capital investments.
* Participate in budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning. • Identify and mitigate operational and business risks to ensure continuity and stability.
* Evaluate and prepare CAPEX recommendations.
* Serve as the primary site representative to corporate partners, customers, and external stakeholders.

**General Responsibilities**

* Maintain accurate records and reporting across all operational areas.
* Participate in meetings, training, and development activities as required.
* Follow the Group Code of Conduct and Group Compliance.
* Follow Compliance requirements per “KNA-SOP-1705 Compliance Roles and Responsibilities.”
* Performs all other duties as assigned.

**Education/Experience:**

* Formal education is preferably a bachelor’s degree or above.
* 10 years of manufacturing experience, ideally in a continuous product environment.
* Knowledge and practice of modern manufacturing techniques.
* Knowledge of labor laws.
* Knowledge of the construction industry.
* Know the operation of the panel producing equipment and accessory equipment.
* Ability to calculate figures/amounts.
* Good oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to train and instruct employees.
* Good analytical problem-solving skills.
* Strong Microsoft Word and Excel skills.
* Proven track record of lean manufacturing experience.
* Must be highly proficient in all Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Outlook.

**Personal Attributes**

The successful candidate will exhibit the following attributes:

**Senior Site Leadership**

* Serves as the visible, accountable plant leader, shaping performance, culture, and behavior.
* Builds long-term organizational capability while balancing operational urgency with people and succession needs.

**People-Centered, Results-Driven**

* Delivers results through strong managers and supervisors, not direct control.
* Sets clear expectations, fosters accountability and trust, and coaches leaders to manage performance fairly and effectively.

**Operational & Strategic Focus**

* Aligns KPIs and execution with business objectives, customer commitments, and financial results.
* Uses data, standard work, and problem-solving while maintaining both short-term execution and long-term excellence.

**Comfort with Complexity**

* Makes sound decisions in dynamic, ambiguous environments with competing priorities.
* Leads calmly and decisively through disruptions, pressure, and change.

**Influence-Based Leadership**

* Is visible on the factory floor, approachable, and accessible to team members, fostering open dialogue and trust.
* Builds alignment through credibility and relationships rather than authority.
* Effectively influences cross-functional partners and gains buy-in at all organizational levels.

**Change & Continuous Improvement**

* Champions continuous improvement as a performance system and leadership mindset.
* Engages teams in change and sustains gains through embedded leadership routines.

**Safety, Values & Integrity**

* Models personal accountability for safety, quality, and ethical behavior.
* Treats safety, respect for people, and values as non-negotiable standards.

**Executive Presence**

* Communicates clearly and confidently across all levels.
* Represents the site professionally with corporate leaders, customers, and external stakeholders.

**Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here represent those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform key responsibilities.

**Body Movement & Posture:** Standing or walking for extended periods, frequent bending, stooping, crouching, or kneeling, climbing stairs or ladders, crawling, or working in confined spaces.

**Manual Dexterity & Handling:** Using hands and fingers to grasp, manipulate, or assemble objects, operating machinery or tools with precision, repetitive motion tasks (e.g., packaging, sorting).

**Strength & Lifting:** Lifting and carrying materials (often 25–50 lbs.). Pushing or pulling carts, pallets, or equipment. Adjusting body movements to match the pace of moving objects.

**Sensory Requirements:** Near and far visual acuity for spotting defects or reading gauges. Hearing alarms, instructions, or machinery sounds. Peripheral vision for monitoring surroundings.

**Cognitive & Environmental Factors:** Maintaining focus in noisy or fast-paced environments. Performing tasks independently or in teams. Exposure to heat, cold, dust, or chemicals, depending on the facility.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including 401k with company match, Medical, Dental, Vision, Identity Theft Protection, Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Pregnancy and Parental Leave, Fitness Reimbursement, Educational Assistance, Life, AD&D, Short- and Long-Term Disability, and Life Assistance Program.

Kingspan is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any factor, including veteran status and disability status, protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

new_roles.description:
POSITION TITLE: Plant Manager 
CLASSIFICATION: Exempt 
REPORTS TO: Plant Manager I 
SUPERVISES: Yes

POSITION PURPOSE: 
Responsible for overseeing and supervising the manufacturing and distribution departments by establishing, monitoring and enforcing policies and procedures to ensure that departments run smoothly and are aligned to quality standards. Creates and executes on strategies and policies for company growth. 
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND BASIC DUTIES: 

* Oversee and supervise the Manufacturing and Distribution departments.
* Provide for the timely manufacture and distribution of product against customer orders.
* Anticipates and tracks operational and tactical risks and providing strategic solutions.
* Plays a significant role in long-term planning, project status reporting, and implementing change control processes.
* Maintain average workdays to manufacture and ship all published catalog items.
* Maintain average workdays to manufacture and ship all custom manufactured items (RCC label)
* Provide monthly responses to budget variance.
* Provide for utilization planning by weekly reporting of the average Work-in-Process.
* Perform physical inventories of raw materials, packaging components, and finished goods.
* Provide for an appropriate balance of inventory to meet performance and financial objectives.
* Implement plant safety programs and ensure compliance with GMP.
* Confirm that appropriate work instructions are developed and maintained and followed throughout the business.
* Ensure that all ISO quality systems are followed.
* Provide compliance to ISO quality systems (i.e. Corrective Action)
* Oversee facilities and grounds maintenance.
* Oversees and reports weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual metrics.
* Identifies trends and assess opportunities to improve processes and execution.
* Completes reasonability testing and information validation prior to circulating findings and recommendations to key stakeholders.
* Solicits and responds to feedback while gaining commitment and support.
* Stays up to date on industry regulations, trends, and technology.
* Manage and supervise employees, resolve problems, and make recommendations for staffing and interviewing candidates for employment.
* Responsible for annual personnel reviews.
* Champions Functional Training Document (FTD) program through employee learning and development initiatives; standards of excellence & leader/employee accountability.
* Other Duties as assigned.
* Commitment to the organizations values; High Standards, Bias for Action, Teamwork, Customer

Obsession, Trust, Accountability, Innovation and Growth & Learning. 
Items covered in this job description are not all-inclusive of the expectations to perform this job 
satisfactorily. There may be times where management may require that you perform task not listed in this 
job description.

REQUIRED SKILLS: 

* Addressing operational concerns and issues, monitoring overall customer satisfaction.
* Developing and implementing operational procedures and policies.
* Analyzing training needs/requirements.
* Excellent interpersonal communication and organizing skills to coordinate project activities.
* Ability to communicate with others effectively.
* Ability to conduct research for special projects, respond timely inquiries, and present written/ oral briefings.
* Ability to work with details and time-sensitive issues.
* Good decision-making skills and response to high-pressure situations.
* Managing processes, developing standard.
* Tracking budget expenses, financial skills.
* Performance management.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: 

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry or Engineering-related discipline or a business-related area or equivalent work experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Minimum of eight (8) years manufacturing management experience supervising manufacturing employees.
* Minimum of two (2) years of recent overall project management experience.
* Knowledge of HazMat, ISO, Distribution and safety programs.
* Experience with Microsoft Office, including advanced Excel skills with the ability to manipulate spreadsheets, create pivot tables and summarize data from multiple sources
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to work independently and with the team with strong follow through
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Accuracy and attention to detail
* A Project Management Professional (PMP) certified by the Project Management Institute (PMI) can be used in lieu of the educational requirements

WORK ENVIRONMENT: 
The physical environment may require the employee to work both inside and outside in heat/cold, wet/humid, and dry/arid conditions. This position may be working in the warehouse under various indoor environmental conditions, including supplemental heating in the winter months and without air-conditioning in the summer months. May be requested to work overtime and weekends. The position may occasionally be exposed to ruptured, leaking packages, some of which may contain Hazardous Materials. Where appropriate, proper safety equipment should be utilized and/or appropriate personnel notified. Frequently required to use personal protective equipment to prevent exposure to hazardous materials and chemicals. This job may require lifting of up to 50 pounds occasionally. 
INTENT AND FUNCTION OF JOB DESCRIPTIONS 
All descriptions have been reviewed to ensure that only essential functions and basic duties have been included. Peripheral tasks, only incidentally related to each position, have been excluded. 
Items covered in this job description are not all-inclusive of the expectations to perform this job 
satisfactorily. There may be times where management may require that you perform task not listed in this 
job description. 
Requirements, skills, and abilities included have been determined to be the minimal standards required to successfully perform the positions. In no instance, however, should the duties, responsibilities, and requirements delineated be interpreted as all-inclusive. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate. 
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, it is possible that requirements may be modified to reasonably accommodate disabled individuals. However, no accommodations will be made which may pose serious health or safety risks to the employee or others or which impose undue hardships on the organization. 
Job descriptions are not intended as and do not create employment contracts. The organization maintains its status as an at-will employer. Employees can be terminated for any reason not prohibited by law.

new_roles.description:
### **Summary**

The Production Manager oversees the operations of the entire production facility (excluding purchasing, personnel, and non-production functions), with a focus on the Converting department. This role ensures adherence to company policies and procedures while driving optimal operational performance. The manager directly supervises Converting employees and supervisors.

**Perks of Pratt:**

* Medical/Dental/Vision Plans
* Short Term/Long Term Disability
* Supplemental Life Insurance Plans
* Child Bearing/Parental Leave
* 401K Plan with Company Match
* Paid Holidays/Paid Vacation
* Uniforms/Safety Shoes/Prescription Safety Glasses
* Healthy Lifestyles Program/ Virgin Pulse Fitness Tracker
* $500.0/Year Gym Membership Reimbursement100% Tuition Reimbursement/Assistance Program
* Income Protection Plans
* Legal & Travel Assistance Plans
* EAP/Home Auto Insurance Plans
* Wireless/Auto/Computer Discount Plans

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Production & Operations**

* Provide full production support, with a strong emphasis on converting machine performance.
* Maximize productivity and minimize downtime through effective resource management.
* Coordinate with Maintenance on PMs, MVP, and machine uptime goals.
* Oversee converting production, including equipment installation and major repairs.
* Support cost-reduction strategies and drive productivity improvements.
* Ensure compliance with all company policies, safety protocols, and quality standards.

#### **Quality & Safety**

* Ensure plant focus on quality processes and tools for each converting machine.
* Maintain plant housekeeping standards and ensure machine cleaning programs are current.
* Drive safety initiatives and uphold OSHA, EPA, and company regulations.
* Oversee all audit protocols (third-party, customer, and internal).

#### **Leadership & Supervision**

* Directly supervise Converting employees and supervisors.
* Set and communicate quality, efficiency, and production standards.
* Provide training, coaching, conflict resolution, performance evaluations, and disciplinary action as needed.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, teamwork, and high morale.

#### **Administrative & Strategic Support**

* Evaluate new methods, machinery, and safety programs; contribute to planning, budgeting, and purchasing.
* Maintain optimal staffing levels daily.
* Communicate issues to the General Manager in a timely manner.
* Remain on-call and available after hours to address urgent production issues.
* Perform additional duties as assigned by management.

### **Qualifications**

#### **Required**

* High school diploma or GED
* 10 years of experience in corrugated manufacturing
* 5 years of proven management experience in a production environment

#### **Preferred**

* College degree
* Experience with Ward Servo Pro Die Cutters, Bobst 8.2, and Gopfert Die-Cutters
* 5+ years in converting manufacturing operations
* 2+ years in a supervisory role
* Proficiency in Lean/5S, OSHA, EPA regulations
* Mechanically inclined with strong troubleshooting skills
* Strong project management and coaching abilities

### **Skills & Competencies**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Sound mathematical and analytical capabilities
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and lead effective meetings
* Emotional resilience and conflict resolution skills
* Positive leadership presence and professional demeanor

### **Performance Measurements**

* **Operating Standards:** Meets/exceeds performance goals for production and customer service
* **Personal Growth:** Achieves annual professional development goals
* **Employee Relations:** Demonstrates effective team development, coaching, and motivation
* **Creativity:** Contributes innovative ideas to improve business operations

### **Physical & Work Environment Requirements**

* Regular walking, talking, hearing; frequent standing and reaching; occasional sitting
* Visual requirements include close, distance, color, peripheral vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
* Exposure to wet/humid conditions, mechanical parts, fumes/particles, and high noise levels

Requirements:

Pratt Industries is America's 5th largest paper and packaging company with more than 10,000 highly skilled employees dedicated to the environment and sustainability. Pratt Industries is one of the largest corrugated packaging companies in America, with sophisticated manufacturing facilities in more than a dozen states. The company operates three of the most modern, cost effective paper mills in the country, as well as a series of sheet and box plants strategically placed throughout the United States offering a wide range of creative packaging solutions. Pratt Industries is committed to recycling and the environment by “harvesting the urban forest." 
Pratt Industries offers competitive compensation plans with incentive opportunities, full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, FSA, All State, Pre-Paid Legal, and 401(k) with company match, paid vacation, and paid holidays.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
As a leader and innovator in the snack food industry for over 50 years, J&J Snack Foods provides branded snack foods to foodservice and retail supermarket outlets across the U.S. Its products include such icons as SUPERPRETZEL, ICEE, and Dippin' Dots along with other key brands like LUIGI'S Real Italian Ice, The Funnel Cake Factory Funnel Cakes, and Hola Churros. J&J also has a strong presence in bakery providing cakes, cookies, and pies to some of the largest grocery and convenience retailers in industry. Our company continues to deliver record sales led by a talented team and a commitment to "Fun Served Here".

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Reporting to the Senior Director of Plant Operations, the Plant Manager serves as the senior leader responsible for the overall operational performance of a high-volume snack food manufacturing plant. This role oversees all day-to-day plant activities and is accountable for safety, quality, service, cost, people, and culture. The Plant Manager leads cross-functional teams across production, maintenance, quality, warehouse, planning, and sanitation to ensure the efficient production of high-quality products in alignment with company standards and financial targets. This position combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, translating company objectives into daily plant operations while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement. The Plant Manager plays a critical role in delivering the production plan, enhancing productivity and profitability, and fostering a safe, engaged, and high-performing workforce.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS****:**

* Leads and manages all aspects of plant operations, including production, maintenance, quality, warehouse, planning, and sanitation, to ensure the safe, efficient, and timely manufacturing of high-quality products.

* Establishes and sustains a strong safety culture by promoting a zero-injury mindset; ensure full compliance with all OSHA, FDA, GMP, HACCP, and environmental regulations through proactive programs, audits, and corrective actions.

* Delivers the production plan on time and in full by optimizing operational performance, including OEE, labor efficiency, yield, and waste reduction, while identifying and eliminating constraints and bottlenecks.

* Partners with Quality to uphold the highest food safety and product standards; ensure adherence to all quality systems, maintain audit readiness, and lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for quality deviations.

* Builds, leads, and develops a high-performing team by recruiting, training, and coaching supervisors and frontline employees; fosters a culture of accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement, while supporting succession planning and positive employee/labor relations.

* Owns and manages the plant's financial performance, including the operating budget, labor and overtime costs, waste, and conversion costs; monitor expenditures and drive cost-effective operations aligned with business objectives.

* Champions continuous improvement initiatives by implementing Lean manufacturing principles, 5S, and structured problem-solving methodologies; lead kaizen events and leverage data and KPIs to drive performance and decision-making.

* Ensures equipment reliability and optimal facility performance through strong partnership with maintenance; oversee preventive maintenance programs and manage capital improvement projects to support operational efficiency and long-term growth.

* Collaborates cross-functionally with Planning, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, and Distribution to align materials, staffing, and maintenance plans with production needs, including support for new product introductions and process changes.

* Tracks, analyzes, and reports key performance indicators related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people; communicate performance and improvement plans effectively to senior leadership.

* Performs other duties and special projects assigned to support plant operations and organizational objectives.

**COMPETENCIES:**

To perform this job successfully, the Plant Manager must be self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to solve problems while staying focused on priorities. The following knowledge, skills, and abilities are required:

* Excellent planning, organizational, and time-management skills, with the ability to balance production and maintenance priorities.

* Proven leadership and team-building abilities, including advanced coaching, employee development, and motivation skills.

* Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and active listening skills.

* Adaptable and flexible, able to navigate change and respond to evolving operational needs.

* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving capabilities.

* Collaborative, with the ability to lead team-based decision-making processes.

* Highly motivated, results-oriented, and driven to achieve operational excellence.

* Alignment with and passion for the company's mission, vision, values, and operating principles.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business Management, or a related field; Master's degree preferred. Equivalent experience will also be considered.

* Minimum of 7–10+ years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing, preferably in CPG or food production, with prior experience leading a plant or large production operation.

* Proven track record in safety management, including implementing and enforcing safety systems and ensuring compliance with OSHA and other regulatory standards.

* Extensive experience managing food quality systems and adhering to GMP and other industry requirements.

* Strong operational knowledge of manufacturing processes, maintenance, and engineering principles, with demonstrated practical application.

* Experience managing budgets, expenses, and cost performance, with solid financial and accounting understanding.

* Hands-on experience with continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, 5S, Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt preferred), or similar process improvement frameworks.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with enterprise systems such as SAP or JD Edwards is a plus.

Disclaimer: This position description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the team member. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

new_roles.title: Manufacturing Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**ClarkDietrich** offers a comprehensive lineup of products and services for both cold-formed steel framing and drywall/plastering finishing systems. We manufacture innovative products for interior and exterior framing, interior and exterior finishing, floor and roof framing, clips, connectors, metal lath, welded wire, barrier mesh, and accessories.

As the demands for higher performance in all aspects of today's building requirements rise, our leadership team's partnerships are focused on maintaning the highest quality standards in the commercial building industry. Our teams work with architects, engineers, building developers and owners, contractors, and more on projects of all sizes, scopes, and complexity. Far beyond products, our collaborations increasingly involve efforts and expertise that support a more ingenious installation and design. Are you a Leader that understands collaboration, trust and engagement? We are looking for incredible people to contribute to our future success and growth!

Join a team that is **STRONGER THAN STEEL**℠, by applying to become a **Manufacturing Plant Manager** at our **Woodland** location.

**SUMMARY**

The **Plant Manager** is responsible for the day-to-day operations of the entire manufacturing facility to include safety, quality, efficiencies, and meeting customer expectations. This includes driving strategic plans that ensure that production goals are met in the safest and most cost-effective manner, while delivering expected financial results.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Direct and manage plant operations for production, maintenance, quality, and shipping and receiving.
* Coordinate plant activities through planning with departmental supervisors/managers to ensure that all manufacturing objectives are accomplished in a timely and cost-effective manner.
* Oversee all aspects of the day-to-day plant operations, including production, maintenance, and logistics.
* Develop, monitor and control plant budget, through active planning and understanding of P&L to ensure financial targets are met.
* Understands employment laws and oversees the application of SOPs, policies and procedures.
* Implements cost effective systems of control over capital, operating expenditures, manpower, wages, and salaries.
* Leads the effort and drives Lean Manufacturing tools and techniques fostering continuous improvement within the facility. Acts in a proactive fashion regarding problem resolution.
* Maintains existing plant facilities and equipment; replace or adjust plant facilities and equipment when necessary. Investigate and recommend new equipment or process improvements.
* Actively participated with Regional Sales Management to develop and manage the Regional Operating Unit into a team-oriented environment.
* Establish and monitor overall plant performance for production and quality standards.
* Controls and minimizes labor overtime, premium freight, and repair expenses.
* Provides leadership and training to accomplish the company goals and objectives.
* Incorporates shop floor organization and plant cleanliness among plant personnel.
* Schedules and conducts plant communication which focused on key operative measurements and safety topics.
* Onsite contact for government agencies, landlords and various other vendors
* Engages team by overseeing employee relations, coordinates team events, employee performance recognition and rewards.

**SAFETY**

* Strives to improve the plant's safety accident record year after year in creating a positive safety culture for all employees. Conducts safety walks of the facility on a weekly basis.

* Monitors the activities of all employees and provides feedback and discipline to promote a safe workplace.
* Oversee the development and organization of all safety related documentation.
* Ensures and develops all required safety related training and promotes programs to lead safe behaviors.
* Audits equipment and the shop floor for safety related improvements.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Supervise plant staff and ensure employee safety.
* Mentor staff to create a productive and positive work environment.
* Accountable to Establish strong relationships that foster engaging collaborative influence.

Requirements:

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Mechanically Inclined.
* Problem Solver.
* Team Oriented.

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's degree in related field or five years plant/general management experience in a manufacturing environment, strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of budgets and financial statements.
* Background with manufacturing methods, process improvement programs and procedures required.
* Basic computer experience with Microsoft Word and Excel
* The military equivalent will be recognized in lieu of education and/or experience.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS**

* Basic mathematical skills, addition, subtraction, multiplication and converting fractions into decimals.
* Ability to read a tape measure, micrometer, and caliper accurately.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* Manufacturing facility exposed to heat and cold.
* Personal Protective Equipment is always required.
* Controlled Noise exposure
* Activity level is high-continuous movement.

**CLARKDIETRICH BENEFITS INCLUDE**

* Full benefits package (Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible Spending Accounts and Life Insurance)
* 401(k) with company match
* Annual Incentive Program
* Paid Time Off
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Paid Community Service Day

Pay Transparency ClarkDietrich’s compensation program supports the company’s Vision and Values. We offer a competitive compensation, opportunities for advancement and a work-life balance.

new_roles.title: Senior Director, Automation & New Process Engineering
new_roles.description:
**Job Description:**

**Position Overview**
---------------------

TransMedics is seeking a **Senior Director of Automation and New Process Engineering** to lead a critical transformation within our R&D and Engineering organization. This highly visible leadership position will oversee Automation, New Product Introduction (NPI), and Sustaining Engineering, driving engineering innovation, manufacturing excellence, and operational scalability.

**This is a build role, not a maintain role.**

As TransMedics continues its rapid growth, we need a strategic, hands-on engineering leader who can develop and execute a multi-year transformation roadmap while remaining closely connected to day-to-day manufacturing operations.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in automation and advanced manufacturing with proven experience building high-performing engineering organizations. This leader will drive improvements in product quality, reliability, manufacturing efficiency, and scalability while developing the engineering talent needed to support our continued growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Engineering Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Lead the Automation, New Product Introduction, and Sustaining Engineering organizations.
* Develop and execute a multi-year engineering transformation strategy aligned with business growth.
* Build, mentor, and develop high-performing, multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Establish organizational structures, processes, and capabilities to support long-term scalability.
* Oversee performance management, professional development, and engineering resource planning.

**Automation & Advanced Manufacturing**

* Drive the implementation of advanced automation, robotics, and innovative manufacturing technologies.
* Lead automation initiatives across multiple manufacturing lines to improve quality, efficiency, and throughput.
* Identify opportunities to modernize manufacturing processes, systems, and infrastructure.
* Establish scalable, reliable, and cost-effective manufacturing solutions.

**New Product Introduction & Sustaining Engineering**

* Provide strategic leadership for NPI engineering and manufacturing process development.
* Ensure successful transitions from product development into scalable manufacturing.
* Lead sustaining engineering initiatives to improve existing products and manufacturing processes.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical challenges and support product launches.
* Maintain a hands-on approach to troubleshooting manufacturing issues and addressing production or launch risks.

**Design for Excellence (DfX)**

* Champion Design for Excellence (DfX), including Design for Manufacturability (DFM), throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Drive product and process simplification, including part-count reduction.
* Improve product reliability, manufacturing efficiency, and cost effectiveness through engineering design improvements.
* Establish best practices supporting consistent, scalable manufacturing performance.

**Strategic Collaboration & Operational Excellence**

* Partner closely with R&D, Quality, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement in engineering systems, processes, and infrastructure.
* Leverage manufacturing technologies, digital tools, and operational data to improve engineering outcomes.
* Support capital planning, resource allocation, and strategic investment decisions.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience specifying, developing, and implementing automation across multiple manufacturing lines.
* Strong technical understanding of manufacturing processes, automation technologies, and engineering operations.
* Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on technical problem-solving.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or advanced degree.
* Proven success leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations through significant growth or transformation.
* Experience implementing advanced manufacturing technologies, including robotics and automated production systems.
* Strong understanding of Design for Excellence (DfX) and Design for Manufacturability (DFM).
* Knowledge of regulatory frameworks, quality systems, and compliance requirements.
* Experience leveraging Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and digital manufacturing technologies.
* Demonstrated financial acumen, capital planning, project management, and resource allocation experience.
* Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent.

**Work Environment**
--------------------

This position operates in both office and manufacturing floor environments and requires a leader who is comfortable engaging directly with engineering teams, manufacturing operations, and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

TransMedics is committed to equitable and transparent compensation.

The expected base salary range for this position is **$220,600 – $314,050 annually**, representing the company's current good-faith estimate of compensation.

Actual compensation will depend on factors including candidate experience, qualifications, skills, and specific work location.

This position may also be eligible for:

* Performance-based bonuses
* Equity compensation
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Retirement savings benefits
* Paid time off
* Wellness resources

TransMedics complies with all applicable U.S. pay transparency laws and does not request or consider salary history.

**About TransMedics**
---------------------

TransMedics is transforming organ transplantation through innovative technologies designed to improve the availability, utilization, and outcomes of donor organs.

Our mission is to help save more lives by advancing the science and technology of organ preservation and transplantation.

Join a growing organization where engineering innovation, technical excellence, and meaningful impact come together to advance life-saving technology.

This is a full-time, **on-site position** currently based at TransMedics' facility in Andover, MA.

TransMedics is preparing to transition operations to a new facility in **Somerville, MA**. Candidates should be aware of this upcoming move and must be willing and able to work on-site at both locations as the transition occurs.

Candidates must currently reside within commuting distance of the work location or be willing to relocate to the Greater Boston area.

This position requires regular collaboration with engineering, manufacturing, and cross-functional teams, including direct engagement on the manufacturing floor.

TransMedics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

TransMedics is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and hiring process.

We value the unique perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences of our employees and believe that an inclusive workforce strengthens our ability to innovate and fulfill our mission of saving lives.

**Employee Benefit:**

Medical with Health Reimbursement Account through Blue Cross/Blue Shield of MA

Dental

Vision

Healthcare Flexible Spending Account

Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account

Short Term Disability

Long Term Disability

401K Plan

Pet insurance

Employee Stock Purchase Plan

TransMedics is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, marital status, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

new_roles.description:
**Job Title:**

Executive Vice President, Innovation & Quality

**Department:**

Leadership

**Reports To:**

CEO

**FLSA Status:**

Full-Time, Exempt

**Location:**

Brooksville, FL (on-site)

**Travel:**

Periodic travel (approx. 10–15%)

**Direct Reports:**

Director, R&D; Regulatory & Technical Services Manager; Quality Manager

**Date Modified:**

November 2026

**About Black Diamond Coatings (BDC Brands)**

Black Diamond Coatings, Inc. (BDC Brands) is a veteran- and family-owned manufacturer of premium, environmentally friendly home improvement products. Our DOMINATOR®, AQUA-X®, and OBSESS® brands are made in the USA and distributed through Amazon, Lowe’s, The Home Depot, Walmart, plus our own e-commerce site. Headquartered in Brooksville, Florida, we operate with an entrepreneurial spirit, high integrity, and a strong belief in teamwork, continuous improvement, and excellence.

**Mission:** Creating Trustworthy Solutions Beyond Expectations.

**Vision:** Our trusted brands deliver home improvement product solutions that “WOW” our DIY and Pro customers, setting the standard for quality and innovation.

**Position Summary**

The Executive Vice President, Innovation & Quality leads R&D, product innovation, quality, and regulatory compliance across the DOMINATOR®, AQUA-X®, and OBSESS® brands. Reporting to the CEO, this role owns BDC’s product development strategy and new-product pipeline, grows and protects our intellectual property, and owns our ISO 9001-certified quality system from formulation through shipment.

This is a builder’s role. The EVP sets technical direction, builds the team, and stays close enough to the bench to make fast, informed decisions. Innovation at BDC means shelf-ready products that win with our retail partners and customers, not open-ended research. Bold ideas are encouraged; products must be manufacturable, meet cost and quality targets, and ship on time.

**Champion BDC’s Core Values**

* Lead by example: demonstrate strong work ethic, integrity, and commitment to excellence in every interaction.
* Be resourceful and tenacious: do more with less, figure it out, and bring a relentless “will to win.”
* Stay positive as a team, communicate with honesty and respect, and hold yourself and others accountable to the BDC standard.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Innovation & Product Development**

* Set R&D strategy and own the product pipeline, aligned with company growth plans and retail partner priorities.
* Turn customer and market insight into products that outperform what is on the shelf, and expand the product line into new categories.
* Lead development of new, patentable technologies and protect BDC’s intellectual property.
* Run a disciplined, fast development process with clear go/no-go decisions.
* Improve the performance and cost of existing products, backed by solid test data.

**Quality**

* Own the quality system end to end and maintain ISO 9001 certification.
* Make quality a selling point with retail partners.

**Technical Support & Compliance**

* Oversee regulatory compliance and technical support so every product meets federal, state, and retailer requirements.

**Leadership & Partnership**

* Lead and develop the R&D, Quality, and Compliance teams through three direct reports.
* Partner with Operations to scale products from lab to full production.
* Work with Sales and Marketing on launches and retail buyer presentations.

**Job Qualifications**

**Required**

* Master’s or PhD in Chemistry, Polymer Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.
* 15+ years of product development in coatings, sealers, adhesives, cleaners, or specialty chemical consumer products, including 5+ years leading R&D teams.
* Proven record of taking products from concept to commercial launch, including developing patentable technology.
* Experience owning a QC/QA function under ISO 9001 or an equivalent quality management system.
* Deep expertise in water-based polymer and emulsion formulation; dry-blend experience is a plus.
* Hands-on lab skills and experience scaling products from lab to full production.
* Measured results using continuous improvement methods (Six Sigma, lean, or equivalent).
* Working knowledge of product regulatory requirements (SDS/GHS, VOC, EPA and state rules).
* Ability to travel approximately 10–15%.

**Preferred**

* Experience developing products for mass retail, including retailer testing and compliance.
* Category experience in home improvement, building products, or protective coatings.
* Experience building or scaling an R&D function in a growing, entrepreneurial company.
* Hands-on experience applying AI tools to R&D or quality work.

**Working Conditions**

On-site role based at BDC’s lab and manufacturing facility in Brooksville, FL. Regular laboratory work, including handling chemicals with appropriate PPE; outdoor field and application testing; and time on the production floor. Periodic travel to retail partners, suppliers, trade shows, and other BDC facilities.

Black Diamond Coatings, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations - Commercial Laundry
new_roles.description:
**LEAD OPERATIONS. DEVELOP PEOPLE. DRIVE RESULTS.**

Century Linen and Uniform is seeking an experienced, results-driven Director of Operations to lead and oversee operations across five commercial laundry and uniform rental facilities throughout New York State and Massachusetts.

This is a key leadership position responsible for driving operational excellence, improving financial performance, developing strong management teams, and ensuring consistency and accountability across all facilities.

The ideal candidate is a strategic and hands-on leader who understands how to manage a multi-location operation, develop General Managers, improve productivity, control costs, and build a culture of performance and accountability.

**WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

**Multi-Plant Leadership**

* Provide overall operational leadership and direction to five commercial laundry facilities.
* Lead, coach, and hold General Managers accountable for facility performance and results.
* Establish consistent operating standards, procedures, and expectations across all locations.
* Conduct regular facility visits to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and address operational challenges.

**Financial and Operational Performance**

* Oversee operational budgets, expenses, labor costs, overtime, and profitability.
* Partner with Finance to monitor financial results, identify variances, and implement corrective actions.
* Drive cost-control initiatives, productivity improvements, and operational efficiencies.
* Ensure each facility meets established financial and operational objectives.

**Production and Productivity**

* Oversee production performance, workflow, scheduling, labor utilization, and capacity planning.
* Monitor productivity, quality, rewash, linen loss, and production efficiency.
* Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to maximize throughput and resource utilization.
* Ensure production operations support customer demand and service commitments.

**Customer Service and Service Delivery**

* Ensure consistent service quality, accuracy, and on-time delivery.
* Partner with Sales, Customer Service, and Transportation to resolve operational issues.
* Establish accountability for customer complaints, service failures, shortages, and recurring quality concerns.

**Leadership and Employee Development**

* Recruit, develop, coach, and evaluate General Managers and key operational leaders.
* Establish clear performance expectations, measurable goals, and accountability standards.
* Address performance concerns and leadership gaps promptly.
* Build a culture of ownership, teamwork, communication, and continuous improvement.

**Maintenance, Engineering, and Safety**

* Partner with Engineering and Maintenance leadership to improve equipment reliability and reduce downtime.
* Support preventive maintenance programs, capital projects, and facility improvements.
* Promote a safe working environment and ensure compliance with applicable safety and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Human Resources and plant leadership on employee relations, workforce planning, and labor matters.

**Transportation and Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Transportation leadership to improve routing, fleet utilization, delivery performance, and operating efficiency.
* Work collaboratively with Finance, Human Resources, Sales, Engineering, Customer Service, and other departments.
* Provide regular operational updates, performance reports, and recommendations to executive leadership.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

The Director of Operations will be accountable for measurable improvements in:

* Plant profitability and performance against budget.
* Labor costs, overtime, and productivity.
* Pounds processed per labor hour and production efficiency.
* Customer service, on-time delivery, and quality.
* Rewash, shortages, and linen loss.
* Equipment reliability and downtime.
* Workplace safety and compliance.
* Staffing, employee retention, and General Manager performance.
* Execution of operational improvement initiatives.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Industrial Management, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 7–10 years of progressive operations management experience.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing multiple facilities, locations, or business units.
* Experience leading and developing General Managers, Plant Managers, or senior operational leaders.
* Commercial laundry, textile rental, manufacturing, distribution, or other labor-intensive industrial experience strongly preferred.
* Experience managing budgets, analyzing financial results, and improving operational profitability.
* Experience working in a unionized environment and interpreting collective bargaining agreements preferred.

**Leadership Qualities**

* Strong leadership and people-development skills.
* Ability to lead through others rather than micromanage.
* High level of accountability and the ability to hold others accountable.
* Strong financial and analytical abilities.
* Strategic thinking and sound business judgment.
* Effective communication and relationship-building skills.
* Decisive problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to implement change and drive continuous improvement.

**TRAVEL AND TRANSPORTATION REQUIREMENTS**

* This position requires frequent travel, potentially up to 90% of working time, among the company's five facilities throughout New York State and Massachusetts.
* Travel may include overnight stays, early morning departures, evening returns, weekends, and schedule adjustments based on operational needs.
* The employee is responsible for independently arranging reliable transportation to and from all assigned work locations and required reporting locations.
* The employee must be able to report to all assigned locations at the times and schedules required by the position.
* Company-provided bus transportation, if available, is offered as a convenience only and is not guaranteed. Bus service is subject to designated routes, schedules, and availability and may not accommodate the travel requirements or working hours of this position.
* Employees in this position may not rely on company-provided transportation as their sole means of commuting or traveling to required work locations.

This position requires regular presence in both office and industrial laundry environments, including production floors, maintenance areas, and loading docks. The employee must be comfortable working in environments with elevated temperatures, humidity, noise, moving equipment, industrial chemicals, and other conditions commonly found in commercial laundry facilities.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Operations - Quality
new_roles.description:
**About the role:**
===================

This is a hands-on role with both strategic and executional scope. You will build and lead quality assurance and quality control standards across Operations, set the sampling, validation, and escalation practices the organization runs on, and partner closely with the Senior Manager, Operations - Payer Ops, the Human-in-the-Loop Operations leader, Product, and Engineering. You will report to the Head of Operations and help define the company's AI/Human QA strategy as Adonis scales.

**What you'll do:**
===================

**Own the Quality Program across Operations**
---------------------------------------------

* Define and own QA/QC standards, sampling methodologies, audit practices, and validation processes across AI agent outputs, human-executed work, and vendor-delivered operations.
* Develop & present quarterly plans and operating metrics; communicate progress and trade-offs; surface risks early + Work closely with the Head of Operations on strategic projects
* Lead quality assurance for payer workflows and agent outcomes, including new payer activations on the voice channel.
* Lead the development and implementation of a near-real-time QA Dashboard to provide visibility into quality, identify performance gaps, and track improvement over time.
* Partner with the operations team and external vendors to ensure work consistently meets Adonis's accuracy, operational, and compliance standards.
* Partner closely with the operations team to align on quality standards, remediation priorities, and operational performance.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to address quality gaps, improve workflows, and support strategic initiatives.
* Serve as the quality subject matter expert across Operations, ensuring quality considerations are incorporated into new workflows, product launches, and operational changes.

**Turn quality findings into operational and product improvements**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

* Translate and present quality trends and findings into actionable recommendations for Product, Engineering, and Operations, driving improvements from identification through implementation and validation.
* Leverage AI, automation, and internal tooling to increase the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of QA/QC processes.
* Establish quality thresholds and escalation criteria for uncertain, complex, or high-impact outcomes.

**Build and lead a high-performing quality function**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Build and scale the Quality function, establishing clear goals, ownership, processes, and performance metrics.
* Lead, coach, and develop onshore and offshore team members, as the function grows.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, playbooks, training materials, and quality guidelines to support operational consistency and continuous improvement.

**Who you are:**
================

* 6+ years of experience
* Experience in healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) is required, with practical understanding of payer, claims, or related revenue-cycle workflows.
* Experience building or leading quality assurance, quality control, or quality programs in a technology-enabled operations environment.
* Experience coaching a team and creating clarity across multiple workstreams.
* Experience defining operating standards, evaluating results, investigating failures, and ensuring corrective actions are effective.
* Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, customer-facing teams, and operational partners.
* Comfort moving between strategic planning and hands-on operational detail in a fast-changing environment.
* An AI-forward mindset and practical experience applying AI, automation, or intelligent tooling to improve quality and operational performance, with sound judgment about when human review is needed.

The base salary range for this position is $140,000 to $180,000. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to base salary, we also offer competitive equity and benefits packages.

**About Adonis**
================

Adonis is the leading AI orchestration platform for healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), purpose-built for healthcare organizations seeking to transform their revenue operations. Traditional RCM processes often struggle with inefficiencies, costing providers up to 15% or more of their potential revenue. Through advanced automation, data science, and AI Agents, Adonis helps revenue teams detect vulnerabilities, optimize workflows, and deploy precise solutions that drive reliable and scalable financial outcomes.

Adonis is headquartered in New York City and has raised over $95M in funding, including a recent $40M Series C round led by Quadrille Capital with continued support from existing investors such as General Catalyst and Bling Capital. This funding supports our mission to restore sanity to RCM and equip provider groups and health systems with AI-driven revenue cycle operations at scale.

**Compensation Philosophy**
===========================

Actual base pay will depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Adonis determines compensation based on each candidate’s experience and qualifications relative to peers, and most new hires fall near the middle of the range. In addition to base salary, you’ll receive meaningful equity and great benefits.

**Perks at Adonis**
===================

* Competitive equity packages
* Employer-paid medical insurance
* Employer-paid dental insurance
* Employer-paid vision insurance
* Employer-funded HSA
* Parental leave
* Commuter benefits
* Office lunches every day
* Office snacks
* Generous PTO
* Located in 3 World Trade Center with easy access to all trains and the PATH, and amazing views of the city

Adonis is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

At Adonis, we fully comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals.

Compensation Range: $140K - $180K
