new_roles.title: Sr. Manager, Operations
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**

The Senior Operations Manager leads the machining department (approximately 60 employees) through supervisors and technical specialists. The role is accountable for safety, quality, on-time delivery, capacity utilization, productivity, and margins in a high-mix, low-volume precision CNC environment.

This is a people-and-business leadership position focused on removing barriers, driving continuous improvement, and partnering with the General Manager and Business Development to support profitable growth. Hands-on machining or CNC programming is not required.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Safety & Quality: Maintain a safety-first culture. Partner with Quality to uphold ISO standards, reduce nonconformances, and lower cost of poor quality through root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Operational Performance & Capacity: Direct production through supervisors across milling, turning, and secondary operations. Improve throughput by reducing bottlenecks, setup times, downtime, and waste. Optimize capacity planning, staffing, sequencing, and preventive maintenance.
* Delivery & Customer Execution: Own on-time delivery from order release through shipment. Ensure realistic schedules, visible priorities, and proactive recovery plans. Coordinate cross-functionally with Planning, Quality, Purchasing, and Shipping.
* Financial & Margin Management: Partner with Finance and the General Manager to protect and improve gross margin through labor productivity, material yield, scrap reduction, and disciplined cost control. Monitor job costs and provide reliable data for quoting, make/buy decisions, and capital recommendations.
* Systems & Continuous Improvement: Drive adoption, accuracy, and continuous improvement of ERP/MRP and shop-floor systems. Apply Lean tools (5S/6S, standard work, SMED, value-stream mapping, Kaizen) where they deliver measurable results. Develop practical performance dashboards and management reviews.
* People Leadership & Culture: Develop supervisors, team leads, and production personnel through coaching, clear expectations, and empowerment. Build engagement, retention, skills development, and succession. Foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Growth Partnership: Support Business Development with capacity assessments, customer meetings, and opportunity qualification to profitably fill available machine capacity.

**Key Performance Measures**

* Safety performance
* On-time delivery and schedule adherence
* Throughput, labor productivity, setup time, and unplanned downtime
* Capacity utilization and available capacity for new work
* Gross margin, job-cost variance, and scrap/rework costs
* ERP/MRP data accuracy and timely reporting
* Employee engagement, retention, and internal development
* Nonconformance trends and cost of quality

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience leading manufacturing teams or operations departments, preferably in CNC machining, high-mix/low-volume contract manufacturing, or precision manufacturing. Hands-on machinist or programming experience is not required.
* Demonstrated improvements in productivity, on-time delivery, profitability, and operational performance, supported by measurable results.
* Experience implementing or improving ERP/MRP systems, production scheduling, job costing, and KPI reporting.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, business acumen, change management, and cross-functional communication skills.
* Practical understanding of capacity, cost drivers, scheduling, Lean methods, and ISO-based quality systems.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or business preferred; equivalent relevant leadership experience will be considered.

**Role Alignment**

This role manages the machining department through its supervisors and technical staff, with accountability for people development, operational performance, and continuous improvement. The Senior Operations Manager partners with the General Manager on business priorities, financial objectives, and capital recommendations, and with Business Development on customer relationships and growth.

The position does not require personally operating or programming CNC equipment. Final authority for pricing, hiring, capital spending, and related decisions will be defined by company leadership.

**Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled**

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Quality, Fauna
new_roles.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life. We are hiring a Senior Manager to lead the quality, test engineering, and reliability organization supporting our robots from development through production. 
In this role, you will improve product and manufacturing quality while building the testing capabilities needed to scale. Your organization will support new product introduction through volume production across our facilities, suppliers, and manufacturing partners. 
You will build the team and its engineering leadership, set the technical direction, and establish quality standards and validation processes. You will turn changing product and manufacturing needs into a roadmap that supports higher production volumes and additional sites. 
The ideal candidate is a technically strong engineering leader who has improved quality and reliability for products where hardware and software must work together. They can evaluate test strategies and guide critical supplier, production, and reliability investigations. They grow engineers and leaders, and make clear decisions on scope and priority while product designs and manufacturing processes are changing. 
 
Key job responsibilities 

* Architect the quality, test engineering, and reliability organization. Assess capability gaps, define the staffing and investment plan, and hire and develop the engineering leaders and teams needed to scale.
* Establish supplier and factory quality teams, with Fauna engineers embedded at manufacturing sites. Strengthen and scale the quality system to support new products and increasing production volumes.
* Define and lead the reliability strategy, working with our engineers to improve robot performance and durability.
* Build and scale reliability labs and test infrastructure to support product development and production growth.
* Scale and develop the manufacturing test engineering team, shaping its structure, growing its leaders, and strengthening its capabilities to support new products and increasing production volumes.
* Deploy and qualify production test systems across our facilities and manufacturing partners. Partner with the software and systems team on automation and traceable results, and improve repeatability, cycle time, and failure diagnosis.
* Partner with engineering and operations to embed quality, reliability, and testability into product design and production readiness.
* Establish quality and reliability metrics and use production, test, and field data to guide priorities and drive sustained improvement.

 
About the team 
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
 
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
 
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
 
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
 
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a related field
* 10+ years in quality, test engineering, or reliability for complex electromechanical products.
* 5+ years managing multidisciplinary engineering teams, with a track record of building organizations and developing engineers and leaders.
* Experience scaling supplier and manufacturing quality through NPI and production ramp, with strong knowledge of quality systems.
* Technical depth in reliability and manufacturing test engineering, with experience scaling test programs and infrastructure for integrated hardware-software products.
* Strong command of statistical analysis and structured problem-solving, with demonstrated success turning engineering data into product and process improvements.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with robotics or autonomous systems.
* Experience leading engineering managers or distributed teams across multiple manufacturing sites.
* Experience working with contract manufacturers and suppliers globally
* Experience with product safety certification or formal quality management standards.

 
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. 
 
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager - Operations External Manufact
new_roles.description:
**Senior Manager, Operations External Manufacturing**

**About the Company:**

At Horizon Organic, we’re growing a culture of passionate people driven to do good for the horizon we all share. We’re building the tomorrow we want to see. Every single day.

Joining our team means being part of a dynamic environment where your skills are valued, and your contributions make a real difference. We offer diverse opportunities for career growth and development. Embark on a rewarding journey with us in shaping the future of organic dairy!

Two generations of families—and counting—have grown up on Horizon Organic® milk. From the start, as the leading organic milk producer in the U.S., Horizon has been committed to delivering innovative, nourishing dairy that growing families can rely on. In 2023, Horizon Organic became a brand of Platinum Equity. Today, Horizon works with more than 500 farmers across the U.S. to bring high-quality, certified organic milk to consumers. For more information on Horizon’s full portfolio of organic dairy products, visit Horizon.com.

**About the Job:**

We are currently looking to hire a **Senior Manager, Operations External Manufacturing** to join our Supply Chain Department.

Leads external manufacturing operations and network optimization activities across contract manufacturing partners. This role is responsible for ensuring external manufacturing partners deliver excellence in Safety, Quality, Cost, and Delivery while supporting business growth, supply continuity, and operational effectiveness. The position partners closely with Procurement, PMO, Quality, R&D, Finance, Brand, Planning, Logistics, Customer Experience, and Milk Procurement teams to drive execution and continuous improvement across the external manufacturing network.

The Senior Manager - Operations External Manufacturing is responsible for the operational leadership of external manufacturing partners, management of manufacturing qualifications, execution of network optimization initiatives, and oversight of manufacturing performance across assigned facilities. This role develops and implements operational strategies, establishes performance expectations, leads cross functional initiatives, and ensures external manufacturing partners deliver products safely, efficiently, and in alignment with business objectives.

*This is a hybrid position with an expectation of 3 days per week on-site in Broomfield, CO.*

**This role may be responsible for, but not limited to:**

* Lead operational management of external manufacturing partners across assigned manufacturing networks.
* Oversee manufacturing qualification activities and support successful onboarding of new external manufacturing partners.
* Manage execution of network optimization initiatives, including transitions between manufacturing partners and facility rationalization activities.
* Establish and communicate operational performance expectations across Safety, Quality, Cost, and Delivery metrics.
* Monitor manufacturing partner performance and ensure corrective actions are identified, implemented, and sustained.
* Champion cross-functional project teams supporting network optimization, manufacturing transitions, and strategic initiatives.
* Partner with Procurement, PMO, Quality, R&D, Finance, Brand, Planning, Logistics, Customer Experience, and Milk Procurement teams to ensure successful project execution.
* Develop and execute strategies that improve manufacturing performance, service levels, and operational efficiency.
* Evaluate manufacturing capabilities and identify opportunities to optimize network performance.
* Ensure manufacturing partners operate in compliance with company standards, quality requirements, and operational expectations.
* Support supply continuity planning and mitigation activities associated with manufacturing risks and constraints.
* Analyze operational performance trends and develop recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with external manufacturing partners.
* Lead initiatives that improve collaboration, communication, and execution across the external manufacturing network.
* Prepare and present operational performance updates, risks, and recommendations to leadership teams

*The base compensation range for this position is $125,000 - $140,000 commensurate with experience*.

**About You:**

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Engineering, Manufacturing, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 7 years of experience in manufacturing, operations, supply chain, or related disciplines.
* Experience working within Consumer Packaged Goods, food, beverage, dairy, or manufacturing environments.
* Experience leading operational improvement initiatives and cross-functional projects.
* Experience managing suppliers, co-manufacturer, or contract manufacturing relationships.
* Experience developing and implementing operational strategies.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing, supply chain, and consumer packaged goods operations.
* Experience managing external manufacturing partners, suppliers, or co-manufacturers.
* Strong strategic planning and network optimization capabilities.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to evaluate complex operational challenges and implement effective solutions.
* Strong project management and cross-functional leadership capabilities.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Proven ability to develop and implement operational strategies and performance improvements.
* Strong leadership and organizational effectiveness skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience managing external manufacturing networks.
* Experience supporting network optimization and manufacturing transition initiatives.
* Experience leading large cross-functional business projects.
* Experience working with contract manufacturing and co-manufacturing environments.
* Experience supporting supply chain, logistics, planning, and procurement functions.
* Strong understanding of operational performance metrics and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Project management certification or formal project management training preferred.
* Ability to travel up to 25% or more as required.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality
new_roles.description:
At GE Appliances, a Haier company, we come together to make “good things, for life.” As the fastest-growing appliance company in the U.S., we’re powered by creators, thinkers and makers who believe that anything is possible and that there’s always a better way. We believe in the power of our people and in giving them the freedom to explore, discover and build good things, together.

 

The GE Appliances philosophy, backed by three simple commitments defines the way we work, invent, create, do business, and serve our communities: *we come together*, *we always look for a better way*, and *we create possibilities*.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must be able to maintain such authorization without current or future employer or school sponsorship. GE Appliances will not sponsor employment-based visas for this position now or in the future.

Interested in joining us on our journey?

 
The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality leads a team supporting the execution of short-term and long term projects focused on product and process quality improvement. The role supports front-line leadership and development of both salary and hourly team members in support of the factory Manufacturing Control Plans. The role is responsible for working cross-functionally to execute the overall goal for reducing the cost of poor quality associated with plant operations and product performance post-sale.

**Position**
------------

Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality

**Location**
------------

USA, Louisville, KY

**How You'll Create Possibilities**
-----------------------------------

* Live, promote and support the Appliance Production System (APS) philosophy and drive continuous improvement in the quality and adjacent areas. Coach all team members to ensure cross-functional, focused collaboration is the way we work.
* Partner with the Quality Improvement Engineering, Business Operations and Manufacturing Engineering Leaders to promote a culture that establishes, sustains and improves product quality through engineering problem solving and discipline around supporting systems. Promote a method-based quick response to new issues.
* Responsible for developing and tracking team performance metrics tied to the overall factory (FPY, EOLA, Scrap) and effect to the product line financial plan (Damage, Scrap). Leads the team to complete projects and tasks supporting this effort. Owns and assigns tasks and establishes accountability at the appropriate level.
* Closely collaborates with the product line Engineering, Field Quality and Service organizations to understand and respond to part or system product level performance issues impacting owner use and satisfaction. Responds to this data in addition to internal data streams (leading indicators) for product quality and reliability (Engineering, EOLA and audit labs).
* Identify and execute projects to improve the cost of operations. Serve as a broad owner for Corrective and Preventative Actions (CAPA), Corrective Action Request (CAR) approach to problem solving.
* Owner of the execution of attributes of the Manufacturing Control Plan for broad areas. Responsible for the training, execution, auditing and improvement of the Manufacturing Quality Control Plan. Support efforts intended to improve workstation documentation process; create, update and maintain Manufacturing Control Instructions (MCI’s), visual aid and alerts (single point lessons) as needed.
* Strong technical aptitude and ability to coach others in complex engineering topics like dimensional control, material properties, failure analysis as well as emerging technologies such as AI
* Support analysis of data as part of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and implementation of responses as required by MCI/MCP. Escalate and measure response to data trends. Validate root cause response for effectiveness.
* Lead and support 1x1 problem solving for quality systems and related issues collaborate cross functionally to improve product quality through the identification and elimination of root cause of issues. Focus on overall repair efficiency.

**What You'll Bring to Our Team**
---------------------------------

new_roles.title: Senior Manager Operational Area Quality (Hybrid)
new_roles.description:
**Job Description**

**General/Position Summary**

 

The Quality Assurance Senior Operational Manager is recognized as an expert internally in the principles and application of quality assurance and compliance. The Quality Snr Manager will provide QA support of manufacturing operations, analytical laboratory operations and materials management for the external manufacture of Cell & Genetic Therapeutic programs. This role will drive, review & support activities related to product disposition including review of batch data, batch records, deviations, in-process data, EM data, QC release testing and other quality systems documentation.

 

**Key Duties & Responsibilities**

* Responsible for quality support of Vertex Cell and Gene Therapy manufacturing operations across all phases of development, support of analytical laboratory, materials management and manufacturing operations.

* Responsible for GMP batch disposition activities including review and approval of batch records, deviations, in-process data, EM data, QC release testing, materials review board and other quality activities as applicable to determine acceptability of product disposition.

* Partner with External CDMOs

* Provide QA support of change controls, process and OOS investigations, and associated CAPAs.

* Responsible for approval of COAs and product labelling.

* Support review and approval of manufacturing documents such as technical and analytical protocols/reports

* Support technical transfer, and process performance qualification activities.

* Responsible for identifying compliance risks and gaps for GMP processes and supporting implementation of mitigating controls

* Support audit and inspection readiness activities.

* Act as a trusted advisor by providing compliance guidance through collaborative review and partnering with business stakeholders and contract manufacturers.

* Support the vendor management process including the creation and review of Quality Agreements with suppliers.

* Assist with addressing product complaints

* Maintain periodic batch record metrics and assists department with routine/quarterly Quality System data review metrics and reporting

* Execute improvements to QA operations procedure.

* Participate/ lead Cell & Genetic Program and Quality projects and drive continuous improvement activities.

 

**Required Education Level**

* Bachelor's degree in a biotech/ Lifesciences field.

* Preferred Master's degree or relevant comparable background.

 

**Required Experience**

8+ years of relevant industry experience such as manufacturing, quality assurance, and/or quality control in biotechnology/regulated pharmaceutical environment.

 

**Required Knowledge/Skills**

* Demonstrated experience providing QA support to GMP manufacturing operation
* Experience successfully leading event investigations, Root Cause Analysis and CAPA
* Experience with network-based applications such as Oracle, TrackWise, Veeva
* In-depth knowledge of both the conceptual and practical application of cGMPs in a pharmaceutical setting; Biotech/Cell & Gene GMP regulations and applicability. (e.g. EU, FDA, ICH, USP, etc. or other industry best practices ex. ISPE, WHO, etc.)
* Knowledge in Cell technology, aseptic manufacturing technology, analytical assays, cell & genetic therapies/Biologics processing, fill/finish and testing.
* Professional membership or equivalent in relevant societies, network of knowledge in cell and gene therapy industry.
* Ability to evaluate quality matters and make decisions utilizing risk-based approach
Ability to independently lead cross-functional teams, and effectively communicate with business stakeholders. 

 

**Other Requirements**

Up to 15% Travel may be required 

 
 

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.

**Pay Range:**

$133,800 - $200,600

**Disclosure Statement:**

The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.

**Flex Designation:**

Hybrid-Eligible Or On-Site Eligible

**Flex Eligibility Status:**

In this Hybrid-Eligible role, you can choose to be designated as:
 
1. **Hybrid** : work remotely up to two days per week; **or select** 
2. **On-Site** : work five days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility.

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.

#LI-Hybrid

**Company Information**

Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation.

Vertex is committed to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Vertex is an E-Verify Employer in the United States. Vertex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.

Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should make a request to the recruiter or hiring manager, or contact Talent Acquisition at ApplicationAssistance@vrtx.com

new_roles.title: Senior Manager Quality
new_roles.description:
**We believe that great healthcare is an essential safeguard of human dignity.**

At Laborie, we know the work we do matters – it’s what fuels our motivation and contributes to our success. If you’re ready to make a positive impact in the lives of patients across the globe, we’d like to meet you.

We support and empower our employees to grow their careers in an environment that encourages a sense of belonging and a connection to doing good. We’re not afraid to roll up our sleeves to make our goals a reality and work together to solve for our customers. We reward and recognize our employees based on our values of **Aspire to Greatness, Respect All, Own It, Working Together, Persist with Passion.**

**Who We’re Looking For:**

To ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and the Laborie Medical Quality Systems in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of Laborie Medical products. The position supports corporate wide process improvement initiatives relating to Quality and Regulatory.

**About the Role:**

* Develop and direct quality strategies, objectives, policies and procedures for assigned sites and Quality Management Systems.
* Directly responsible for the CAPA, Internal Audit, Complaint Handling and Training Systems for assigned sites and Quality Management Systems, including results against Quality Objectives related to these areas.
* Provide team leadership, development, and talent management activities including coaching, resource forecasting, hiring, performance management, training, and budgeting for the Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering functions to meet the company's objectives.
* Maintain quality standards set forth in the Laborie Medical Quality Manual(s) and those of its subsidiaries.
* Influence management and staff to encourage continuous improvement of quality and compliance.
* Proactively identify/resolve compliance risks.
* Fulfill the duties of back-up Management Representative.
* Play prominent role in acquisition due diligence and integration efforts.
* Prioritize and manage continuous improvement activities for Laborie
* Provide technical recommendations based on trend analysis to eliminate future problems and execute changes as necessary.
* Maintain compliance to all applicable regulations for the marketing of medical devices.
* Manage the CAPA process for all the company QMS’s.
* Lead auditee and serves as escort during inspections and audits performed by external regulatory bodies and internal auditors.
* Execute miscellaneous tasks, as assigned.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* BS or BA in Business Administration/Computer Sciences/Engineering or related degree
* Experience in a leadership position with direct supervision of Quality/Regulatory professionals
* Minimum 8 years’ experience working in a medically regulated industry in a Quality or Regulatory position.
* Experience with ISO13485, MDSAP, MDR, CFR820
* Experience with Project Management, Problem Solving, Six Sigma, Lean Management Systems, Root Cause Analysis, and other standard Quality tools
* Strong project management skills and attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills, cross department collaboration and leadership skills

**Why Laborie:**

Our Mission every day is to operate as a world-class specialist medical company making and advancing technologies that preserve and restore human dignity. We do that today by helping people with pelvic and gastrointestinal conditions live normal lives, and by helping mothers and babies have safe deliveries.

* Paid time off and paid volunteer time
* Medical, Dental, Vision and Flexible Spending Account
* Health Savings Account with Company Funded Contributions
* 401k Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Parental Leave and Adoption Services
* Health and Wellness Programs and Events

We are interested in a qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we will not be sponsoring work visas for this position, at this time.

*Laborie* *provides equal employment opportunities and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person’s race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Laborie is committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in our services, activities, education, and employment for individuals with disabilities.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager - Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
Lead continuous improvement at our Battle Creek, Michigan manufacturing facility, where your work will shape performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost and growth. As a key member of the plant leadership team, you will set the CI vision, advise site leaders on strategy and lead a team of continuous improvement professionals.

You will own the plant's management operating system and annual cost-out process while building the capabilities that sustain results. This role combines enterprise-level thinking with daily visibility on the plant floor, giving you the opportunity to turn data, Lean methods and cross-functional partnership into measurable operational gains.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set and execute the plant's continuous improvement strategy, creating the behaviors, systems and culture needed to achieve plant goals.
* Lead, coach and develop the salaried continuous improvement team while building Lean problem-solving capability across functions.
* Own the plant management operating system, annual cost-out process and A3 strategy documents, including daily, weekly and monthly performance tracking.
* Identify, scope and prioritize breakthrough and incremental improvement opportunities using plant data and operational metrics.
* Teach and model root-cause analysis, DMAIC, standard work, waste reduction, recurrence prevention and structured follow-up.
* Facilitate Kaizen events and cross-functional improvement efforts that strengthen safety, quality, delivery, cost, yield and equipment effectiveness.
* Maintain the plant continuous improvement project docket, track savings and communicate project status and results to operations leadership.
* Partner with operations, engineering and technical teams to implement sustainable solutions and share best practices across PCB facilities.
* Serve as a change leader who constructively challenges non-value-added work and helps teams navigate resistance to change.

**Why You'll Love This Role**

* A visible seat on the plant leadership team with direct influence on site strategy and operational performance.
* The opportunity to build CI capability across the organization and leave a clear handprint on how the plant works.
* Broad collaboration with operations, engineering and CI leaders across Post Consumer Brands.
* A role where big company resources meet a practical, hands-on plant environment.

**Location & Travel Requirements**

* This role is based at the Battle Creek, Michigan manufacturing facility.

**Education**

* A bachelor's degree in science, engineering, management or a related field is preferred.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5 or more years of related experience in a manufacturing environment.
* 3 or more years of successful leadership experience guiding teams that execute continuous improvement or Lean Six Sigma work.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable efficiency, effectiveness and financial benefits through continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience operating in a large manufacturing plant environment.
* Deep working knowledge of Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement methods, including root-cause analysis, DMAIC, Kaizen and waste reduction.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects, use operational data to set priorities and sustain improvements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in food manufacturing.
* Experience working in a union manufacturing environment.
* Experience in food or automotive manufacturing settings.
* Experience leading Black Belt-level or transformational cost-out initiatives.

**Success in This Role**

* Builds trust and strong working relationships across plant leadership, operations, engineering and frontline teams.
* Influences, coaches and develops others while setting clear expectations and maintaining accountability for results.
* Communicates a compelling improvement vision and translates complex problems into organized, practical action plans.
* Uses sound analytical and business judgment to solve complex problems and prioritize actions quickly.
* Leads change with candor, optimism and respect, including in environments where established ways of working may be challenged.
* Demonstrates a consistent commitment to a safe, respectful workplace.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**

If you are ready to lead transformational improvement, develop strong teams and help a large manufacturing operation perform at its best, bring your experience and big ambitions to Post Consumer Brands.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager of Production
new_roles.description:
Gwynedd Manufacturing is seeking a hands-on Senior Manager of Production with a strong CNC machining background to lead day-to-day operations in a high-precision environment. This role is ideal for someone who has progressed through the ranks—from the shop floor into leadership—and is ready to step into a broader operational role.

The ideal candidate brings deep, practical knowledge of CNC machining (mills, lathes, EDM) and thrives in a fast-paced, high-tolerance manufacturing setting. This is not a purely strategic role—this leader will be actively engaged on the floor, driving performance, mentoring teams, and continuously improving processes.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead daily plant operations with a strong presence on the manufacturing floor, ensuring output, quality, and efficiency targets are met
* Direct oversight of machining operations including CNC mills, lathes, and EDM, ensuring optimal machine utilization and performance
* Manage and develop a team of supervisors, leads, and machinists (50–100+ employees)
* Serve as a technical resource and mentor, supporting setup, programming, and troubleshooting when needed
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on cycle time reduction, scrap reduction, and process standardization
* Partner closely with Engineering and Quality to ensure tight tolerance requirements and manufacturability of parts
* Own production scheduling, workflow optimization, and labor planning to meet customer demand
* Establish and reinforce shop floor accountability, KPIs, and standard work practices
* Maintain a safe, compliant, and disciplined manufacturing environment
* Support new product introductions and prototype builds with a strong understanding of machining constraints
* Overseeing multiple departments withing the manufacturing space.

Qualifications:

* 5+ years of progressive manufacturing experience, with clear growth from hands-on machining into leadership
* Strong CNC background required (setup, programming, and/or machining experience with mills, lathes, EDM)
* Prior experience in roles such as Machine Shop Manager, Manufacturing Manager, or Plant Manager
* Proven ability to lead teams in a high-precision, tight-tolerance environment
* Deep understanding of machining processes, tooling, fixturing, and production workflows
* Experience driving continuous improvement on the shop floor (Lean, process optimization, etc.)
* Comfortable being hands-on and highly visible in daily operations, not just managing from an office
* Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to develop talent from within
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field preferred, but equivalent hands-on experience strongly valued

Physical and Work Environment Requirements: 
This position is based in a manufacturing environment and may require the following over extended periods of time up to a full 8-hour work shift (excluding lunch and breaks): stand, walk, sit, squat or bend, kneel and rise, lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to — and occasionally exceeding — 50 pounds, view a computer or other digital screen, work on a computer, workstation or comparable system, and make accurate entries in such systems. Manual dexterity and fine motor skills are required for detailed assembly and precision work. Work may take place in areas with varying temperatures or no climate control, varying noise levels, and production equipment in motion. Proper personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn in designated areas at all times as required by company policy. Reasonable accommodations may be available to enable individuals with disabilities but are always subject to safety concerns for the employee and all team members. Employer may require a physical assessment of the candidate’s ability to perform these tasks as a condition of an offer letter. Any assessment will be performed by a third party vendor and will be reported on a pass/fail basis with no other medical information conveyed to employer.

*Equal Opportunity Employer:* 
*Gwynedd Manufacturing is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

*Note: This job description reflects general duties and responsibilities and is not intended to be an exhaustive list. Management may modify or assign other responsibilities as needed.*

2026-11-19

**Country:**

United States of America

**Location:**

US-CT-EAST HARTFORD-ETC ~ 400 Main St ~ BLDG ETC

Onsite

**U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements:**

The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

**Security Clearance Type:**

DoD Clearance: Confidential

**Security Clearance Status:**

Active and existing security clearance required after day 1

At **RTX**, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

**Pratt & Whitney** is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Pratt & Whitney is seeking a Senior Manager, Model-Based Quality Deployment, to lead the deployment and adoption of Model-Based Quality (MBQ) capabilities across the organization. This highly visible leadership role is responsible for driving strategic digital transformation initiatives, accelerating implementation of advanced quality technologies, and developing organizational capabilities that support long-term business objectives.

The successful candidate will provide direct leadership to the Model-Based Quality Deployment Team, with resources aligned to the module center structure including Cold Section, Hot Section, North Berwick, and Supply Chain. This position requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, organizational influence, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure successful deployment and sustainment of Model-Based Quality capabilities across programs, sites, and customers.

**What You Will Do:**

* Lead the Model-Based Quality Deployment Team, providing direct leadership, coaching, mentoring, and performance management.

new_roles.title: Sr Manager, Quality Assurance Engineering (Hybrid - Acton, MA)
new_roles.description:
Job Summary

This Senior Manager, Quality Engineering role is a key leadership position responsible for overseeing Insulet’s global Design Transfer Quality Engineering team and ensuring new and modified Omnipod products and manufacturing processes are successfully transferred, validated, and sustained in compliance with FDA and ISO quality standards. The position leads a team of Quality Engineers supporting product launches, manufacturing expansion, process validation, risk management, CAPA, and continuous improvement initiatives across global manufacturing sites. The ideal candidate brings extensive medical device quality experience, deep expertise in design transfer, process validation, and regulatory compliance, along with proven people leadership skills. Success in this role requires partnering across Manufacturing, Operations, R&D, Regulatory Affairs, and Quality organizations to drive quality strategy, support global growth initiatives, and maintain high standards in a complex, high-volume regulated manufacturing environment.



The Senior Manager, Quality Engineering leads Insulet's global Design Transfer Quality Engineering team, ensuring new and changed Omnipod products and manufacturing processes are successfully transferred to production, validated and sustained in compliance with the Insulet Quality System, FDA Quality Management System Regulation (21 CFR Part 820), ISO 13485 and ISO 14971. The Sr. Quality Engineering Manager leads a team of Quality Engineers to support design transfer, capacity expansion, and process controls across Insulet's manufacturing sites. The Senior Manager establishes quality strategy, owns key QMS procedures and metrics, represents Quality throughout major design transfer and global expansion initiatives, and partners closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, R&D, Regulatory Affairs and site Quality leaders. The ideal candidate is an experienced medical device quality leader who builds strong teams, makes sound risk-based decisions and drives continuous improvement in a highly regulated, high-volume manufacturing environment at a global scale.

 

Responsibilities:

· Lead, coach and develop a team of Quality Engineers; set priorities, manage workload and resourcing, conduct performance reviews and development plans, and lead hiring.

· Serve as Quality lead for the design transfer of new products and product design changes, ensuring quality deliverables (e.g. Project Quality Plans, Design Transfer Plans, Product Launch Plans) are created and properly executed through each phase gate.

· Serve as global process owner for Production & Process Controls and Design Transfer including procedure continuous improvement, performance monitoring of KPIs, and development of new or expanded processes to support Insulet’s growing production capacity.

· Support manufacturing process validation, equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) and Test Method Validation for new manufacturing lines, capacity expansion, site transfers and equipment upgrades; review and approve plans, protocols and reports.

· Drive process risk management across all sites, including pFMEA governance and integration of nonconformance and production data into risk management.

· Lead remediation and compliance initiatives and provide Quality oversight of CAPAs, investigations, quality events and nonconformances, ensuring effective root cause analysis and verification of effectiveness.

· Partner with global manufacturing sites and contract manufacturers to deploy harmonized quality and process improvements.

· Provide Quality leadership for enterprise systems and digital initiatives (e.g. SAP, MES, eDHR, eQMS).

· Prepare and present quality metrics and project status for operations leadership, QMS process owner forums, and management review.

· Support internal and external audits as a subject matter expert, maintain inspection readiness, and serve as the escalation point for cross-functional quality questions from Operations, Engineering and Supply Chain.

Education and Experience:

• BS degree in engineering, a technical or scientific discipline; and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Master's degree in engineering or technical or scientific discipline preferred.

• Minimum 10 years' experience in Medical Device Quality Assurance.

• 3-5 years' experience managing people, including leading engineers and technical staff.

• In-depth knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485 and ISO 14971.

• Demonstrated experience leading design transfer and process validation for high-volume manufacturing of single-use products, preferably on automated manufacturing equipment.

• Experience with process risk management (pFMEA), CAPA, nonconformance and change control processes; QMS process ownership experience preferred.

• Experience with statistical methods (e.g. statistical process control, sampling plans, Test Method Validation, gauge R&R, and capability).

• Experience working with global manufacturing sites and contract manufacturers.

• Experience with eQMS/PLM, ERP and data visualization tools, as well as word processing, spreadsheet and database programs.

 

Skills/Competencies:

• Proven ability to build, lead and develop high-performing teams, including effective delegation and succession planning.

• Strategic thinking with the ability to organize, judge and balance priorities across multiple complex projects.

• Sound, risk-based decision making in a highly regulated environment.

• Strong verbal (including presentation) and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and present to executive leadership.

• Effective collaboration and communication with individuals at multiple levels and across functions, sites and geographies.

• Strong problem solving / root cause analysis skills.

• Ability to generate and maintain organized and accurate records, and to follow up with task owners to close out open items.

 

Other Expectations:

· Flexibility to work across multiple time zones, outside of normal working hours.

· Travel (International) – 10%

*NOTE: This position is eligible for hybrid working arrangements (requires on-site work from an Insulet office). #LI-Hybrid*

Additional Information:



Compensation & Benefits:

For U.S.-based positions only, the annual base salary range for this role is $138,700.00 - $208,000.00

This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:
• Medical, dental, and vision insurance
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid time off (PTO)
• And additional employee wellness programs

Application Details:
This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.
To apply, please visit the Insulet Careers site and submit your application online.

Actual pay depends on skills, experience, and education.

Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD), headquartered in Massachusetts, is an innovative medical device company dedicated to simplifying life for people with diabetes and other conditions through its Omnipod product platform. The Omnipod Insulin Management System provides a unique alternative to traditional insulin delivery methods. With its simple, wearable design, the tubeless disposable Pod provides up to three days of non-stop insulin delivery, without the need to see or handle a needle. Insulet’s flagship innovation, the Omnipod 5 Automated Insulin Delivery System, integrates with a continuous glucose monitor to manage blood sugar with no multiple daily injections, zero fingersticks, and can be controlled by a compatible personal smartphone in the U.S. or by the Omnipod 5 Controller. Insulet also leverages the unique design of its Pod by tailoring its Omnipod technology platform for the delivery of non-insulin subcutaneous drugs across other therapeutic areas. For more information, please visit insulet.com and omnipod.com.
 
 
We are looking for highly motivated, performance-driven individuals to be a part of our expanding team. We do this by hiring amazing people guided by shared values who exceed customer expectations. Our continued success depends on it!

At Insulet Corporation all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

( Know Your Rights )

new_roles.description:
**Michael Kors is always interested in hearing from talented, globally-minded individuals with a passion for fashion.**

**If you enjoy working in a creative, fast-paced environment, then we would love to hear from you!**

—

**Who You Are:**

The Senior Manager, Global Visual Merchandising Production will lead the strategic planning, creative execution, and global production of visual merchandising activations across the Michael Kors retail network. This role is responsible for delivering innovative, brand-elevating experiences that drive customer engagement while ensuring operational excellence, fiscal responsibility, and flawless execution worldwide.

 

Working closely with Global Visual Experience, Store Design, Marketing, Creative Services, Supply Chain, and regional partners, the Senior Manager will oversee the end-to-end production lifecycle for seasonal campaigns, retail environments, windows, in-store experiences, and new store openings. This role will also lead vendor strategy, production innovation, and team development to support the continued growth of the brand globally.

 

**What You’ll Do:**

**Strategic Leadership**

* Define and lead the global production strategy for all Visual Merchandising assets, while providing direct leadership and oversight for the North America region, ensuring alignment with brand, business, and market objectives.
* Own the performance and evolution of the global production function, including operating models, production capabilities, quality standards, vendor networks, and operational effectiveness.
* Establish scalable production processes, governance, and resource strategies that support current business priorities and future growth across North America, EMEA, and APAC.
* Serve as the strategic advisor to Visual Merchandising, Design, and Creative teams, influencing decisions related to feasibility, engineering, materials, fabrication, innovation, and investment priorities.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance speed-to-market, scalability, sustainability, quality, and cost efficiency while maintaining brand integrity.
* Champion the adoption of AI-enabled tools and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, enhance decision-making, and identify opportunities to simplify and modernize Visual Merchandising production process globally.

**Global Production Management**

* Lead the end-to-end production lifecycle for all global Visual Merchandising programs, including windows, props, visual tools, branded environments, animations, and special activations.
* Oversee planning, budgeting, fabrication, logistics, installation, and execution across retail, outlet, wholesale, and special project channels.
* Ensure all programs are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality, craftsmanship, and brand consistency.
* Drive cross-functional project management across multiple concurrent initiatives, balancing competing priorities, business needs, and market requirements.
* Proactively identify executional risks and develop mitigation plans to ensure successful delivery across regions and stakeholders.

**Financial & Vendor Management**

* Own global production budget planning, forecasting, capital investment recommendations, and overall financial performance.
* Develop cost optimization strategies and scalable sourcing models that improve efficiency without compromising quality, customer experience, or brand standards.
* Build and manage strategic partnerships with fabricators, printers, logistics providers, installation partners, and other key vendors worldwide.
* Establish vendor performance metrics, accountability measures, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure best-in-class execution.
* Evaluate production investments, operating models, and resource requirements, providing recommendations based on business impact, risk, and return on investment.

**Executive Influence & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as the senior production partner to Visual Merchandising, Store Design, Marketing, Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain, and regional leadership teams.
* Influence decision-making through data-driven recommendations, business acumen, and a comprehensive understanding of brand, customer, operational, and financial priorities.
* Build alignment across functions and regions while balancing competing priorities to achieve the best overall business outcome.
* Represent the production function in senior leadership discussions, ensuring production considerations are incorporated into broader business planning.
* Lead organizational change initiatives and drive adoption of new processes, technologies, and ways of working that improve operational effectiveness globally.

**Team & Organizational Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing production team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Build organizational capability by developing future leaders, strengthening succession plans, and creating scalable ways of working.
* Establish clear performance expectations, operating rhythms, and development plans that enable increasing levels of ownership and autonomy across the team.
* Allocate resources strategically to ensure effective execution across a complex portfolio of global initiatives.
Create an environment where proactive problem-solving, strategic thinking, and enterprise leadership are expected at all levels. 

 

**You’ll Need to Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Production Management, Design, Construction Management or a related field.
* PMP certification or equivalent project management credentials preferred.
* 7-10 years of progressive experience in visual production, retail marketing production, environmental design, experiential production, or related fields.
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing high-performing teams in a global environment.
* Proven success leading large-scale, multi-market production programs within a premium or luxury retail organization.
* Strong expertise in project management, fabrication, print production, logistics, and installation processes.
Experience managing multimillion-dollar budgets and complex vendor ecosystems. 

 

**We’d Love to See:**

* Exceptional leadership, communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to translate creative vision into operational execution.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Expertise in vendor negotiations, contract management, and cost optimization.
* Strong analytical and financial acumen.
* Highly collaborative with experience working across global, matrixed organizations.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, project management platforms, and collaborative workplace tools.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager - Level 1 Operations
new_roles.description:
Pico fuels the global capital markets community by providing exceptional market data services and customized managed infrastructure solutions. As financial industry experts at the center of markets and technology, we help our clients efficiently scale their business and quickly access markets. From infrastructure to connectivity, we support our clients through the full trading lifecycle. We are a global company headquartered in New York, with offices in Chicago, London, Singapore, Hong Kong and Tokyo.

**Role Description**

Pico powers the global capital markets community with high-performance market data services and tailored managed infrastructure solutions. As financial industry experts at the intersection of markets and technology, we help clients scale efficiently and access markets quickly. From infrastructure to connectivity, we support our clients across the full trading lifecycle. Pico is headquartered in New York, with offices in Chicago, London, Dublin, Madrid, Krakow, Singapore, Hong Kong, South Korea, and Tokyo.

 

**Title:** Senior Manager, Level 1 Operations

 

**About the Role**

Pico is looking for a Senior Manager, Level 1 Operations to lead its global Level 1 technical operations function supporting financial markets infrastructure. The role combines accountability for operational performance, technical capability, people development and the quality of incident response and client communication.

Pico operates mission-critical, low-latency technology supporting banks, hedge funds, asset managers, broker-dealers and other financial market participants. The Level 1 team sits at the front line of that environment and is responsible for rapid detection, triage, communication and escalation of service-impacting issues.

This is not a traditional service desk management role.

The Senior Manager, Level 1 Operations will be accountable for developing a technically strong, customer-focused operations function capable of taking meaningful ownership of incidents from the moment they are detected or reported. Alongside operational delivery, the role will drive improvements to tooling and processes and develop talent across the team. The team is expected to conduct effective first-line diagnosis across network, connectivity, server and platform domains, establish technical direction during the early stages of an incident and engage the appropriate Level 2 or engineering teams with clear evidence and context. The successful candidate will combine people leadership, strong technical judgement, incident management and excellent client communication. They will be comfortable leading critical incidents involving senior internal stakeholders, clients, carriers and technology partners while maintaining calm, structure and urgency.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operational Leadership**

* Own the day-to-day operational performance of the global Level 1 team.
* Ensure operational queues and monitoring are actively managed and that nothing falls between shifts, regions or technical teams.
* Establish and track service management performance metrics covering response and triage times, escalation quality, queue health, shift-handover quality and client communication.
* Agree targets with Operations Management, review trends across shifts and regions, and use the findings to drive corrective action.
* Drive a prioritised roadmap for Level 1 tooling improvements, working with technical teams to improve monitoring, alert quality, workflow automation and operational visibility.
* Own continuous improvement of Level 1 processes, including triage, escalation, shift handovers, runbooks and knowledge management. Use incident reviews, service data and feedback from regional leads to prioritise changes, embed adoption and verify their effectiveness.

 

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach and develop the Level 1 Operations Engineers, working with the regional leads in AMRS, APAC and EMEA to translate global priorities into regional delivery and maintain consistent technical, behavioural and service standards.
* Work with regional leads to translate global priorities into clear local responsibilities, delegate operational ownership and review delivery against agreed standards across shifts and regions.
* Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews and career development discussions.
* Develop future technical authorities, technical specialists and team leaders from within Level 1.

**Incident Management**

* Act as the senior point of escalation for the Level 1 team and the regional leads in AMRS, APAC and EMEA when incidents, operational risks or service issues require senior direction, cross-region coordination or decisions beyond regional authority. Take ownership of the escalation and coordinate the appropriate technical and management response.
* Lead real-time technical triage across network, platform, server and connectivity domains.
* Direct incident bridges involving clients, senior stakeholders, Network Operations, Platform Operations, engineering teams, carriers and third-party providers.
* Ensure incidents are correctly prioritised and escalated based on technical and customer impact.
* Drive improvements in MTTR, first-line diagnosis and incident quality.

 

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Ensure consistently high standards of client communication throughout incidents and service requests.
* Communicate confidently with senior client and internal stakeholders during high-pressure situations.
* Ensure updates are technically accurate, concise, timely and appropriate for the audience.
* Work closely with Operations Management and technical teams to ensure a consistent service narrative.
* Reinforce a customer-centric rather than ticket-centric approach throughout the team.

 

**Experience and Qualifications**

 

**Essential**

* 10+ years' experience in technical operations, infrastructure support, network operations, production support or a comparable mission-critical environment.
* Demonstrable experience managing or leading technical operations/support engineers within a 24x7 or follow the sun environment, including coordinating delivery across regions and working with regional or shift leads to maintain consistent service standards.
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes or related frameworks for incident management.
* Experience leading significant incidents and technical bridges.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting ability with the technical judgement to assess first-line diagnosis across network, connectivity, server and platform domains, challenge assumptions and recognise when specialist escalation is required.
* Experience establishing KPIs and improving operational performance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Confidence communicating directly with senior client and internal stakeholders.
* Demonstrable ownership mentality and ability to operate effectively under pressure.

 

**Highly Desirable**

* Experience in financial services, fintech, electronic trading or low-latency infrastructure.
* Previous experience in a telecommunications or managed service provider environment.
* Experience with monitoring and infrastructure management tooling.
* Experience with Salesforce, Jira, SolarWinds Orion, or Device42.
* ITIL certification or similar service management qualification.
* Strong networking fundamentals, particularly TCP/IP, routing, switching and BGP at a CCNA level or higher.
* Good working knowledge of Linux/Unix.

 

**Working Arrangements**

This is an office-based position with a minimum of two days office attendance per week. Occasional travel may be required, but it is not expected to be regular or frequent. The core business hours to be covered by the role are 09:00 – 18:00, Monday to Friday. The role holder will be expected to work the hours necessary to perform this role, recognizing it supports multiple jurisdictions/geographies including (but not limited to) EMEA, AMRS, and APAC. Out-of-hours escalation arrangements and availability expectations will be agreed and communicated explicitly; the team's 24/7 coverage does not imply continuous personal availability.

 

**IMPORTANT DATA PRIVACY INFORMATION:**

This position is available with Pico Services Inc. The controller of your personal data will be Pico Services Inc.

For further information on what personal data we collect, how we will process your personal data and your rights with respect to your personal data please read our Pico Job Candidate Privacy Notice, View Here.

Be a part of Pico Family

Pico is an equal opportunity employer. Pico does not discriminate on the basis of a candidate's age, race, gender, color, religion, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, or other non-merit factors. All employment decisions at Pico are based on business needs, job requirements and qualifications. If you require any assistance or accommodations to be made for the recruitment process, please inform us when you submit your online application.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager - Process Engineering - Walker, MI Plant
new_roles.description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world.A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

**Job Summary**
---------------





**General Purpose** **:**

Responsible for leading and developing a team of process engineers and technicians responsible for SMT manufacturing processes and continuous improvement. Provides technical and organizational leadership to establish and improve manufacturing process capabilities, increase capacity and throughput, reduce cost, improve quality and reliability, and support successful introduction of new products. Partners closely with Operations, Quality, Product Engineering, NPI, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and other functional teams to ensure manufacturing processes meet customer, quality, delivery, cost, and capacity requirements.

**Principal Accountabilities** **:**

* Lead, coach, develop, and manage a team of process engineers and technicians supporting SMT manufacturing, including board printing, SPI, pick and place, reflow, AOI, X-ray, and other back-end operations, excluding Box Assembly.

* Establish clear goals, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans for engineering team members. Provide regular coaching, feedback, performance management, and career development.

* Establish, maintain, and continuously improve process capabilities to achieve required levels of quality, reliability, throughput, capacity, and cost.

* Develop and maintain process documentation, including work instructions, PFMEA, Control Plans, process specifications, and other applicable manufacturing documentation.

* Lead engineering efforts to identify and eliminate process variation, defects, scrap, rework, downtime, and other sources of manufacturing inefficiency.

* Use data-driven problem-solving and appropriate engineering methodologies, including statistical analysis, SPC, DOE, root-cause analysis, and structured corrective action, to resolve complex manufacturing issues.

* Develop and maintain appropriate engineering and manufacturing performance metrics.

OEE, scrap, and yield to name a few

* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, collaboration, problem solving, and ownership within the engineering organization.

* Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, tools, standards, and best practices and share lessons learned across the organization.

* Ensure engineering activities comply with applicable safety, environmental, quality-system, regulatory, customer, and company requirements.

* Build effective relationships with internal and external customers, suppliers, equipment manufacturers, and other technical partners as required.

* Communicate engineering priorities, project status, risks, resource requirements, and recommendations effectively to site and senior leadership.

* Implement appropriate HR strategies and actions to recruit, retain, develop, and motivate a qualified and high-performing engineering workforce.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

**EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE:**

Requires a bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience and training. A Master's or MBA degree is a plus but not required.

Typically requires **9 years** of engineering experience, including experience leading or supervising engineering personnel. Experience in high-volume electronics manufacturing and SMT processes is strongly preferred.

 

**KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / ABILITIES:**

* Demonstrated functional, technical, and people-management skills, with the ability to lead engineers and technicians in a manufacturing environment.

* Strong knowledge of SMT manufacturing processes, including solder paste printing, SPI, pick and place, reflow, AOI, X-ray, and related manufacturing processes.

* Demonstrated understanding of process capability, statistical process control, root-cause analysis, DOE, PFMEA, Control Plans, and structured continuous improvement methodologies.

* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence decisions across Engineering, Operations, Quality, NPI, Product Engineering, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and other functions.

* Ability to establish priorities, allocate resources, manage competing projects, and make sound engineering and business decisions.

* Demonstrated ability to use manufacturing and engineering data to identify problems, establish facts, determine root causes, and drive measurable improvements.

* Strong understanding of manufacturing economics, including cost reduction, capacity, throughput, capital investment, and return on investment.

* Demonstrated ability to develop, coach, and retain engineering talent and build a high-performing team.

* Strong interpersonal, communication, presentation, and organizational skills.

* Ability to communicate complex technical information effectively to engineers, technicians, operations personnel, customers, and senior management.

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex technical, engineering, financial, and business documents.

* Ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries and complaints and resolve complex issues using sound judgment and appropriate communication.

* Ability to make effective and persuasive presentations regarding technical recommendations, business cases, project status, and complex engineering issues.

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts including probability, statistical inference, process capability, and statistical analysis and apply them to practical manufacturing situations.

* Ability to define problems, collect and analyze data, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, and develop practical solutions.

* Demonstrated proficiency with common engineering and business software, including word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, data analysis, and other applicable manufacturing/engineering systems.

* Working knowledge of applicable employment laws, company policies, and HR practices.

**What you'll receive for the great work you provide:**

* Full range of medical, dental, and vision plans
* Life Insurance
* Short-term and Long-term Disability
* Matching 401(k) Contributions
* Vacation and Paid Sick Time
* Tuition Reimbursement
