new_roles.title: Director Engineering Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Job ID: 116026**

 

The Leonardo DRS Naval Electronics business provides leading naval computing infrastructure, network and data distribution and middleware enterprise services, as well as world-class manufacturing and support capabilities.

**Business Unit**: Naval Electronics
 
**Location**: Eagan, MN
 
**Career Functional Area**: Engineering
 
**Telework Type**: Hybrid
 
**Travel Expectation**: 30%
 
**Schedule**: 9/80

**Job Summary**
---------------

Responsible for establishing and continuously improving the processes, tools, and data-management practices that enable disciplined, compliant, and efficient engineering execution across all programs. Own engineering configuration-management standards, processes and execution releasing the E BOM. Monitor the quality of engineering deliverables identifying opportunities of improvement.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Engineering Process Ownership and Excellence**

* Define, deploy, maintain, and continuously improve standardized engineering processes, procedures, work instructions, templates
* Ensure engineering processes are practical for program execution while meeting applicable customer, contractual, quality, regulatory, cybersecurity, and internal requirements.
* Establish process ownership, approval authorities, compliance expectations, training requirements, and periodic process-review cycles.
* Lead process maturity assessments, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and implement corrective and preventive improvements.

**Engineering Tools and Digital Strategy**

* Define the engineering tools strategy, roadmap, governance model, and deployment plans in partnership with Engineering, IT, Quality, Supply Chain, and program teams.
* Lead deployment, adoption, administration requirements, user support models, and continuous improvement of engineering tools, including product lifecycle management, requirements management, analysis, collaboration, and configuration-management tools.
* Ensure tools, workflows, data structures, and integrations support disciplined engineering execution, traceability, release control, and reliable engineering data.
* Capture user and program needs; prioritize enhancements, integrations, and new capabilities based on business value, risk reduction, compliance, and program demand.

**Engineering Configuration Management**

* Own the engineering configuration-management process, standards, governance, and associated tool workflows.
* Establish common rules for engineering baselines, configuration identification, revision control, change management, release authorization, and configuration-status accounting.
* Ensure configuration-management processes support full traceability between requirements, drawings, parts, assemblies, bills of material, changes, verification evidence, and released product definition.
* Define the governance framework for configuration control boards and ensure appropriate technical, quality, programmatic, manufacturing, supply-chain, and customer inputs are incorporated where required.

**Job Responsibilities (Cont.)**
--------------------------------

**Program Configuration-Management Support**

* Provide configuration-management process leadership and tailored support to programs from proposal through product support.
* Support development, review, and maintenance of program Configuration Management Plans and related configuration-management deliverables.
* Establish program-specific configuration baselines, release schedules, change-control workflows, approval matrices, and reporting appropriate to contractual and product requirements.
* Support programs in resolving configuration-management issues, ensuring timely decisions and minimizing release, production, and customer-impact risk.

**Product-Definition Data Integrity**

* Govern the processes for drawing-number creation, part-number assignment, nomenclature, document classification, and engineering-data release.
* Ensure new drawing and part numbers are created, controlled, and uniquely identified in accordance with approved standards and system rules.
* Establish validation controls for engineering drawings, parts, assemblies, and engineering bills of material (EBOMs), including consistency, completeness, revision alignment, and traceability.
* Monitor the integrity of released product-definition data and drive resolution of discrepancies that could affect procurement, manufacturing, verification, sustainment, or customer deliverables.

**Engineering Deliverable Quality and Performance Monitoring**

* Define the quality criteria, review expectations, and performance measures for engineering deliverables.
* Monitor the quality, completeness, timeliness, and first-pass acceptance of engineering outputs, including requirements artifacts, drawings, specifications, analysis reports, test documentation, change packages, and released product data.
* Analyze defects, rework, late changes, release escapes, configuration discrepancies, and recurring nonconformities to identify systemic causes and improvement opportunities.
* Provide leadership with regular visibility into engineering-process performance, deliverable quality trends, compliance risks, and recommended corrective actions.

**Continuous Improvement and Assurance**

* Lead improvement initiatives that strengthen engineering execution, reduce rework, improve data quality, and increase delivery predictability.
* Develop and recommend improvement actions based on performance data, audit findings, lessons learned, user feedback, program needs, and changes in business or customer requirements.
* Verify the effectiveness of implemented improvements and maintain an actionable backlog of process, tool, and data-governance enhancements.
* Support internal and external audits by maintaining objective evidence of process compliance, configuration control, tool governance, and engineering-data integrity.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; advanced degree or relevant professional certification preferred
* 10+ years of progressive experience in engineering, engineering operations, configuration management, PLM, quality, or systems engineering within a complex and regulated product environment.
* 5+ years in a leadership role responsible for engineering processes, tools, configuration management, quality, or operational excellence.
* Experience developing and deploying engineering processes, governance controls, workflows, and performance measures.
* Experience leading implementation and improvement of engineering tools, including PLM, requirements-management, design-data management, and configuration-management systems.
* Practical experience with Configuration Management Plans, engineering change control, drawing and part-number management, release control, and EBOM validation.
* Proven record of improving engineering deliverable quality, data integrity, process compliance, and operational efficiency

**Additional Qualifications**
-----------------------------

* Strong knowledge of engineering product-development processes, configuration management, product-data control, and engineering release practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders in a matrix organization.
* Strong analytical, communication, and continuous-improvement skills

**U.S. Citizenship required. This position requires an active DOD security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.**

*The salary range for this position is $161,180/year- $250,000/year. This range reflects the good faith estimate of pay the employer is willing to offer at the time of posting. Several factors can influence the pay scale, including but not limited to: Federal contract labor categories and contract wage rates, collective bargaining agreements, geographic location, business considerations, scope, and responsibilities of the position, local or other applicable market conditions, and internal equity. Other factors include the candidate’s qualifications such as prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education/training, and certifications. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for: annual performance-based bonuses, equity awards, and overtime pay (for non-exempt employees as applicable. Our benefits package includes comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision), employer matching 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off including vacation, holidays, and sick leave (including ant state-mandated paid sick leave), parental leave benefits, tuition reimbursement, professional development support, and life and disability insurance coverage.*

 

*Taking care of our people is a top priority at Leonardo DRS. We are proud to offer competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a company contribution to a health savings account, telemedicine, life and disability insurance, legal insurance, and a 401(k) savings plan. We champion wellness programs that focus on physical, emotional, and financial well-being. We develop our talent by offering programs and activities to support career-growth, professional development, and skill enhancement. And we understand there is more to life than work, and the importance of offering flexible work schedules with our 9/80 program, competitive vacation, health/emergency leave, paid parental leave, and community service hours.* 

* *Some employees are eligible for limited benefits only*

 

*Leonardo DRS, Inc. and its subsidiaries provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.*

new_roles.description:
**Build Your Career with Ashley Furniture- Where Innovation Meets Comfort**

**Who We Are:**

At Ashley, inspiring the love of home is at the heart of everything we do. As the world’s largest manufacturer of home furnishings, we’re more than a business — we’re a family driven by innovation, competitiveness, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. We persevere through challenges, push beyond the status quo, and constantly seek better ways to deliver an exceptional customer experience. Our solutions-first mindset and dedication to growth are why Ashley remains #1 in our industry.

If you’re ready to grow, you’ve come to the right place. With a true “Growth Mindset,” Ashley Furniture invests in developing future leaders and helps every team member learn from the best in the business.

 

**If you are a current Ashley employee**: Please login to your UKG account and apply using the internal job board.

 

**Summary:**

The Ashley Home Delivery (AHD) Operational Excellence Director provides centralized leadership for operational planning, routing, process development, project execution, vendor governance, performance management, and organizational coordination across Ashley Home Delivery. This role translates strategy into repeatable operating standards, disciplined execution, measurable performance, and scalable support.

The Director partners with field leadership and cross-functional teams to improve customer experience, delivery performance, carrier accountability, cost effectiveness, and launch readiness, enabling Regional Directors and market leaders to remain focused on field execution.

**Responsibilities:**

**Operational Planning & Routing**

* Lead the centralized routing organization, establishing operating rhythms, service standards, workload allocation, escalation paths, and accountability.
* Own delivery forecasting, capacity planning, route-planning governance, and resource alignment across AHD markets.
* Develop, document, deploy, and audit routing standards that support safe, efficient, reliable, and customer-focused delivery execution.
* Partner with field leaders to identify capacity constraints, route-quality issues, and execution risks, coordinating corrective actions as needed.

**Operational Excellence**

* Lead the development, maintenance, communication, and adoption of standard operating procedures across Ashley Home Delivery.
* Design and continuously improve end-to-end processes for stand-up, load-out, route monitoring, check-in, returns, recovery, beginning-of-day controls, and end-of-day controls.
* Develop validation, compliance, and audit tools to ensure operating standards are understood, adopted, and sustained.
* Drive continuous improvement through data analysis, root-cause analysis, structured problem-solving, and field feedback.
* Establish governance and documentation processes that preserve institutional knowledge and keep operating standards current.

**3PL & Vendor Management**

* Lead carrier sourcing, due diligence, onboarding, implementation, and performance governance in partnership with Procurement, Legal, Finance, Risk, and AHD leadership.
* Establish consistent business reviews, escalation processes, relationship-management routines, and service expectations for delivery partners.
* Provide leadership for the AHD Claims team and governance of claims administration, disputes, documentation, approval controls, and timely resolution.
* Oversee invoice validation and payment-administration processes, including controls that support accuracy, transparency, and accountability.
* Support contract improvements and ensure approved terms, service levels, and operating requirements are effectively implemented.

**Performance Management**

* Develop and maintain national AHD KPI definitions, reporting standards, scorecards, forecasts, and performance dashboards.
* Establish management routines connecting daily operating controls, weekly business reviews, action plans, and executive-level visibility.
* Analyze performance trends and operational gaps, identify root causes, establish accountable owners, and track corrective actions through resolution.
* Provide decision-ready reporting on customer experience, delivery reliability, productivity, capacity, cost, claims, and carrier performance.

**Strategic Projects & Launch Execution**

* Lead program and project management for AHD market launches, conversions, expansions, and national operational initiatives.
* Establish launch-readiness plans covering schedules, staffing, training, travel, uniforms, fleet, equipment, routing, carrier readiness, communications, and operating controls.
* Coordinate cross-functional implementation activities, manage dependencies and risks, and maintain clear milestones, decisions, ownership, and status reporting.
* Drive post-launch adoption and ensure new processes, tools, contracts, and standards become embedded in routine operations.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and deploy assigned AHD support resources against the highest-priority operational and strategic needs.
* Establish clear roles, decision rights, service expectations, workload priorities, and performance standards for centralized support functions.
* Build a high-accountability, service-oriented culture that partners effectively with Regional Directors, site leaders, carriers, and cross-functional teams.
* Coach and develop team members through ongoing feedback, development planning, and recommendations regarding staffing, selection, recognition, and performance actions in accordance with company policy.

**Qualifications:**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in operations, transportation, logistics, supply chain, home delivery, final mile, or a related field.
* 5+ years of leadership experience with responsibility for teams, operational programs, or multi-site/multi-market operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading operational excellence, process improvement, performance management, and large-scale implementation initiatives.
* Experience managing third-party carriers, 3PL providers, vendors, or outsourced delivery operations.
* Experience developing and managing KPIs, scorecards, operating reviews, and performance improvement plans.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional projects from planning through implementation and sustained adoption.

**Additional Qualifications, Preferred**

* Experience in final-mile delivery, retail distribution, home delivery, furniture delivery, or similar customer-facing logistics operations.
* Strong knowledge of routing, capacity planning, delivery forecasting, carrier management, and operational controls.
* Experience developing SOPs, governance frameworks, compliance processes, and audit programs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate operational data into clear business actions.
* Proven ability to influence field and cross-functional leaders in a matrixed environment.
* Strong project and change-management capabilities with experience managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to travel as business needs require.

**Annual Salary: $130,000 - $160,000**

**Benefits We Offer:**

* Health, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program
* Paid Time Off; increases with years of service
* Generous Employee Discount on home furnishings
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Tuition Assistance
* Ashley Wellness Centers (location specific)
* 401(k) and Profit Sharing
* Life Insurance

**Our Core Values:**

* **Honesty & Integrity:** Acts with transparency, discretion, and ethical judgment. Trusted to handle sensitive information and provide accurate, unbiased insights.

* **Dirty Fingernail:** Takes full accountability for outcomes, not just tasks. Inspects details, ensures data accuracy, and follows through to completion.

* **Continuous Improvement:** Actively seeks better ways to improve templates, tools, and processes. Learns from prior initiatives and embeds lessons into standard work.

* **Growth & Results Focus:** Understands how transformation initiatives drive growth, cost reduction, and profitability. Keeps work aligned to enterprise priorities.

* **Culture of Leadership**: Leads through influence, reliability, and example. Builds trust across functions and supports leaders at every level.

* **Customer-Centric & Boundaryless:** Works across silos for the greater good of the organization. Ensures outputs meet the needs of executives, initiative owners, and teams.

* **Operational Excellence:** Demonstrates strong organizational discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to translate ambiguity into clear, executable tools.

 

Interested in learning more about Ashley Furniture’s Community Engagement programs, Environmental Stewardship, or our Core Values, click the links below:

**Corporate Social Responsibility** (https://www.ashleyfurniture.com/about-us/corporate-social-responsibility/report/)

**View Our Corporate Brochure** (https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ashleyfurnitureindustriesllc.com%2Fen%2Fcorporate-brochure&data=05%7C02%7CShLee%40Ashleyfurniture.com%7C7380207222ee4e223aea08dd96e531de%7C5a9d9cfdc32e4ac1a9edfe83df4f9e4d%7C0%7C0%7C638832633331666148%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=wNmuyaqBcPo%2FSsLdHmzI%2F3XX3FQf%2Fjy3iHyYUhbP8V8%3D&reserved=0)

new_roles.description:
At E Tech Group, joining our team means joining a group of passionate and forward-thinking experts. We're one of the largest engineering and system integration firms in the United States providing value for our clients through IT automation and control solutions for more than 30 years to the Life Sciences, Mission Critical, Metals & Mining, Warehousing & Distribution, and CPG/Food & Beverage industries. Our national and global scale allows us to help our clients develop and implement standardized solutions at any of their facilities regardless of physical location or the local resources available at that site.

We're adding to our team! We are seeking an **Operational Excellence****Director** to lead the optimization of workflows and play a key role in the continuous improvement across all projects and operations. This role ensures alignment with industry best practices, including CSIA Best Practices, while driving consistent, high-quality delivery in automation and integration projects.

**You will:**

* Ensure workflows meet E Tech Group and Business Unit quality policies, procedures, CSIA Best Practices, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct internal audits to evaluate adherence to standards, practical efficiency of associated tools, assess root-cause failure modes, and support corrective and preventive actions.
* Business Unit representative for E Tech's Continuous Improvement Committee, providing practical suggestions and solutions, communicating with Business Unit leadership.
* Analyze project execution workflows to identify and remove bottlenecks, directly improving project lead times and margin predictability.
* Identify and champion the use of digital tools and AI to automate repetitive administrative tasks, reducing 'process friction' for engineering teams.
* Represent the Business Unit for Customer and third party audits, including audit preparation, participation, response coordination, and follow up.
* Foster quality, consistency, and ongoing improvement across cross-functional teams.
* Support Corporate Continuous Improvement initiatives including development and review of policies and procedures.
* Lead Business Unit continuous improvement activities.
* Provide necessary supplemental training and guidance to the Business Unit on quality standards, procedures, and expectations.
* Provide support to improve the quality and effectiveness of the Learning Management System (LMS)
* Encourage collaboration, shared learning, and knowledge transfer across teams throughout the Company
* Collaborate with Sales, Application Engineering, and the Project Management Organization to support project risk assessments, and quality planning.
* Attend project reviews, as needed, and provide guidance to project teams for compliance with Project Management Life Cycle (PMLC) and System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and other procedures during project execution.
* Interface with clients and third parties on quality related topics, including audits, vendor qualification, and compliance inquiries.
* Be an ambassador who embodies our Core Values, prioritizing the success of E Tech Group, our clients, and the professional development of our associates.

 

**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical or Systems), or related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Over seven years of experience in process improvement and engineering performance within technical, project-driven settings. Proven track record in supporting process optimization, waste reduction, quality assurance, compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives in engineering or project environments.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to influence technical teams and stakeholders
* Experience working in automation, life sciences or other regulated industries, prefer knowledge of ISO 9001, GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, and Computer System Assurance (CSA).
* Experience supporting automation and control systems (PLC, DCS, SCADA, HMI).
* A DNA comprised of collaboration and teamwork.

 

**Benefits & Perks:**

* 401k + match + prompt enrollment. E Tech Group employees are 100% vested upon entry.
* Prompt enrollment into Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
* Generous paid time off that includes paid vacation, paid holidays, paid family leave and sick time off.
* Learning and growth are key parts of the E Tech culture. We provide you with training and continuing education from day one, so you can advance your career. As an E Tech associate, you can unlock your greatest potential through challenges and opportunities.

Salary Range: $150,000-$170,000

*E Tech Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, military status, genetic information, gender identity, sexual orientation, citizenship status, or any other basis prohibited by law. E Tech Group will provide reasonable* *accommodations* *to qualified individuals with disabilities and for religious beliefs. E Tech Group is an Affirmative Action Employer of individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.*

identity_held_roles.title: Director of Manufacturing Process Engineering
identity_held_roles.description:
**Job Summary**
The Director of Manufacturing Process Engineering is a hands-on leadership role and the process authority for how Butcher Power Products’ switchboard and switchgear products are built. The person in this role must be the subject-matter expert who can also do the work — capable of designing and improving manufacturing processes and line layouts, building routings and process documentation, and personally leading process and PFMEA reviews — so they can teach and develop the manufacturing engineering team and set the standard for process quality. This role owns how products are built rather than what is designed; however, deep familiarity with the product and the production floor is essential. The Director must understand the design intent released by Product Engineering and the realities of the floor in order to engineer processes that are efficient, repeatable, and capable. This role works hand in hand with Product Engineering as the manufacturing voice in the design process, partners with Quality on process controls, and supports Production and Planning rather than owning them.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Hands-On Process Engineering: Personally design, document, and improve the manufacturing processes, routings, work instructions, and line layouts that build the product. This is a working role: the successful candidate stays actively engaged in process design and technical problem-solving alongside the team rather than delegating all hands-on work.
* Process Authority & Technical Review: Lead, critique, and approve the team’s process designs, routings, PFMEAs, and control plans; set and enforce the standard for process quality, capability, and engineering rigor through formal process reviews.
* Mentorship & Teaching: Coach, train, and develop manufacturing engineers and technicians in process design, tooling, DFM/DFA, Lean and Six Sigma, time studies, and structured problem-solving, raising the technical capability of the whole team.
* Leadership & Management: Lead and manage the manufacturing engineering team, including hiring, development, workload balancing, priorities, and performance.
* Process Strategy & Standardization: Own manufacturing process strategy and standardization across product lines, and define the tooling and capital equipment roadmap.
* Product Engineering Partnership (DFM): Work closely and continuously with Product Engineering as the manufacturing voice in the design process — provide manufacturability and assembly feedback at design reviews before release, jointly resolve producibility issues, and ensure released designs transition cleanly into production.
* Process Controls & Quality Partnership: Own the manufacturing side of PFMEAs and control plans in partnership with Quality Engineering; ensure processes are capable, controlled, and continuously monitored.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen across the function to improve throughput, cycle time, yield, and cost.
* Capital, Tooling & Automation: Plan and justify capital equipment, tooling, and automation investments, and provide financial management of the manufacturing engineering capital and tooling budgets.
* New Product Introduction (NPI): Lead the process side of NPI — develop and validate the processes, tooling, and routings that bring newly released designs into production.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Production, Planning, Quality, Project Management, and Product Engineering on capacity, scheduling, and material flow, supporting these functions rather than owning them.
* Safety & Compliance: Ensure manufacturing processes across the function comply with safety, environmental, and regulatory standards, including UL 891, NEC, and ANSI.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Industrial, or Mechanical Engineering.
* 8+ years of progressive process engineering (or directly related) experience, including significant time spent personally developing and improving manufacturing processes.
* Hands-on proficiency in SolidWorks for process documentation, line layouts, and reviews; the ability to design tooling and fixtures in CAD is a plus.
* Strong proficiency developing routings, work instructions, process documentation, and process controls.
* Proven ability to lead formal process and PFMEA reviews and to mentor and train engineers and technicians.
* Experience hiring, developing, and managing a manufacturing engineering team.
* Strong working knowledge of PFMEA, control plans, SPC, and process capability (Cpk).
* Deep knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong understanding of the products being built and of how design intent translates into manufacturing process — sufficient product familiarity to engineer the right processes.
* Working knowledge of UL 891 and related standards (NEC, ANSI) as they affect manufacturing processes.
* Experience planning and justifying capital equipment and tooling investments, including financial management of budgets.
* Hands-on fabrication and machining experience is a plus.
* Automation experience is a plus.
* Experience with structured problem-solving methods such as 8D or A3 is a plus.
* Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems, particularly Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365).
* Excellent leadership, project management, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on manufacturing process design and improvement (CAD)
* Process authority and engineering quality standards

identity_held_roles.description:
Work Model: This role can be performed remotely from an approved location, with flexibility based on business needs and applicable requirements.
 
 
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
 
 
Regal Rexnord Business System (“RBS”) plays a pivotal role in driving organizational change and process improvement to achieve our business objectives. The
**Linear Motion Division**
(“LMD”) within the AMC segment is seeking a
**Director of RBS**
. Reporting to the President of the Division, this position will drive the implementation, maturity, and cultural adoption of RBS and continuous process improvement across the division.
 
 
This leadership position is focused on the deployment of RBS across the Division to drive both short and long-term goals and will partner closely with LMD’s leadership team, as well as the AMC RBS team. The right candidate will drive operational excellence, develop CI capability, and ensure alignment to strategic priorities through Policy Deployment. This leader influences across manufacturing sites, functional teams, and the broader AMC organization to deliver year-over-year performance improvement. As a key member of the AMC RBS Team, this role will impact results and culture by establishing standards, institutionalizing management systems and ensuring effective problem-solving skills (& tool capability) across the organization.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 
**Continuous Improvement Leadership and Standard Work**

* Champion the Lean philosophy and its deployment across all functions and manufacturing sites.
* Support the organization in achieving SQDCG and financial objectives through effective application of the RBS tools and methodologies to achieve continuous improvement.
* Develop and drive the divisional CI Roadmap and ensure alignment to site-level plans.
* Lead, guide, and help create solutions for highly complex and multi-faceted problems requiring ingenuity, creativity, innovation, and strong analytical skills. Problems are unique and require a thorough understanding of operating unit policies and practices. Apply knowledge of different techniques and practices to achieve desired results
* Connect operational improvements (e.g., machine productivity, labor productivity, lead time/turnaround time, quality, backlog, capacity, OEE, etc.) to financial outcomes (Revenue/TVOS, Cost, Cash, Margin).
* Participate in the hiring, development and coaching of site continuous improvement leaders.
* Utilize a team-oriented structured problem-solving approach to analyze current conditions, diagnose problems, and identify improvement opportunities.

**Capability and Talent Development**

* Support Division and Site RBS leaders in maturing the Regal Rexnord Business System through the development of skills, capabilities, and engagement driving impact to the next level.
* Coach, mentor, and train Regal Rexnord associates on CI tools and Lean leadership.
* Develop RBS capability through formal training and “stop-and-teach” coaching at Gemba.
* Lead and coach multiple projects and Kaizen events simultaneously through both a hands-on and influential approach.
* Engage and influence teams at all levels to drive momentum toward the future state.
* Identify, coach, and develop talent; build a strong bench of RBS tool champions across the division to leverage RBS Continuous Improvement tools and methodologies to support their professional advancement and improve the business's operational performance.

**Policy Deployment**

* Lead the creation of annual X-Matrix and oversee the deployment plan via RBS charters, bowlers, and action plans.
* Manage charters, bowlers, action plans and monthly PD cadence.
* Support Division Annual Improvement Priorities through effective application of RBS tools and methodologies to support Policy Deployment initiatives.

**Qualifications**
**PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical field; Advanced degree preferred (MS Engineering, MBA)
* 8-10 years relevant work experience across Continuous Improvement, Business Systems, or Operations (global and/or multi-site experience preferred)
* Familiarity with Policy Deployment, its facilitation and implementation.
* Technical background in continuous improvement methodology and framework
* Proven successful applications of multiple CI tools: 80/20, Lean Leadership, including Daily Management, KPI Leadership, Standard Work, Gemba Walks, Value Stream Mapping, 6S, Transactional Process Improvements, Kanban/replenishment systems, FMEA, Advanced Problem Solving, RCCMs
* Demonstrated ability to facilitate Kaizen-type events to produce measurable improvements (financial, service, quality, etc.)
* Skilled and experienced in decomposing a strategic vision into actionable strategies and tactics.
* Critical thinking skills to properly identify problem area & potential solutions
* Demonstrate the Regal Rexnord Values; Integrity, Responsibility, Diversity, Engagement & Inclusion, Customer Success, Innovation with Purpose, Continuous Improvement, Performance, Passion to Win, and Sense of Urgency
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Must be able to travel at least 50-75% of the time domestically and internationally as required

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Project and program management expertise (PMP, Prince II)
* Lean Six Sigma certification (e.g, Green Belt or Black Belt)
* Experience with High Mix / Low Volume and Low Mix / High Volume manufacturing

Physical Demand and Work Environment
 
 
**Physical Demands**
– while performing the duties in this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands; reach with hands and arms; and talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, and sit.
 
 
**Work Environment**
– the noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
 
 
Restrictions imposed by federal export control laws may limit this job opportunity to candidates who are a "U.S. Person,' which includes U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, U.S. permanent residents, individuals granted asylum in the United States, and refugees in the United States.
 
 
Expected salary: $160,000 - $190,000 annually. The salary range provided is intended to display the value of the company's base pay compensation for all statewide locations across the United States. Salary is dependent on a multitude of factors, including but not limited to the physical worksite location, candidate's skill set, level of experience, education, and internal peer compensation comparisons.
 
 
**Benefits**

* Medical, Dental, Vision and Prescription Drug Coverage
* Spending accounts (HSA, Health Care FSA and Dependent Care FSA)
* Paid Time Off and Holidays
* 401k Retirement Plan with Matching Employer Contributions
* Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance
* Paid Leaves
* Tuition Assistance

**About Regal Rexnord**
Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.
 
 
The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food & beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.
 
 
Regal Rexnord is comprised of three operating segments: Industrial Powertrain Solutions, Power Efficiency Solutions, and Automation & Motion Control. Regal Rexnord has offices and manufacturing, sales and service facilities worldwide. For more information, including a copy of our Sustainability Report, visit RegalRexnord.com.
 
 
**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**
Regal Rexnord is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex/gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, ancestry, national origin, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status (unless required by the applicable law or government contract), disability or protected veteran status or any other status or characteristic protected by law. Regal Rexnord is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. We are committed to building a team that represents diverse and inclusive backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. If you’d like to view a copy of the company’s affirmative action plan for protected veterans/individuals with disabilities or policy statement, please email Recruiting@RegalRexnord.com. If you have a disability and you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to submit an online application, please e-mail Recruiting@RegalRexnord.com.
 
 
Equal Employment Opportunity Posters
 
 
**Notification to Agencies**
: Please note that Regal Rexnord Corporation and its affiliates and subsidiaries ("Regal Rexnord") do not accept unsolicited resumes or calls from third-party recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Master Service Agreement or similar contract and approval from HR to submit resumes for a specific requisition, Regal Rexnord will not consider or approve payment to any third-parties for hires made.

identity_held_roles.description:
***POSITION PURPOSE:***

The Director of Quality Improvement operates under the leadership and direction of the Chief Medical Officer (CMO) and Chief Operating Officer (COO). The CMO maintains direct clinical oversight of clinical quality improvement activities and regulatory quality programs. The Director of Quality Improvement provides organization-wide leadership for EVCHC's quality improvement program. The Director establishes the quality strategy in partnership with executive, clinical, operational and compliance leaders; converts organizational goals and regulatory requirements into measurable work plans; and leads improvement efforts that strengthen patient outcomes, safety, access, equity and care experience. The Director is accountable for reliable quality data, required clinical quality reporting, continuous improvement methods, Patient Centered Medical Home recognition, and the performance of the Quality Improvement Department.

 

***MAJOR POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES AND FUNCTIONS:***

**Quality Strategy and Governance**

* Lead the development, implementation and annual evaluation of EVCHC's organization-wide Quality Improvement and Quality Assurance Plan in alignment with the strategic plan, clinical standards and applicable Health Center Program requirements.

* Establish annual quality priorities, measures, targets, owners and timelines with executive and clinical leadership. Monitor progress and recommend corrective action when performance does not meet established goals.

* Lead or support the Quality Improvement Committee and related workgroups. Prepare agendas, dashboards, meeting materials, decisions and follow-up reports for executive leadership and the Board of Directors, as requested.

* Advise executive leaders on emerging quality risks, performance trends, resource needs and opportunities to improve care delivery across sites and service lines.

* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, patient safety and learning throughout the organization.

**Department Leadership**

* Direct the work of the Quality Improvement Department, including recruitment, onboarding, supervision, coaching, performance evaluation, workload assignment and staff development.

* Develop departmental goals, staffing plans, procedures and budgets that support timely completion of quality priorities and reporting obligations.

* Set clear expectations for the accuracy, timeliness and usability of analyses, audits, reports and improvement support provided by the department.

* Build effective working relationships with clinical care teams, Operations, Information Technology, Compliance, Human Resources, Finance, Behavioral Health, Dental and other departments involved in quality outcomes.

**Quality Measurement and Reporting**

* Oversee the collection, validation, analysis and submission of clinical quality measures and required reports, including Uniform Data System measures, population health platforms transition and readiness, HEDIS and payer measures, grant measures and internal quality indicators.

* Develop and maintain executive, provider, site and service-line dashboards that show current performance, trends, disparities, targets and improvement actions.

* Track provider and care-team performance, identify variation and care gaps, and provide leaders with actionable information while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and data-use standards.

* Establish data-validation controls and documentation so that quality reports can be reconciled to source systems and used as an organization-wide source of truth. Partnering with Director of Data and IT operations for oversight on data governance committee.

* Present quality findings in clear written and verbal reports to the Board, executive leadership, managers, providers, staff, health plans and external reviewers, as appropriate.

**Performance Improvement**

* Lead Plan Do Study Act cycles, root-cause analyses and other structured improvement methods from problem definition through implementation, evaluation and sustainment.

* Partner with clinical and operational leaders to improve preventive care, chronic disease outcomes, access, continuity, patient experience, care coordination, documentation and other priority measures.

* Translate data findings into practical workflow changes, training, decision support, audit tools and accountability processes that can be sustained across sites.

* Evaluate improvement results, identify lessons learned and spread effective practices to other care teams, programs or locations when appropriate **Regulatory Readiness and Patient Safety**

* Lead the quality components of Patient Centered Medical Home recognition and renewal, including evidence collection, workflow assessment, documentation, staff education and sustainment of recognized practices alongside Director of compliance.

* Partner with Compliance Director, Risk Management, clinical leadership and Operations on quality-related readiness for HRSA operational site visits, FTCA deeming and risk-management activities, health plan audits, accreditation reviews and other external assessments.

* Support corrective action plans with the Director of Compliance arising from audits, quality reviews, safety events or regulatory findings. Define measures, monitor completion and verify that corrective actions are effective and sustained.

* Analyze trends in patient safety events, grievances and quality-of-care concerns with the appropriate leaders while protecting confidentiality and following reporting requirements.

* Maintain organized records of quality plans, committee actions, reports, audits, improvement projects and supporting evidence required for oversight and external review.

**Clinical Analytics and Health Information Technology**

* Direct the clinical analytics program and define reporting requirements that support clinical decision-making, population health management and performance improvement.

* Partner with Information Technology and system vendors to improve data extraction, interfaces, registries, care guidelines, clinical decision support, templates and reporting tools used for quality measurement.

* Lead data-governance practices for quality information, including measure definitions, ownership, validation, access, change control and resolution of reporting discrepancies.

* Assess the quality and workflow impact of new digital tools and automation used in clinical or quality processes and recommend safeguards, testing and performance monitoring before broad implementation.

* Recommend redesign of workflows affected by the electronic health record, patient portal, population health platforms and other clinical information systems.

**Organizational Responsibilities**

* Participate in executive, management, clinical and staff meetings related to quality priorities and organizational performance.

* Maintain current knowledge of FQHC quality requirements, clinical quality measures, health plan expectations and recognized improvement practices.

* Protect patient, employee and organizational information and comply with HIPAA, confidentiality, cybersecurity and records-management requirements.

* Perform other job-related duties as assigned within the scope of the position.

***POSITION REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS:***

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in public health, health care administration, nursing, health sciences, informatics or a related field is required. A master's degree is preferred.

* At least five years of progressive experience in health care quality improvement, population health, clinical analytics or health care program management is required, including at least three years of supervisory or department leadership experience.

* Experience in a Federally Qualified Health Center, community health center or other safety-net setting is strongly preferred.

* Experience leading cross-functional improvement projects and preparing quality reports for executives, governing boards, health plans or regulatory agencies is required.

* Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality, Lean or Six Sigma certification, or comparable quality-improvement training is preferred.

**Knowledge and Skills**

* Working knowledge of continuous quality improvement methods, patient safety practices, clinical quality measurement, health equity and population health management.

* Knowledge of HRSA Health Center Program expectations, Uniform Data System reporting, HEDIS measures, Patient Centered Medical Home standards and payer quality programs is strongly preferred.

* Advanced ability to collect, validate, analyze and present health care data and to translate findings into operational decisions and improvement plans.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and experience using electronic health records, population health platforms, data visualization tools or clinical reporting applications. Experience with NextGen or comparable systems is preferred.

* Strong leadership, project management, facilitation, written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build accountability across departments .

* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet reporting deadlines, exercise sound judgment and communicate sensitive performance information professionally.

* Demonstrated commitment to serving medically underserved communities and reducing disparities in access, care and health outcomes.

***WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL/MENTAL ABILITIES AND PROCESSES:***

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

 

* Work is performed primarily in an office and health center environment and requires regular travel among EVCHC sites and occasional travel to meetings or trainings.

* The position requires extended periods of sitting and computer use, as well as standing, walking, bending, reaching, speaking, hearing and seeing sufficient to perform assigned duties.

* The employee must be able to communicate clearly, review detailed reports, maintain concentration, manage competing deadlines and work effectively in shared office and clinical environments.

* The employee must be able to lift and carry materials and equipment weighing up to 20 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

DOE: $125,000 - $148,824 Annually

Please apply to this position with your current resume.

Principals only. Recruiters, please do not contact this job posting.

identity_held_roles.description:
*ZetSol Energy | A Zetwerk Company | Solar Manufacturing & Supply Chain Platform for North America*

**Position:** Director – Operations 
**Location:** North Carolina/ South Carolina 
**Type:** Full-Time 
**Reports To:** CEO, ZetSol Energy

**Who We Are**

ZetSol Energy is the solar manufacturing and supply chain platform built to give North American solar developers, EPCs, utilities, and independent power producers a reliable, tariff-compliant alternative to fragmented overseas sourcing. The company is establishing a vertically integrated greenfield facility in Tuticorin, Tamil Nadu, producing silicon ingots, monocrystalline wafers, cells, and modules, including high-efficiency TOPCon and HJT technology, and pairs that manufacturing base with a full strategic sourcing, bill-of-materials management, quality audit, compliance, and logistics practice purpose-built for the US market.

ZetSol Energy is backed by Zetwerk, a global manufacturing platform valued at over $2.7 billion that already supplies solar piles, mechanical and structural components, and modules to leading US EPCs and asset owners, and whose 2022 acquisition of Unimacts strengthened its US industrial and solar manufacturing footprint. ZetSol Energy is the next chapter of that build-out: a dedicated US-facing commercial platform launching at a moment when American solar developers are actively searching for supply chain partners who can deliver both scale and certainty.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for an experienced operations leader to lead and scale ZetSol Energy's US operations, with overall responsibility for manufacturing, factory production, supply chain, logistics and sales operations.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in managing large-scale operations, with a strong background in Supply Chain Management (SCM), logistics and manufacturing, preferably within the renewable energy, solar or industrial sectors.

This individual will be responsible for overseeing factory production, managing end-to-end supply chain and logistics operations, and driving sales operations, including demand planning, order management and customer fulfilment in the US market.

The role will also involve building strong relationships with US government authorities, regulatory bodies, logistics partners and other key industry stakeholders, while ensuring operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and cost optimisation.

This is a key leadership position that will play an instrumental role in building and scaling ZetSol Energy's US operations, establishing robust operational processes and driving business growth in North America.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead and oversee end-to-end US operations for ZetSol Energy, covering manufacturing, supply chain, logistics and sales operations.
* Manage factory production operations, including production planning, capacity utilisation, quality, productivity and timely delivery.
* Drive end-to-end supply chain and logistics operations, including global sourcing, procurement, inventory management, import/export, customs clearance and distribution.
* Oversee sales operations, including demand planning, order management, customer fulfilment and coordination with commercial teams.
* Build and manage relationships with US government authorities, regulatory bodies, customs officials, port authorities, logistics partners and other key stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with US trade regulations, import policies, tariffs and applicable industry standards while driving operational efficiency and cost optimisation.
* Build and scale the US operations team, processes and infrastructure while working closely with the leadership and manufacturing teams in India.

**Qualifications**

* 15–20 years of experience in operations, manufacturing, supply chain management and logistics, preferably within renewable energy, solar, infrastructure or industrial sectors.
* Extensive experience managing large-scale manufacturing operations, including factory production, production planning, quality and operational efficiency.
* Strong experience in end-to-end supply chain, logistics and sales operations, including global sourcing, procurement, import/export, order management and customer fulfilment.
* Strong understanding of US trade regulations, import compliance, tariffs, customs procedures and logistics frameworks.
* Established relationships with government authorities, regulatory bodies, customs officials, port authorities and key industry stakeholders.
* Proven track record of building and managing large operational teams, vendor ecosystems and strategic partnerships, with strong commercial and cost management capabilities.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience in the solar, renewable energy or energy manufacturing ecosystem.
* Previous experience leading operations for a global manufacturing or industrial organisation.
* Experience managing manufacturing facilities and cross-border operations between the US and international markets, preferably India.
* Ability to build and scale operational infrastructure in a fast-growing business environment.

**Why ZetSol Energy**

* Opportunity to play a key leadership role in building ZetSol Energy's US operations.
* Work closely with the CEO and leadership team in shaping the company's operational strategy.
* Opportunity to build and scale a large operational and supply chain ecosystem.
* Be part of a growing solar manufacturing and supply chain platform backed by Zetwerk's global manufacturing capabilities.

Work Location: In person

The company is establishing a vertically integrated greenfield facility in Tuticorin, Tamil Nadu, producing silicon ingots, monocrystalline wafers, cells, and modules, including high-efficiency TOPCon and HJT technology, and pairs that manufacturing base with a full strategic sourcing, bill-of-materials management, quality audit, compliance, and logistics practice purpose-built for the US market.

ZetSol Energy is backed by Zetwerk, a global manufacturing platform valued at over $2.7 billion that already supplies solar piles, mechanical and structural components, and modules to leading US EPCs and asset owners, and whose 2022 acquisition of Unimacts strengthened its US industrial and solar manufacturing footprint.

identity_held_roles.description:
**Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future**
======================================

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

**Why This Role Exists**
------------------------

Hadrian is building an additive manufacturing capability that runs as part of an autonomous factory, not as a room full of printers. The hard problem is not any single machine, material, or line of code. It is making all of them behave as one system. Systems engineering is the glue that holds that system together, and this role owns the glue.

The Senior Director leads three engineering functions, materials and process engineering, hardware engineering, and software engineering, and is accountable for the digital backbone that binds them to each other and to applications engineering: the architecture, interfaces, and data that connect Hadrian’s Opus platform to cutting-edge additive manufacturing equipment, add automation where it makes sense, fuse sensor data into the part record, and turn a collection of parts into a full, integrated digital manufacturing system built around additive.

The measure of success is not three strong teams. It is one manufacturing system that a customer part flows through, from design intent to qualified hardware, with every decision and every data point captured along the way.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Architect the system.** Define and control the end-to-end architecture for additive at Hadrian: requirements, interfaces, data model, and acceptance criteria that hold across multiple equipment platforms, modalities, and sites. Treat the factory as the product.
* **Build the digital backbone.** Connect additive equipment, peripherals, and inspection assets to Opus with the same discipline a semiconductor fab applies to connecting tools to the host: standardized state models, telemetry, event streams, and data contracts, with security and configuration control built in.
* **Fuse the sensors.** Bring in-situ monitoring, machine telemetry, environmental data, and downstream inspection into one correlated record per part, then move from monitoring to data-driven release and, where it is justified, closed-loop control.
* **Automate where it pays.** Lead automation across additive cells (material and powder handling, build changeover, part removal and depowdering, post-processing flow, robotics, controls, and safety) with a written case for each: safety, repeatability, and data capture first; labor second. Never automate an unstable process.
* **Lead the three functions as one.** Set standards, priorities, and cadence for materials and process, hardware, and software engineering. Resolve conflicts between them at the architecture level, not the escalation level.
* **Own the applications engineering interface.** With the Head of Applications Engineering, define what a production-ready hand-off looks like, publish the process capability and design-rule data applications engineers build to, and close the loop from floor results back into design guidance.
* **Industrialize the equipment.** Through the hardware engineering leader, own factory and site acceptance, commissioning, reliability (preventive maintenance, spares, MTBF/MTTR), and configuration-controlled modification and upgrade of additive systems, and lead the technical relationships with equipment partners that unlock deeper integration. The machine-level depth lives in that team; the standards and the outcomes live here.
* **Design for the factory.** Partner with Factory Development and Factory Automation on cell and site design: material flow, capacity, simulation, utilities, and the path to lights-out operation for additive.
* **Build quality in.** Make the system itself the evidence: traceability, data integrity, and process control that stand up to AS9100 audits and customer qualification without a separate paper trail.
* **Be the additive voice in Hadrian’s platform.** Carry additive requirements into Core Engineering and the Opus roadmap, and bring platform capability back to the floor.
* **Hire, develop, and retain.** Build a leadership bench under you, set a high technical bar, and make Hadrian the place the best additive systems engineers in the country want to work.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a physical science; an advanced degree is strongly preferred.
* 12+ years in advanced manufacturing, with real depth in at least three of these six domains: factory design and industrial automation; semiconductor or other high-reliability capital-equipment engineering; manufacturing software and data systems; materials science and process engineering; quality systems in regulated industries; sensing, process monitoring, and sensor fusion.
* 5+ years leading engineering teams, including leading through managers and building at least one function from the ground up.
* Production experience with metal laser powder bed fusion, as a user of the equipment, a developer of it, or both.
* Has led the integration of complex equipment into factory-level software (manufacturing execution, equipment host, or data platforms), including requirements, interface standards, and acceptance criteria.
* Has taken at least one production automation or capital-equipment program (robotic cells, material handling, or equipment with safety systems and controls) from concept through commissioning in a regulated environment (aerospace and defense, semiconductor, medical, or similar), and has owned the reliability of production equipment afterward.
* Fluent across the stack: can review a process flow, a data schema, a metallurgical cross-section, and a controls narrative in the same meeting, and knows which one is lying.
* Has worked as a true peer to a customer-facing or design function, with a record of building clean interfaces rather than absorbing the other team.
* Willing to travel up to 20%, including to Hadrian sites and international partners. Must meet the ITAR requirements below.

**What Will Set You Apart**
---------------------------

* Ph.D. in materials science, mechanical engineering, systems engineering or a related discipline.
* Semiconductor capital-equipment background: equipment-to-host integration, tool matching, fleet data, fault detection and statistical process control at scale.
* Equipment-maker experience developing or launching metal additive systems (new product introduction, cost-productivity trades, design reviews) in addition to user-side experience.
* In-situ monitoring and sensor fusion implemented in production, with data-driven release or closed-loop control.
* Factory design: material flow planning, discrete-event simulation, and highly automated or lights-out operations.
* AS9100 and customer qualification pathways; familiarity with AM specifications (ASTM F42, ISO/ASTM 529xx, SAE AMS 7xxx series).
* Budget or P&L ownership of a capital-intensive program, with a record of making the build-versus-buy and automate-versus-wait calls well.
* Modern software fluency: APIs, event streaming, OT/IT architecture, industrial interoperability standards (OPC UA, MTConnect), and cloud data platforms.

**Compensation**
----------------

For this role, the target salary range is $300,000 - $350,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

**Benefits for Full-time Employees**
------------------------------------

* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees
 
 401k
* Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need.
* Flexible vacation policy
* Equity

**ITAR Requirements**
---------------------

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

**Use of AI in hiring**
-----------------------

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy.

**Consideration of Criminal History**
-------------------------------------

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

**Hadrian Is An Equal Opportunity Employer**
--------------------------------------------

Hadrian does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, marital status, mental status, physical disability or any other legally protected status. When necessary, the Company also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled candidates and employees, including for candidates or employees who are disabled by pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions.

Compensation Range: $300K - $350K

identity_held_roles.description:
**Position Overview:**

As the Regional Senior Manager of Post Production/IQR, you will have the unique opportunity to partner closely with several different teams at multiple sites (including IC leadership, reconditioning, and support teams) to drive the strategy behind the development and deployment of Post Production & Quality programs, as well as manage continued performance of internal and external vendors. We are looking for a resourceful self-starter who will set the tone for the successful and fast-paced growth of our Inspection Centers. The Regional Senior Manager of Post Production/IQR role will be heavily focused on leading our teams to effectively close operational gaps and establishing standardized practices that will drive exceptional quality.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Driving successful execution amongst our Post Production teams by effectively leading and developing team members and creating and implementing new processes and systems.
* Identifying issues or roadblocks to execution and quickly taking action to problem solve and implement effective solutions across a large and quickly evolving platform.
* Providing clear direction and necessary support to ensure operational gaps are being closed in a timely manner.
* Working with key business partners to develop systems, metrics, reporting, and staffing models for our Post Production processes and teams.
* Effectively leading and developing onsite personnel at third-party production locations.
* Managing quality of internal and external vendors responsible for producing units for Carvana.
* Establishing effective working relationships with internal and external partners.
* Creating and successfully executing large-scale change management initiatives and new process rollouts.
* Other duties as assigned.

**What the job requires:**

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

* Minimum of 8 years of leadership, people development, and operations experience
* Experience working in a Lean Manufacturing environment
* Experience developing effective and scalable operating systems and processes
* Proven track record of production process improvement and innovation
* Proven track record of managing complex change across large teams
* Proven track record of leading and developing others
* Proven ability to obtain project deliverables and company metrics
* Strong analytical thinking and organizational skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; Ability to learn quickly and transfer knowledge
* Requires standing for extended periods of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking, stooping, pushing, and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance
* Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to travel up to 80% (multi site responsibility)
* Ability to provide valuable and actionable feedback
* Proficient computer skills
* Must be at least 18 years of age
* Valid driver's license with a clean driving record (no DUIs and no more than two moving violations in the last 3 years).
* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English

This job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Compensation Range: $120K-$140K annually

**Legal stuff** 
Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. 
Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Please note this job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
