identity_held_roles.description:
**Job Description:**

**Who We Are:**

At Cart.com, we're **defining the future of commerce.**

Founded to solve the growing complexity of modern commerce, Cart.com helps businesses simplify how they sell, fulfill, and deliver products to their customers. We bring together technology, services, and logistics infrastructure into one connected platform, making it easier for organizations to grow, operate efficiently, and navigate an increasingly fragmented commerce landscape.

We work with brands, retailers, manufacturers, and public sector organizations to support every stage of the customer journey, from ecommerce and order management to fulfillment, distribution, and delivery. By combining software, expertise, and a nationwide logistics network into a unified solution, we help our customers move faster, operate smarter, and scale with confidence.

But what truly sets Cart.com apart is our people. We're builders, problem-solvers, and innovators who thrive on turning big challenges into meaningful outcomes for our customers. Every day, we're helping shape the future of commerce while creating opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact.

If you're energized by solving complex problems, collaborating with talented teammates, and helping build what's next, we'd love to hear from you.

**Cart.com Milestones**

* Founded in 2020 with a vision to build the first truly unified commerce platform.
* Achieved unicorn status with a valuation exceeding $1 billion.
* Raised more than $475 million to support continued growth and innovation
* Expanded a nationwide commerce and logistics network that helps organizations scale, fulfill, and grow across channels.
* Recognized by Inc.'s Power Partner Awards for helping businesses grow and scale.
* Recognized as an award-winning employer for four consecutive years, reflecting our commitment to building an environment where talented people can grow, innovate, and make an impact.

**Our values:** Cart.com is building a company that is committed to living out these 6 core values:

* **Be brand obsessed:** Our lives are shaped by the brands we interact with daily. We obsess over the brands we serve, and about the things they care about.
* **Think beyond the box:** “We’ve always done it that way” is not a phrase uttered often at our office. We create creative solutions to complex problems.

* **Don’t give up:** We learn from our challenges and see them for what they are; great building blocks to an amazing brand story.
* **Speak up:** We communicate clearly and directly because we care deeply. Communication is the bedrock of our community.
* **Work together:** We’ve built a team that prides itself on diversity of thought and background. Collaboration is better with contrast.
* **Remember to be human:** We work hard, but we leave room for the people, places and things that we love

**AI is part of how we work. It's not doing the hiring.** 
 
We'll use AI in parts of our process and we think you should feel free to use it too — for research, prep, whatever helps. But our interviews exist to meet *you*, not your best AI-assisted draft. Real people make every call here. Any questions about how this works, just ask.

**Remote:**

This position is fully remote and open to candidates in AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, DE, FL, GA, HI, IL, IN, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MO, MS, NC, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA. The salary range for this role is $175,000-200,000 annually. Actual compensation may vary based on geographic location, experience and qualifications. This role is eligible for bonus, equity and benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off. Applications accepted through 1-31-2027. We comply with all applicable pay transparency laws in the states where we operate.

**The Role:**

The Director, Quality and Compliance leads the quality function for Cart.com’s federal pharmaceutical distribution business across four sites. This leader will standardize and strengthen an established quality program, develop site quality leaders, ensure consistent application of procedures, and serve as the primary quality point of contact for client reporting, audits and product-quality events.

This is approximately a 70% strategic leadership and 30% hands-on role. The Director will not build the program from the ground up, but will assess the current-state program, make targeted improvements, and ensure teams consistently execute against client, regulatory and network requirements. The role is remote with approximately 30% travel.

The role offers the opportunity to influence the quality standard for a growing federal business and help prepare the organization to support additional federal programs over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead and develop site quality leaders across Maryland, Goodyear, Temecula and Memphis, establishing clear accountability, delegation and follow-through.
* Standardize quality procedures and expectations across the network while refining the existing quality management system and closing identified gaps.
* Ensure sites remain prepared for client and regulatory audits; support audit planning, host or coordinate inspections, and oversee timely responses and corrective actions.
* Serve as the primary quality point of contact for pharmaceutical product excursions and related client reporting, ensuring submissions are accurate, complete and timely.
* Oversee quality processes supporting receiving, quarantine, release, disposition, returns, destruction, recalls, deviations, corrective and preventive actions, change control, training, complaints and document control.
* Guide quality decisions for controlled-temperature pharmaceutical products, including refrigerated, frozen and ultra-cold storage and distribution.
* Partner with site Operations leaders and Cart.com’s Compliance team to implement operational changes required to meet quality standards and client expectations.
* Use quality metrics, audit findings, client feedback and site observations to identify risk, prioritize improvements and report progress to senior leadership.
* Travel to sites for audit preparation, team development, quality reviews and issue resolution.

**Who You Are:**

 

* You are a strategic, hands-on quality leader who can set direction while stepping into audits, excursions and site-readiness work when needed.
* You lead through others, delegate clearly, establish checkpoints and hold site quality leaders accountable for follow-through.
* You put the client’s requirements first, ask the right questions and respond with accurate, timely information.
* You communicate with credibility and composure across clients, regulators, Operations, Compliance and senior leadership.
* You are highly organized and disciplined, ensuring commitments, documentation and escalations do not get lost.
* You build strong cross-functional partnerships and can influence operational changes without creating a separate quality silo.
* You adapt to changing federal-client requirements while maintaining consistent quality standards and sound judgment.
* You develop people, address performance gaps directly and create a culture of ownership across a distributed team.

**What You’ve Done:**

 

* 7+ years of progressive pharmaceutical quality experience, including work in a current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) facility and meaningful pharmaceutical distribution, logistics or 3PL quality exposure.
* 5+ years of people-leadership experience with demonstrated success delegating, developing leaders and holding teams accountable.
* Worked in pharmaceutical distribution, wholesale, logistics or third-party logistics (3PL). Manufacturing experience alone is not sufficient without meaningful distribution-quality exposure.
* Applied cGMP, Good Distribution Practice (GDP), controlled-document and standard operating procedure requirements in a regulated pharmaceutical environment.
* Prepared for or led audits involving the U.S. Food and Drug Administration or comparable regulators, including managing responses and follow-up actions.
* Supported pharmaceutical product release, disposition, holds, recalls or temperature-excursion decisions in a regulated distribution setting.
* Written, revised or implemented quality procedures and documentation, then ensured consistent execution across teams or sites.
* Led a distributed or multi-site team and built accountability through site leaders rather than personally owning every task.
* Managed a significant client, product-quality or regulatory issue requiring coordination across Quality, Operations and Compliance.
* Earned a bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, biology, chemistry or a related field, or bring an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
* Ability to travel up to 30%.

**Nice to Haves:**

 

* Background supporting federal health programs or agencies such as HHS, DLA, ASPR, BARDA, DoD or VA.
* Experience with pharmaceutical 3PLs, wholesalers, state licensing or NABP accreditation.
* Hands-on experience with vaccines or other cold-chain and ultra-cold pharmaceutical products.
* Knowledge of Drug Supply Chain Security Act requirements and suspect or illegitimate product processes.
* Relevant certifications such as ASQ Certified Quality Auditor, Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence, Certified Pharmaceutical GMP Professional or Lead Auditor.
* Master’s degree in a life-sciences or related discipline.
Direct leadership of quality teams 

 
 

**Physical Demands & Working Conditions:**

 

* Remote work environment with regular computer and video-conference use.
* Ability to travel by air or ground up to 30% and work onsite in warehouse, pharmaceutical distribution and temperature-controlled environments.
* Ability to move through operating areas and wear required personal protective equipment when visiting sites.
* Flexibility to support audits, client needs or quality events outside standard business hours when required.

Eligibility Requirement: This position is open only to U.S. citizens due to applicable federal requirements. By applying, you confirm that you are a U.S. citizen and can provide acceptable documentation verifying your status if selected. 
 
If you are not a U.S. citizen, please do not apply for this role.

Cart.com is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

identity_held_roles.title: Sr. Director -Engines Manufacturing
identity_held_roles.description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

You will lead Huntsville manufacturing for the BE-4 and Northstar engines—powerful engines that support Blue Origin’s launch vehicles and our mission to build a road to space. Reporting to the Vice President of Engines Manufacturing, you will lead senior managers and teams responsible for production, industrialization, and continuous improvement.

This hands-on leadership role balances the immediate need to deliver BE-4 engines with the work of bringing Northstar into production and scaling manufacturing capability for the future. You will partner across Blue Origin to deliver safely, reliably, on schedule, and at planned cost.

### **Responsibilities**

* Lead BE-4 and Northstar manufacturing in Huntsville, delivering to customer, program, safety, quality, schedule, and cost commitments.
* Sustain and improve BE-4 production while transitioning Northstar from development into stable, repeatable production.
* Develop production strategies, capacity plans, and operating rhythms aligned with program needs and company operating plans.
* Coordinate factory readiness, equipment identification and procurement, capital improvements, production start-up, and process qualification.
* Partner with Engineering, Program Management, Supply Chain, Test Operations, Quality, Safety, and other Blue Origin sites to resolve constraints and improve hardware flow.
* Lead improvement efforts across manufacturing, business processes, production planning, and resource utilization; apply lessons learned and standardize effective practices.
* Manage the manufacturing capital portfolio and ensure projects are executed safely and on schedule.
* Champion mission assurance and safety principles, including the planning and execution of critical operations.
* Develop leaders and teams, strengthen organizational capability, and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Identify opportunities to improve safety, quality, cost, capacity, and delivery performance. 

### **Minimum qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in industrial, manufacturing, mechanical, or electrical engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 15+ years of experience in aerospace or a closely related complex manufacturing industry.
* Significant experience leading manufacturing or production organizations, including through senior leaders.
* Experience managing customer relationships and expectations.
* Experience with program- or project-level financial performance, budgets, or profit and loss.
* Proven ability to lead complex projects, coordinate across functions, and deliver in a fast-paced environment.
* Expertise in production operations, manufacturing process development, and continuous improvement.
* Strong understanding of quality systems, root cause analysis, and risk-based problem solving.
* Demonstrated commitment to safety, including experience planning and overseeing critical operations.
Strong communication, judgment, personnel management, and mentoring skills. 

### **Preferred qualifications**

* Master’s degree in engineering or a related field; MBA or equivalent business experience.
* Experience transitioning complex products from development into production and scaling manufacturing rates.
* Experience launching or expanding a production facility.
* Knowledge of fabrication, assembly, integration, test, quality, and configuration management.
* Experience managing facility-level capital improvements and equipment procurement.
* Lean Manufacturing, Toyota Production System, or Six Sigma experience; Black Belt certification is a plus.
Experience leading operations across multiple departments, programs, or sites. 

 

**Culture Statement**

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

 

**Export Control Regulations**

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

 

**Background Check**

* Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical 

 

**Benefits**

* Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
* Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
* Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details. 

 

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws.

 

**Affirmative Action and Disability Accommodation**

Applicants wishing to receive information on Blue Origin’s Affirmative Action Plans, or applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation in order to participate in the application and/or interview process, please contact us at EEOCompliance@blueorigin.com . Please note this is a publicly managed inbox. Please do not include any personal medical information in your request.

**Director of Quality – Aerospace Manufacturing**
**Oklahoma City, OK**
**Extremely Competitive Pay**
-
*Dependent on Experience*
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced quality leader to oversee and advance our quality management program within a growing aerospace manufacturing organization. This position plays a critical role in ensuring product integrity, maintaining customer and regulatory compliance, and driving continuous improvement throughout the company. Working closely with manufacturing, engineering, and executive leadership, the Director of Quality will lead quality initiatives, develop high-performing teams, strengthen organizational processes, and promote a culture of accountability and operational excellence. The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge with proven leadership skills and a commitment to delivering consistent, high-quality results.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Implement and maintain the company quality system in coordination with the Management Representative.
* Report on the performance of the quality system for review and as a basis for improvement of the quality system.
* Have knowledge and understanding of the standards and customer requirements against which the quality system is developed, maintained, and implemented.
* Provide leadership to subordinates, establishing goals and development plans to meet the strategic direction of the organization.
* Determine and enforce -- through functional groups - quality requirements in accordance with real company needs, based on current regulations and state-of-the art product development.
* Develop audit plans, select, and evaluate auditors, document non-conformance(s) and report non-conformances to management.
* Manage subordinate personnel and ensure proper documentation and methods used are according to the Quality Management System.
* Ensure employees are properly trained to perform their job duties in the manner expected, according to their specific job description.
* Establishes and maintains an effective system of communications throughout the organization.
* Represents the organization with major customers, shareholders, the financial community, and the public.
* Monitor and evaluate subordinate personnel updating the Management Representative and Human Resources to have the Employee Skills Matrix reflect accurately the training and skills of subordinates.
* Administer the company quality program in accordance with customer and company requirements.
* Ensure corrective and preventive actions are issued, responded, and completed.
* Promote continuous improvement initiatives for scrap reduction, reducing variation and waste, increasing profit and to improve product quality.
* Organize and promote companywide quality improvement efforts.
* Liaison with external parties on matters relating to the quality management system.
* Maintain the system for calibration of inspection, tools, and equipment for conformance to product specifications.
* Research and analyze data such as customer design proposals, specifications, quality requirements, and manuals to determine feasibility or processes or application and company’s ability to inspect product at the required stages of manufacture.
* Plan and direct quality activities and establishes QA priorities for keeping effective production operations and cost factors.
* Assist engineering in organizing and planning Quality Planning Meetings.
* Read and understand technical and non-technical documents that relate to contracts, purchasing, product design, manufacturing, and test. This includes the ability to interface with both technical and non-technical personnel.
* Evaluate, study, standardize and improve procedures for the assurance of quality, reliability, safety, and efficiency.
* Assess techniques for examining, questioning, evaluating, and reporting.
* Analyze inspection data to determine product conformance and process capability.
* Prepare composite reports from individual reports of subordinates.
* Maintain training records, coordinate with upper management to determine training requirements.
* Issue written and oral instructions.
* Assign duties and examine work for exactness, neatness, and conformance product specifications, policies and procedures.
* Coordinate and plan meetings with departments to develop documentation to support compliance to the applicable standards.
* Ensure nonconforming product is controlled in accordance with the company's quality requirements.
* Monitor metrics associated with the Cost of Quality.
* Initiate NMR’s and DMR's for product found to be nonconforming.
* Ensure employees are properly trained to perform their job duties in the manner expected, according to their specific job description.
* Ensure employees observe the safety rules and regulations and wear the required safety equipment (PPE).
* Assist employees in using the proper tools and equipment to monitor conformance to specifications and ensure equipment is calibrated and maintained.
* Ensure proper documentation and methods used are according to the Quality Management System.
* Support the Quality Management System to assure compliance to quality, industrial and government standards and regulations and customer requirements.
* Adhere to all Quality Management System procedures and instructions.
* Maintain a safe, clean, and orderly work environment.
* Observe the safety rules and regulations and wear the required safety equipment.

**Additional Benefits We Offer**

* Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) with Company Match
* Company Sponsored Life-Insurance
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays

**Qualifications**
**Job Qualifications**
**Physical Requirements**
While performing the duties of the job, the employee is required to stand; walk; sit; use hands/fingers to handle/feel; reach with hands and arms; climb; balance; stoop; kneel; crouch; crawl; reach; pull; balance; carry; handle. The employee may occasionally lift or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to focus.
  
  
**Education And/or Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 4-10 years of related experience in manufacturing.
* Previous experience working with Lockheed Martin is required

(U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee)

**About CAMP Systems:**
At CAMP Systems, we are the trusted leader in aircraft compliance and health management, proudly serving the global business aviation industry. With over 20,000 aircraft and 33,000 engines supported on our cutting-edge platforms, and partnerships with more than 1,300 maintenance facilities and parts suppliers worldwide, we’re shaping the future of aviation technology. Since our founding in 1968, we’ve grown to a dynamic team of 1,600+ employees across 14 locations globally—all united by a passion for innovation and excellence.

**Our Mission & Vision:**
We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences.

**Our Values & Excellence Mindset:**
We are customer obsessed, trust-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative.

**What You Will Experience in This Role:**

The Director - Quality Assurance drives quality across CAMP's Aircraft Health Management business and provides quality oversight for data and process quality concerns. The role owns the QMS, the internal audit program, and the full quality escape lifecycle, and serves as CAMP's quality voice with OEMs, regulators, and key customers. The right candidate combines deep aviation maintenance knowledge with a disciplined, data-driven approach to compliance and continuous improvement.

This is a high-visibility leadership role reporting to the Vice President, Aviation Health Management Operations. The Director partners with senior leaders across a global organization and will build on an established quality program: strengthening the QMS, deepening OEM and customer confidence, and scaling quality practices as AHM grows.

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Own and lead quality strategy across the full Aircraft Health Management organization, spanning maintenance tracking and engine health monitoring services, aligned with CAMP's business objectives.
* Serve as the escalation point for quality complaints from customer-facing, maintenance compliance, engine health monitoring, flight scheduling, and inventory functions.
* Partner with senior management and departmental leaders to embed quality methodologies across the organization and lead the associated change management.
* Own the quality budget, resource plan, and tooling (QMS, audit, and corrective action platforms), and build the succession pipeline for the quality team.

**Quality Management System & Certification**

* Own the Quality Management System (QMS) and quality SOPs, driving continuous improvement and ensuring processes meet strict regulatory and OEM requirements.
* Maintain ISO 9001 (or higher) certification for the engine health monitoring business, serving as external certification audit lead and ensuring ongoing audit readiness.
* Lead QMS management review with executive leadership, setting risk-based quality objectives and ensuring consistent QMS implementation (document control, competency records, data integrity) across all AHM locations in North America, Europe, and India.

**Audit & Compliance**

* Own the internal audit program end to end, including audit planning, execution, reporting, and the selection, training, and management of internal auditors.
* Host and manage OEM, customer, and third-party audits, driving findings to timely closure.

**Quality Escapes & Corrective Action**

* Manage all quality escapes from intake through investigation, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness, with clear accountability to customers and OEM partners.
* Define and report corrective action performance metrics (e.g., escape rate, time to containment, on-time closure, recurrence) with clear thresholds and escalation paths.

**OEM & Customer Engagement**

* Facilitate and chair weekly, monthly, and quarterly strategic OEM meetings covering quality trends, KPI compliance, and corrective action status.
* Serve as primary quality liaison to OEM partners, regulatory bodies, and high-profile customers and large fleet operators under significant OEM contracts.
* Facilitate weekly, monthly, and quarterly quality reviews with senior management and functional leaders, translating escape, audit, and customer feedback data into trends and strategic quality initiatives.

**Continuous Improvement & Team Leadership**

* Lead process improvement using Lean Six Sigma methods, mentoring teams and driving measurable reductions in escapes, rework, and risk.
* Maintain an executive quality scorecard (customer feedback, escapes, audit results, corrective action performance) to drive data-based decisions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of four, setting priorities and fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Partner with AHM operations, training, and product leaders to ensure analyst competency, training effectiveness, and quality readiness for new products, processes, and teams.

**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum of 10 years of proven leadership experience in the aviation or aerospace sector, with senior quality assurance experience preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of aviation maintenance and its regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA, and OEM requirements). Hands-on aviation maintenance experience may offset formal credentials.
* Experience managing quality escapes, investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action programs.
* Experience owning or managing a QMS in a regulated environment, with working knowledge of ISO 9001 (AS9100 familiarity a plus).
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn quality data into executive-level metrics, insights, and recommendations.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships with OEMs, customers, and leaders at all levels of the organization.
* Strategic thinking with a strong focus on results and the ability to manage complex projects and initiatives.
* Ability to lead across a multi-site, multi-region team; willingness to travel to CAMP offices, OEM, and customer sites as needed.

**Nice to have:**

* Certified ISO 9001 Internal/External Auditor (or equivalent lead auditor certification) with hands-on audit experience.
* Six Sigma Black Belt, with demonstrated process improvement results.
* Quality manager certification (e.g., ASQ CQM) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) is a bonus.
* Experience working with large OEM contracts and high-profile customers or large fleet operators.
* Experience in aircraft maintenance tracking, engine trend monitoring, or other SaaS/data-driven service environments.

**Why Work at CAMP?**

Join a culture where your ideas matter, your impact is real, and your growth is supported. Be part of a team reimagining the future of aviation.

CAMP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer - vets/disabled

CAMP is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, please contact hr@campsystems.com.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status EEO.

Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws.
  
For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

**Obsessed by Science. Entrepreneurial by Nature. United by Purpose.**
Diasorin is a global leader in immunodiagnostic and molecular diagnostic solutions, advancing science to improve patient outcomes worldwide. For more than 50 years, we have combined scientific rigor with an entrepreneurial mindset, operating with a strong commitment to innovation, accountability, and results to deliver trusted diagnostic solutions.
  
  
As the Diagnostics Specialist, Diasorin continuously invests in research, technology, and people. Guided by our values of operational excellence, customer focus, and teamwork, we empower teams to think boldly, act decisively, and transform ideas into meaningful impact across one of the industry’s broadest specialty diagnostic portfolios.
  
  
When you join Diasorin, you are not just filling a role. You are helping build what comes next.
  
  
**Why Join Diasorin**

* Build What Matters Take ownership, challenge the status quo, and contribute directly to solutions that improve patient care worldwide.
* Innovate with Agility at a Global Scale Work in an entrepreneurial environment that enables speed, collaboration, and global impact.
* Grow in a People-Centered Culture Thrive in a culture that values accountability, inclusion, and continuous development.

**Job Scope:**
The Director, Quality Assurance for Austin will lead, establish, implement and maintain quality assurance systems and activities ensuring compliance with domestic and international quality system standards and regulations for commercial medical devices designed, produced and marketed by Luminex. Partner with Manufacturing, Design/Development, Systems Engineering, Quality Control and others across functions to deliver the highest quality instruments, and reagents. This position is responsible for the oversight, control and release of instruments and reagents, quality organizational management, budget preparation, personnel management, organizational goals and metrics, and Executive Level presentations. The Director, Quality Assurance for Austin is a leader and a mentor.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Duties**

* Ensures that the Austin site demonstrates regulatory compliance per GLP/GCP/cGMP/GXP, ISO, and other applicable regulations.
* Support instrument new product development and manufacturing changes, provides guidance to the core teams and participate in the process.
* Leader in process optimization by Identifying and analyzing opportunities for continual improvements in product/service quality, customer satisfaction, and company profitability.
* Leads the strategy and improvements for the manufacturing and service depot of Instruments for our customers and partners in compliance with regulations and standards.
* Participates and manage activities for external audits such as ISO, FDA or other regulatory bodies for the Austin site. Acts in Audits - as co-host, SME or escort
* Responds to alleged QMS violations of regulations, policies, procedures as the result of both external and external audits by evaluating and recommending the initiation of investigative activities, immediate corrections and risk analysis processes. Coordinates responses to external audits and manages corrective actions to close.
* Interacts with various internal and external groups to facilitate the completion of internal audits, handling of non-conformances, performing Risk Assessments, CAPA, investigation and support, manufacturing validation as well as Design Transfer.
* QMS improvements and enhancements and is a leading member of the Quality Management Team. Works across the corporation to align and define quality approach for molecular diagnostic products.
* Partners with Site Leadership and Field Quality to conduct, manage, and evaluate investigations related to customer complaints, nonconformances, audits, corrective/preventive action concerns, deviations, recalls, and potential injuries
* Appropriately escalate Quality issues to the Vice President Quality Assurance Molecular Division
* Provide leadership in the application of Quality Tools such as Risk Management, Root Cause Investigations, Designs of Experiments, Capability Studies, in the establishment and investigation of process and products failures and implement lasting solutions of such failures.
* May act as IVDR Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) for Luminex sites to ensure: the conformity of the devices is appropriately checked before a device is released, the post-market surveillance and reporting obligations are fulfilled and all requirements established between Luminex and Authorized representative are met.
* May act as Management Representative for the site. In this capacity, ensure that product meets label claims and customer satisfaction, any quality or regulatory issue is elevated to the President and/or Vice President Quality Assurance Compliance North America and oversee and drive continuous improvement.
* Develops and releases Change Plans and actions to support the changing needs and requirements of the organization as the result of strategic changes in business direction
* Provide other Quality related technical training as necessary
* Directs activities of employees or through managers who exercise full supervision for daily operations. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.
* Maintains talent through recruiting and development opportunities. Continually develops internal candidates through succession planning and career development.
* Responsible for enforcing all EHS policies in their span of control
* Be part of any the new key and strategic projects and due diligence process if required
* Ensure all site-level activities and related documentation are aligned with corporate procedures and conducted in accordance with DiaSorin’s established Corporate and Quality Assurance governance requirements.

**Education, Experience And Qualifications**

* Minimum Bachelor degree in a science or engineering discipline with 8+ years of relevant experience/training
* 10+ Years of Experience in Quality Assurance or Regulatory Affairs activities in a cGMP Medical Device or Pharmaceutical environment
* 5+ years of Demonstrated knowledge of current industry quality practices under ISO 13485, ISO 14971, CFR 820 and CFR 806 and international regulations preferred
* 2+ years of Management experience in a complex quality assurance/quality systems field
* 2+ years of Ability to provide leadership to others in the organization through influence, innovative practices and coaching skills to foster a corporate culture of responsiveness, compliance awareness, self-regulation, quality system ownership, challenge of status quo, and continuous improvement in order to achieve the highest level of compliance.
* 5+ years of Excellent problem solving methodology, using industry accepted concepts and tools to solve complex problems in creative and effective ways as they apply to compliance issues.
* 5+ years of Hands-on ability to sort through technical complexities and work in a flexible changing environment.
* 5+ years of Possesses a strong scientific and technical background, sufficient to establish creditability with senior management as well as the manufacturing and product development teams.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills
* Thorough knowledge of standards and regulations (cGMP, ISO 13485)
* Highly organized with proven time management and prioritization skills
* Ability to work independently and with minimal supervision
* High degree of problem solving, attention to detail, and analytical skills.
* Experience working independently in a fast-paced environment with rapidly changing priorities
* Ability to handle the pressure of meeting tight deadlines

Diasorin offers a competitive rewards package focused on your overall well-being. We are proud to offer a comprehensive plan of health benefits, retirement and financial wellbeing, time off programs, wellbeing support and perks. Benefits may vary by role, country, region, union status, and other employment status factors. You may also be eligible to participate in an annual incentive program. An incentive award, if any, depends on various factors, including, individual and organizational performance.

JOIN A TEAM WHERE YOU’LL BE CHALLENGED AND valued.
  
  
A career with Summit Polymers means working with smart people in a culture that thrives on challenging, meaningful work. At Summit, we look for growth potential with every hire. We don’t just fill seats, we set people on career paths. We’re always on the lookout for smart people who are committed to continuous improvement, customer service and quality.
  
  
**Job Description**
**JOB TITLE:**
Director, Corporate Quality
**FLSA STATUS:**
Exempt
  
  
**REPORTS TO:**
Regional Director of Manufacturing (Corporate)
  
  
**Summary**
This management position is responsible for developing, implementing and continually improving the company’s standardized manufacturing quality systems globally. The Director, Corporate Quality works collaboratively with plant quality managers, general managers and other company resources to achieve world class quality performance as measured by customer quality scorecards. The Director, Corporate Quality interfaces with key customer personnel to build customer confidence in Summit Polymers, ensure Summit Polymers meets customer expectations and requirements, and to resolve significant customer quality concerns.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Duties**
Is responsible for the following major tasks:
  
  

* Exhibits positive leadership and acts with highest levels of integrity and ethics
* Champions corporate wide manufacturing quality system standardization

+ Leads and collaborates with plant quality managers, general managers and RDMs to determine best practices and develop standardized quality system and procedures applicable to all manufacturing facilities
+ Administers, trains, and communicates the company’s standardized quality system and procedures to ensure they are effectively implemented and maintained throughout the company
+ Performs plant quality system standards compliance audits and leads follow up action plan reviews with each plant
+ Lead continuous improvement of quality systems

* Champions overall quality scorecard performance for all customers

+ Develops deep knowledge of every customer quality scorecard

The successful individual will have oversight of both Quality Assurance and Quality Control, with significant influence across manufacturing operations, regulatory affairs, product development and wider business strategy. This is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of the Quality function, work closely with executive leadership and help drive the business forward while maintaining the highest standards of product quality and patient safety.

**Key areas of responsibility:**

* Set the overall Quality vision, objectives and priorities for the site, leading both QA and QC and ensuring the function supports business growth, operational performance and regulatory compliance.

* Partner with Manufacturing, Operations, Regulatory Affairs, R&D and Engineering to provide Quality oversight across product development, technology transfer, validation, commercial manufacturing and post-market activities.

* Build, lead and develop a high-performing Quality organisation, establishing the appropriate structure, technical capabilities, succession planning and resources to support the site's future needs.
* Work directly with the CEO and wider leadership team, translating complex regulatory requirements and Quality risks into practical business decisions while protecting compliance and patient safety.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 12+ years of progressive experience within pharmaceutical manufacturing, with substantial Quality leadership experience in sterile pharmaceutical products.
* Proven executive-level leadership across multidisciplinary Quality organisations, ideally with responsibility for both QA and QC.
* A strong track record of leading FDA inspections, managing regulatory interactions and driving successful inspection readiness and remediation programmes.
* In-depth knowledge of US pharmaceutical cGMP requirements, particularly 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211, with familiarity with relevant medical device regulations.
* Broad expertise across QMS, CAPA, validation and qualification, laboratory operations, supplier quality, complaints, risk management and data integrity.
* Experience supporting products throughout the lifecycle, from development and regulatory submissions through commercial manufacturing, release and post-market activities.
* Demonstrated success building Quality teams, developing future leaders and embedding a culture of accountability, compliance and continuous improvement.
* The ability to operate as a strategic business partner to executive leadership while maintaining the independence and authority required of the Quality function.
* A degree in a relevant scientific or technical discipline is required.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The VP, Global GMP Quality position will be responsible for leading the GMP quality functional teams at Mirum and its subsidiaries (US and International). This position will play a pivotal role in steering the organization toward an ongoing commitment to quality improvement, driving efforts to identify areas for optimization, innovation, and excellence. This person will be responsible for managing, mentoring and supporting a GMP Operations team of clinical and commercial Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) professionals. This person will provide leadership and hands-on support to ensure the seamless execution of GMP QA and QC functions, including product quality complaint investigation, root-cause investigations, and the reporting of critical GMP issues to executive management.  This person will also be responsible for leading, providing direction, resources, and guidance to ensure that all GMP quality processes are executed with the highest standards of compliance with FDA, EMA, and other international regulatory requirements, corporate objectives, and industry best practices. This role also involves ensuring that the GMP and GDP quality functions are closely aligned with the organization’s broader strategic goals, guaranteeing that quality initiatives support the company’s mission, vision, and operational objectives.

* Serve as the GMP quality strategic leader to assist the head of quality to further develop the quality culture at Mirum to be compliant, collaborative and phase appropriate.
* Develop and execute a global GMP quality strategy to align with corporate goals and regulatory requirements.
* Serve as the GMP quality strategic leader within the Quality group to lead the GMP QA and QC functional teams in fostering professional development and guiding staff in all aspects of GMP/GDP competence in meeting domestic and international regulatory requirements and guidelines (FDA, EMA, MHRA, NMPA, ICH, etc.).

* Lead the GMP inspection readiness for the Company including GMP Quality improvement and maintenance.
* Host/Manage GMP PAI/PLI inspections at Mirum and support Mirum PAI/PLI related CMO inspections.
* Drive corporate values, vision, goals, and objectives through collaboration with senior leaders building cross-functional networks to influence operational capabilities.
* Serve as a GMP Quality advisor to cross-functional stakeholders within Mirum global organizations and subsidiaries.
* Promote collaboration across internal and external functional teams and stakeholders to identify, design and implement opportunities for improvement across all areas of GMP and GDP quality responsibilities.
* Establish, maintain, and ensure effectiveness of GMP and GDP quality programs and documentation to assure GxP compliance in the domestic and international regulatory environment.
* Oversee, support and perform all aspects of GMP QA and QC activities and functions for drug manufacturing to ensure product quality and supply chain integrity.
* Oversee and support all aspects of clinical and commercial product release which includes direct to market, partner and distributor.
* Serve as the Material Review Board (MRB) chair-person designee.
* Develop and execute a global recall strategy that integrates domestic and international recalls.
* Serve as the Recall Coordinator in the recall committee and support the recall/mock recall process.
* Collaborate with Commercial Organization on launch strategies, NPP/EAP/CUP programs and provide input as a Quality SME.

* Provide strategic and managerial leadership related to company objectives & initiatives and changing regulatory requirements to build, manage, and mentor high-performance QA and QC teams in a global environment.
* Oversee product launch, manufacturing, and distribution quality processes.
* Lead a culture of quality excellence, compliance, and continuous improvement across the organization.
* Ensure global GMP Quality Team meets stakeholder needs, focusing on efficiency, quality, budget management, and corporate growth.
* Serve as Quality Head designee for other GXP areas beyond GMP and GDP as required.
* Requires 15% domestic and international travel, at minimum.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education /Experience:**

* 15+ years of progressive Quality Assurance experience in pharmaceutical and/or Biotech industries, with at least 10+ years in quality leadership role and/or people management including direct & indirect reports.
* Demonstrates extensive knowledge of cGMP manufacturing and Quality Management in compliance with FDA (CBER and/or CDER) and EMA requirements for global-regulated products.
* Demonstrates extensive knowledge of the development and commercialization of medical device in compliance with FDA 21CFR820, ISO13485 and EMA MDR regulations
* Comprehensive knowledge of GMP, GDP, ISO, ICH, and global regulatory requirements.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

existing_roles.description:
At CompoSecure, we are redefining the future of payment card technology. As a global leader in premium metal payment cards and fintech solutions, we combine innovation with craftsmanship to deliver exceptional products for the world's leading financial institutions.
  
  
We're looking for talented individuals who share our passion for excellence and innovation.
  
  
**Position Overview**
This role provides senior leadership and ownership of the functions that safeguard product integrity and the operating environment: Quality, Compliance (Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Safety and regulatory conformance), Security, and Facilities. The position is accountable for ensuring that products consistently meet quality specifications, that operations remain fully compliant with regulatory and safety standards, that the site and its products are secure, and that facilities are maintained to support a reliable 24/7 manufacturing environment. The role establishes clear metrics and ownership across these areas and reports performance to senior leadership.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Quality: Establish and maintain quality control protocols for raw materials, components, and finished products. Design inspection and testing processes and provide guidance on maintaining consistent quality from the beginning of production through final release. Lead Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams, monitor quality metrics, and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to eliminate root causes of defects. Ensure conformance to customer, product, and industry specifications.
* Compliance: Ensure full compliance of operations with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and applicable safety standards in accordance with New Jersey law. Own audits, certifications, and documentation, and serve as the primary liaison with regulatory bodies, auditors, and customers on compliance matters. Identify potential risks and pitfalls (e.g., equipment failures or other disruptions) and develop strategies to mitigate these issues through process improvement, alternative suppliers of materials, or altered equipment.
* Security: Oversee physical and product security programs consistent with the company's trust and authentication mission. Establish and enforce protocols to protect raw materials, work-in-process, finished goods, and sensitive assets throughout the facility and supply chain. Ensure operations meet payment-industry and customer security requirements, and manage security personnel and access controls across all shifts.
* Accountability: Own the key performance indicators and reporting for quality, compliance, security, and facilities. Establish clear ownership, metrics, and dashboards, report performance to senior management, and foster a culture of accountability across the organization. Manage a team of approximately 35 people across 7 shifts supporting QA, Safety & Security.
* Facilities: Oversee facility operations, maintenance, and environmental health and safety of the buildings, grounds, and utilities. Ensure facilities are maintained to support a reliable 24/7 manufacturing environment, manage facility vendors and contractors, and lead facility-related capital projects, space planning, and safe-workplace initiatives.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Quality, Operations Management, or a related field.

* Deep knowledge of quality management systems (ISO 9001, IATF 16949 for automotive, AS9100 for aerospace, etc.)
* Six Sigma / Lean methodologies (typically Black Belt or Master Black Belt level)
* Root cause analysis and CAPA (corrective and preventive action) processes
* Statistical process control (SPC) and data-driven decision making
* Supplier quality management and audit experience

* OSHA, EPA, ISO 14001 (environmental), ISO 45001 (occupational health & safety)

* Environmental compliance (emissions, waste management, hazmat handling)

* Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional teams required.

* Quality certifications such as Black belt Six Sigma

**The Opportunity**

Our client is a leading global medical technology company looking to appoint a hands-on VP Global Product Distribution Quality. Reporting directly to the SVP of Corporate Quality, you will be responsible for developing and implementing business strategies to effectively manage all global product distribution quality. In this role, you will lead the global product distribution quality organization and processes, holding quality management accountability for all captive and outsourced distribution centres across every entity worldwide.

This is a genuine turnaround and organizational design mandate, rather than a caretaker or step-up role. You will step in to stabilize day-to-day operations, manage significant FDA and global regulatory scrutiny, and reshape the commercial quality infrastructure into a world-class function. For a seasoned executive who enjoys building progressive systems at scale, there is a clear path to expanded enterprise responsibility within 6 to 20 months.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Global Distribution Governance:**
  Own quality management systems/compliance performance across captive/3PL distribution centres globally - alongside full P&L, budget, and headcount accountability for the function.
* **Turnaround & Future-State Design:**
  Audit current teams, workflows, and systems to close compliance gaps, restructuring the global commercial quality organization into a streamlined, best-in-class model.
* **FDA & Global Regulatory Execution:**
  Act as the single accountable global executive for all distribution-related regulatory inspections, audit responses, and direct agency communications, including intensive FDA engagement.
* **Quality Systems & Digital Traceability:**
  Direct the IT partnership to optimize warehouse management systems (WMS), end-to-end product traceability, inventory controls, and nonconforming product containment.
* **Enterprise Leadership:**
  Serve as the global subject matter expert for distribution quality and contribute to enterprise-wide quality strategy as a senior member of the Global Corporate Quality leadership team.

  Deep operational expertise in commercial, supply chain, and global distribution quality across multi-site networks (upstream supplier quality into manufacturing is out of scope).

  Demonstrated success leading quality turnarounds, organizational redesigns, and systemic remediation under active FDA scrutiny.

  Hands-on command of international medical device regulations, import/export laws, embargoes, import bans, and regional market-entry barriers.

  Bachelor of Science in a medical or applied science discipline

**What Sets You Apart**

You lead from the front with high energy and a clear appetite for complex turnarounds. You combine sharp analytical rigor with executive presence, enabling you to influence across commercial, supply chain, and regulatory stakeholders while building high-performing global teams.

existing_roles.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

  

The Global Head of Quality provides strategic leadership and oversight of ProSciento's global Quality department, establishing the strategy, direction, governance, and priorities for the function. This role will oversee the Quality Management System (QMS) and ensures the organization maintains the highest standards of quality, regulatory compliance, and inspection readiness.

  

This role is accountable for establishing and advancing the company's quality strategy, Quality by Design and governance framework, and quality culture while ensuring compliance with applicable GxP regulations, FDA requirements, ISO standards, and other country specific, regional, and international regulatory requirements. The Global Head of Quality partners closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement, operational excellence, risk management, and organizational effectiveness while supporting ProSciento's strategic growth. Performs duties in accordance with ProSciento's values, policies, and procedures. Approximately 20% domestic and international travel is expected, with additional travel required based on business needs.

  

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

  
* Provides strategic leadership for ProSciento’s Quality department, establishing the vision, priorities, and organizational structure to support the company’s operations and business objectives.
  
* Accountable for the design, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with all applicable regulations including GCP, GLP, GMP (GxP), FDA, ISO, data privacy requirements, and other local, national, and international requirements.
  
* Responsible to oversee the quality of Global CRO studies and local site CRU trials as well as hands on experience implementing and maintaining a strategic Quality by Design framework for both business units.
  
* Responsible for the definition, development, implementation, monitoring and continuous improvement of quality systems, processes, and Key Quality indicators (KQIs) to drive operational excellence and regulatory compliance.
  

  

  
* Oversees the Quality Event Management program, including deviations, CAPAs, change control, investigations, risk assessments, and process improvement initiatives. Chairs or delegates the CAPA Board and ensures timely resolution of quality issues.
  
* Directs internal, external, sponsor, vendor, and regulatory inspection readiness activities, including audit planning, execution, response management, and corrective action oversight.
  
* Partners with Vendor Management to oversee supplier qualification, vendor audits, performance monitoring, and quality risk mitigation.
  
* Leads Executive Quality Management Reviews, ensuring quality trends, compliance risks, audit outcomes, CAPAs, and quality metrics are routinely communicated to Executive Leadership with appropriate recommendations and mitigation strategies.
  
* Oversee the development, maintenance, and governance of Quality Management System documentation, including quality policies, SOPs, work instructions, controlled documents, training programs, equipment records, and electronic document management systems.
  
* Partners with Information Technology and business leaders to ensure computerized systems, electronic records, and applicable equipment are appropriately qualified, verified, or validated in accordance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
  
* Establishes and promotes a culture of quality throughout the organization by providing strategic guidance, regulatory interpretation, and quality leadership across all functional departments.
  
* Maintains current knowledge of evolving global regulatory requirements, industry standards, and best practices, ensuring organizational policies and procedures remain compliant and effective.
  
* Builds, develops, and leads a high-performing Quality organization by fostering employee development, succession planning, collaboration, accountability, and a culture aligned with ProSciento's core values.
  
* Serves as the senior quality representative for regulatory agencies, sponsors, auditors, and executive leadership on matters relating to quality systems, compliance, and inspection readiness.
  

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

  

  
* Provides leadership and oversight for the Quality organization, including workforce planning, organizational design, recruitment, employee development, performance management, succession planning, coaching, and employee engagement.
  
* Establishes departmental objectives, allocates resources, and ensures the Quality organization effectively supports ProSciento's strategic and operational priorities.
  

  

**QUALIFICATIONS & EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:**

  

**Qualifications:**

  

To perform this job successfully an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
  
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Systems, or Regulatory Compliance within the CRO or clinical research industry, including at least 5 years in senior quality leadership roles with responsibility for organizational quality strategy and personnel management with a minimum of 3 years of Global experience.
  
* Equivalent combinations of education, training, and relevant experience will be considered.
  

  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND COMPETENCIES REQUIREMENTS:**

  

**Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities:**

  

  
* Extensive knowledge of Quality Management Systems and quality governance, with demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and continuously improving quality systems within clinical research and regulated environments.
  
* Comprehensive knowledge of applicable global regulatory requirements and industry standards, including FDA regulations, ICH Guidelines, GCP, GLP, GMP (GxP), ISO 9001, data integrity, and applicable privacy requirements. Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and continuously improving Quality Management Systems (QMS) supporting GCP, GLP, GMP (GxP) environments and clinical research operations.
  
* Demonstrated experience leading regulatory inspections, sponsor and internal audits, supplier qualification programs, CAPA governance, inspection readiness, and enterprise quality risk management.
  
* Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing quality organizations, while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  
* Proven strategic leadership, organizational planning, and change management skills, with the ability to partner with executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to establish quality strategies and organizational priorities.
  
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and risk assessment capabilities.
  
* Strong communication and executive presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across all organizational levels.
  
* Experience leading regulatory inspections, sponsor interactions, and quality governance forums.
  
* Ability to balance strategic leadership with operational execution in a dynamic, fast-paced organization.
  
* Proficiency with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), document management systems, quality metrics, and computerized system validation principles.
  

  

**Language Skills:**

  

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to interpret complex regulations, prepare executive reports, develop policies and procedures, and effectively communicate with regulatory agencies, sponsors, auditors, executive leadership, and employees.

  

**Reasoning Skills:**

  

Ability to analyze complex regulatory and operational issues, exercise sound judgment, assess organizational risk, and develop practical, compliant solutions in a dynamic business environment.

  

**Computer Skills:**

  

Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and experience with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), document management systems, learning management systems, audit management tools, and computerized system validation principles. Ability to quickly learn new software applications.

  

**CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT**

  

Verification of educational requirements, employment history, professional references, and certifications/training and U.S. work authorization.

  

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL EFFORT**

  

  
* Work is primarily performed in a professional office environment and may be conducted onsite, remotely, or in a hybrid work arrangement based on business needs and management approval.
  
* Occasional domestic and international travel may be required to support audits, regulatory inspections, client meetings, and business operations.
  

  

The above job description does not imply these outlined duties are the only duties performed by this employee. The incumbent is expected to perform other related duties necessary for the effective operation of the department and company.

  

ProSciento reserves the right to change or alter any of the above duties and responsibilities according to the operational needs of the department and company.

We've sold out of trucks, and we don't want it to happen again. We're hiring a
**Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering**
to grow our production capacity and own how we get there.

You'll lead the team that designs, buys and launches our new lines and equipment. Your decisions will show up directly in how many trucks leave the factory each month.

What you'll do

* Lead and grow the advanced manufacturing engineering team
* Own the manufacturing strategy and capital plan for scaling production
* Take new lines and equipment from concept through design, build, install, testing and start of production
* Plan capacity so production keeps ahead of customer demand
* Run equipment and facility projects to budget and schedule, and present them to the executive team
* Work closely with vehicle engineering, supply chain and operations so new designs can be built at volume
* Bring in integrators and equipment suppliers, and manage them through delivery

What you'll bring

**Must have**

* 8+ years in manufacturing engineering, with 4+ years leading teams
* A track record of growing production capacity: new lines, factory expansions or ramping to full rate
* Hands-on experience taking equipment from specification through install, testing and launch
* Experience building and managing capital budgets
* A degree in engineering (mechanical, manufacturing, industrial, chemical or similar)

**Nice to have**

* Background in EV, automotive, commercial vehicles or batteries. High-volume aerospace, heavy equipment or other complex hardware also welcome.
* Start-up or scale-up experience, ideally through early production and ramp-up
* Experience building a new factory from the ground up
